vajraiścakrairmahāśūlaiśśaktibhiḥ pāśapaṭṭiśaiḥ \|\| 7.1,20.29

musalairasibhiṣṭaṁkairbhidhipālaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ \|\| 7.1,20.30

uddhatāṁstridaśānsarvāṁllokapālapurassarān \|\| 7.1,20.30

bibhidurbalino vīrā vīrabhadrāṁgasaṁbhavāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.31

chiṁdhi bhiṁdhi kṣipa kṣipraṁ māryatāṁ dāryatāmiti \|\| 7.1,20.31

harasva praharasveti pāṭayotpāṭayeti ca \|\| 7.1,20.32

saṁraṁbhaprabhavāḥ krūrāśśabdāḥ śravaṇaśaṁkavaḥ \|\| 7.1,20.32

yatratatra gaṇeśānāṁ jajñire samarocitāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.33

vivṛttanayanāḥ keciddaṣṭadaṁṣṭroṣṭhatālavaḥ \|\| 7.1,20.33

āśramasthānsamākṛṣya mārayanti tapodhanāt \|\| 7.1,20.34

sruvānapaharantaśca kṣipantogniṁ jaleṣu ca \|\| 7.1,20.34

kalaśānapi bhindaṁtaśchiṁdaṁto maṇivedikāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.35

gāyaṁtaśca nadantaśca hasantaśca muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 7.1,20.35

raktāsavaṁ pibantaśca nanṛturgaṇapuṁgavāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.36

524

nirmathya seṁdrānamarān gaṇendrānvṛṣendranāgendramṛgendrasārāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.36

cakrurbahūnyapratimabhāvāḥ saharṣaromāṇi viceṣṭitāni \|\| 7.1,20.37

nandaṁti kecitpraharanti keciddhāvanti kecitpralapanti kecit \|\| 7.1,20.37

nṛtyanti kecidvihasanti kecidvalganti kecitpramathā balena \|\| 7.1,20.38

kecijjighṛkṣaṁti ghanānsa toyānkecidgrahītuṁ ravimutpataṁti \|\| 7.1,20.39

kecitprasartuṁ pavanena sārdhamicchaṁti bhīmāḥ pramathā viyatsthāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.39

ākṣipya kecicca varāyudhāni mahā bhujaṁgāniva vainateyāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.40

bhramaṁti devānapi vidravaṁtaḥ khamaṁḍale parvatakūṭakalpāḥ \|\| 7.1,20.40

utpāṭya cotpāṭyagṛhāṇi kecitsajālavātāyanavedikāni \|\| 7.1,20.41

vikṣipya vikṣipya jalasya madhye kālāṁbudābhāḥ pramathā nineduḥ \|\| 7.1,20.41

udvartitadvārakapāṭakuḍyaṁ vidhvastaśālāvalabhīgavākṣam \|\| 7.1,20.42

aho batābhajyata yajñavāṭamanāthavadvākyamivāyathārtham \|\| 7.1,20.42

hā nātha tāteti pituḥ suteti bhratarmamāmbeti ca mātuleti \|\| 7.1,20.43

utpāṭyamāneṣu gṛheṣu nāryo hyānāthaśabdānbahuśaḥ pracakruḥ \|\| 7.1,20.43

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe yajñavidhvaṁsano nāma viṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 21

vāyuruvāca

tatastridaśamukhyāste viṣṇuśakrapurogamāḥ \|\| 7.1,21.1

sarve bhayaparitrastādudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ \|\| 7.1,21.1

nijairadūṣitairaṁgairdṛṣṭvā devānupadrutān \|\| 7.1,21.2

daṁḍyānadaṁḍitānmatvā cukopa gaṇapuṁgavaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.2

tatastriśūlamādāya śarvaśaktinibarhaṇam \|\| 7.1,21.3

ūrdhvadṛṣṭirmahābāhurmukhājjvālāḥ samutsṛjan \|\| 7.1,21.3

amarānapi dudrāva dviradāniva kesarī \|\| 7.1,21.4

tānabhidravatastasya gamanaṁ sumanoharam \|\| 7.1,21.4

vārāṇasyeva mattasya jagāma prekṣaṇīyatām \|\| 7.1,21.5

tatastatkṣobhayāmāsa mahatsurabalaṁ balī \|\| 7.1,21.5

mahāsarovaraṁ yadvanmatto vāraṇayūthapaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.6

vikurvanbahudhāvarṇānnīlapāṁḍuralohitān \|\| 7.1,21.6

vibhradvyāghrājinaṁ vāso hemapravaratārakam \|\| 7.1,21.7

chindanbhindannuda 1 lindandārayanpramathannapi \|\| 7.1,21.7

vyacaraddevasaṁgheṣu bhadro 'gniriva kakṣagaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.8

tatra tatra mahāvegāccaraṁtaṁ śūladhāriṇam \|\| 7.1,21.8

tamekaṁ tridaśāḥ sarve sahasramiva menire \|\| 7.1,21.9

bhadrakālī ca saṁkruddhā yuddhavṛddhamadoddhatā \|\| 7.1,21.9

muktajvālena śūlena nirbibheda raṇe surān \|\| 7.1,21.10

sa tayā ruruce bhadro rudrakopasamudbhavaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.10

prabhayeva yugāṁtāgniścalayā dhūmadhūmrayā \|\| 7.1,21.11

bhadrakālī tadāyuddhe vidrutatridaśābabhau \|\| 7.1,21.11

1 nalopa ārṣaḥ

524

kalpe śeṣānalajvālādagdhāviśvajagadyathā \|\| 7.1,21.12

tadā savājinaṁ sūryaṁ rudrānrudragaṇāgraṇīḥ \|\| 7.1,21.12

bhadro mūrdhni jaghānāśu vāmapādena līlayā \|\| 7.1,21.13

asibhiḥ pāvakaṁ bhadraḥ paṭṭiśaistu yamaṁ yamī \|\| 7.1,21.13

rudrāndṛḍhena śūlena mudgarairvaruṇaṁ dṛḍhaiḥ \|\| 7.1,21.14

parighairnirṛtiṁ vāyuṁ ṭaṁkaiṣṭaṁkadharaḥ svayam \|\| 7.1,21.14

nirbibheda raṇe vīro līlayaiva gaṇeśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,21.15

sarvāndevagaṇānsadyo munīñchaṁbhorvirodhinaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.15

tato devaḥ sarasvatyā nāsikāgraṁ suśobhanam \|\| 7.1,21.16

ciccheda karajāgreṇa devamātustathaiva ca \|\| 7.1,21.16

ciccheda ca kuṭhāreṇa bāhudaṁḍaṁ vibhāvasoḥ \|\| 7.1,21.17

agrato dvyaṁgulāṁ jihvāṁ māturdevyā lulāva ca \|\| 7.1,21.17

svāhādevyāstathā devo dakṣiṇaṁ nāsikāpuṭam \|\| 7.1,21.18

cakarta karajāgreṇa vāmaṁ ca stanacūcukam \|\| 7.1,21.18

bhagasya vipule netre śatapatrasamaprabhe \|\| 7.1,21.19

prasahyotpāṭayāmāsa bhadraḥ paramavegavān \|\| 7.1,21.19

pūṣṇo daśanarekhāṁ ca dīptāṁ muktāvalīmiva \|\| 7.1,21.20

jaghāna dhanuṣaḥ koṭyā sa tenāspaṣṭavāgabhūt \|\| 7.1,21.20

tataścaṁdramasaṁ devaḥ pādāṁguṣṭhena līlayā \|\| 7.1,21.21

kṣaṇaṁ kṛmivadākramya gharṣayāmāsa bhūtale \|\| 7.1,21.21

śiraściccheda dakṣasya bhadraḥ paramakopataḥ \|\| 7.1,21.22

krośaṁtyāmeva vairiṇyāṁ bhadrakālyai dadau ca tat \|\| 7.1,21.22

tatprahṛṣṭā samādāya śirastālaphalopamam \|\| 7.1,21.23

sā devī kaṁḍukakrīḍāṁ cakāra samarāṁgaṇe \|\| 7.1,21.23

tato dakṣasya yajñastrī kuśīlā bhartṛbhiryathā \|\| 7.1,21.24

pādābhyāṁ caiva hastābhyāṁ hanyate sma gaṇeśvaraiḥ \|\| 7.1,21.24

ariṣṭanemine somaṁ dharmaṁ caiva prajāpatim \|\| 7.1,21.25

bahuputraṁ cāṁgirasaṁ kṛśāśvaṁ kaśyapaṁ tathā \|\| 7.1,21.25

gale pragṛhya balino gaṇapāḥ siṁhavikramāḥ \|\| 7.1,21.26

bhartsayaṁto bhṛśaṁ vāgbhirnirjaghnurmūrdhni muṣṭibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,21.26

dharṣitā bhūtavetālairdārāssutaparigrahāḥ \|\| 7.1,21.27

yathā kaliyuge jārairbalena kulayoṣitaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.27

tacca vidhvastakalaśaṁ bhagnayūpaṁ gatotsavam \|\| 7.1,21.28

pradīpitamahāśālaṁ prabhinnadvāratoraṇam \|\| 7.1,21.28

utpāṭitasurānīkaṁ hanyamānaṁ tapodhanam \|\| 7.1,21.29

praśāntabrahmanirghoṣaṁ prakṣīṇajanasaṁcayam \|\| 7.1,21.29

krandamānāturastrīkaṁ hatāśeṣaparicchadam \|\| 7.1,21.30

śūnyāraṇyanibhaṁ jajñe yajñavāṭaṁ tadārditam \|\| 7.1,21.30

śūlavegaprarugṇāśca bhinnabāhūruvakṣasaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.31

vinikṛttottamāṁgāśca petururvyāṁ surottamāḥ \|\| 7.1,21.31

hateṣu teṣu deveṣu patiteṣuḥ sahasraśaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.32

praviveśa gaṇeśānaḥ kṣaṇādāhavanīyakam \|\| 7.1,21.32

praviṣṭamatha taṁ dṛṣṭvā bhadraṁ kālāgnisaṁnibham \|\| 7.1,21.33

dudrāva maraṇādbhīto yajño mṛgavapurdharaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.33

sa visphārya mahaccāpaṁ dṛḍhajyāghoṣaṇabhīṣaṇam \|\| 7.1,21.34

525

bhadrastamabhidudrāva vikṣipanneva sāyakān \|\| 7.1,21.34

ākarṇapūrṇamākṛṣṭaṁ dhanurambudasaṁnibham \|\| 7.1,21.35

nādayāmāsa ca jyāṁ dyāṁ khaṁ ca bhūmiṁ ca sarvaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.35

tamupaśritya sannādaṁ hato 'smītyeva vihvalam \|\| 7.1,21.36

śaraṇārdhena vakreṇa sa vīro 'dhvarapūruṣam \|\| 7.1,21.36

mahābhayaskhalatpādaṁ vepantaṁ vigatatviṣam \|\| 7.1,21.37

mṛgarūpeṇa dhāvantaṁ viśiraskaṁ tadākarot \|\| 7.1,21.37

tamīdṛśamavajñātaṁ dṛṣṭvā vai sūryasaṁbhavam \|\| 7.1,21.38

viṣṇuḥ paramasaṁkruddho yuddhāyābhavadudyataḥ \|\| 7.1,21.38

tamuvāha mahāvegātskandhena natasaṁdhinā \|\| 7.1,21.39

sarveṣāṁ vayasāṁ rājā garuḍaḥ pannagāśanaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.39

devāśca hataśiṣṭā ye devarājapurogamāḥ \|\| 7.1,21.40

pracakrustasya sāhāyyaṁ prāṇāṁstyaktumivodyatāḥ \|\| 7.1,21.40

viṣṇunā sahitāndevānmṛgendraḥ kroṣṭukāniva \|\| 7.1,21.41

dṛṣṭvā jahāsa bhūtendro mṛgendra iva vivyathaḥ \|\| 7.1,21.41

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe devadaṁḍavarṇanaṁ nāmaikaviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 22

tasminnavasare vyomni samāvirabhavadrathaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.1

sahasrasūryasaṁkāśaścārucīravṛṣadhvajaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.1

aśvaratnadvayodāro rathacakracatuṣṭayaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.2

sañcitānekadivyāstraśastraratnapariṣkṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.2

tasyāpi rathavaryasya syātsa eva hi sārathiḥ \|\| 7.1,22.3

yathā ca traipure yuddhe pūrvaṁ śārvarathe sthitaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.3

sa taṁ rathavaraṁ brahmā śāsanādeva śūlinaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.4

haressamīpamānīya kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata \|\| 7.1,22.4

bhagavanbhadra bhadrāṁga bhagavānindubhūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.5

ājñāpayati vīrastvāṁ rathamāroḍhumavyayaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.5

rebhyāśramasamīpasthastryaṁbako 'ṁbikayā saha \|\| 7.1,22.6

sampaśyate mahābāho dussahaṁ te parākramam \|\| 7.1,22.6

tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā sa vīro gaṇakuñjaraḥ \|\| 7.1,22.7

āruroha rathaṁ divyamanugṛhya pitāmaham \|\| 7.1,22.7

tathā rathavare tasminsthite brahmaṇi sārathau \|\| 7.1,22.8

bhadrasya vavṛdhe lakṣmī rudrasyeva puradviṣaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.8

tataḥ śaṁkhavaraṁ dīptaṁ pūrṇacaṁdrasamaprabham \|\| 7.1,22.9

pradadhmau vadane kṛtvā bhānukaṁpo mahābalaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.9

tasya śaṁkhasya taṁ nādaṁ bhinnasārasasannibham \|\| 7.1,22.10

śrutvā bhayena devānāṁ jajvāla jaṭharānalaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.10

yakṣavidyādharāhīndraiḥ siddhairyuddhadidṛkṣubhiḥ \|\| 7.1,22.11

kṣaṇena nibaḍībhūtāḥ sākāśavivarā diśāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.11

tataḥ śārṅgeṇa cāpāṅkātsa nārāyaṇanīradaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.12

mahatā bāṇavarṣeṇa tutoda gaṇagovṛṣam \|\| 7.1,22.12

taṁ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇumāyāṁtaṁ śatadhā bāṇavarṣiṇam \|\| 7.1,22.13

sa cādade dhanurjaitraṁ bhadro bāṇasahasramuk \|\| 7.1,22.13

samādāya ca taddivyaṁ dhanussamarabhairavam \|\| 7.1,22.14

śanairvisphārayāmāsa meruṁ dhanuriveśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,22.14

tasya visphāryamāṇasya dhanuṣo 'bhūnmahāsvanaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.15

tena svanena mahatā pṛthivīṁ samakaṁpayat \|\| 7.1,22.15

tataḥ śaravaraṁ ghoraṁ dīptamāśīviṣopamam \|\| 7.1,22.16

jagrāha gaṇapaḥ śrīmānsvayamugraparākramaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.16

bāṇoddhāre bhujo hyasya tūṇīvadanasaṁgataḥ \|\| 7.1,22.17

pratyadṛśyata valmīkaṁ vivekṣuriva pannagaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.17

samuddhṛtaḥ kare tasya tatkṣaṇaṁ ruruce śareḥ \|\| 7.1,22.18

mahābhujaṁgasaṁdaṣṭo yathā bālabhujaṅgamaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.18

śareṇa ghanatīvreṇa bhadro rudraparākramaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.19

vivyādha kupito gāḍhaṁ lalāṭe viṣṇumavyayam \|\| 7.1,22.19

lalāṭe 'bhihito viṣṇuḥ pūrvamevāvamānitaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.20

cukopa gaṇapeṁdrāya mṛgeṁdrāyeva govṛṣaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.20

tatastvaśanikalpena krūrāsyena maheṣuṇā \|\| 7.1,22.21

vivyādha gaṇarājasya bhuje bhujagasannibhe \|\| 7.1,22.21

so 'pi tasya bhuje bhūyaḥ sūryāyutasamaprabham \|\| 7.1,22.22

visasarja śaraṁ vegādvīrabhadro mahābalaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.22

sa ca viṣṇuḥ punarbhadraṁ bhadro viṣṇuṁ tathā punaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.23

sa ca taṁ sa ca taṁ viprāśśaraistāvanujaghnatuḥ \|\| 7.1,22.23

tayoḥ parasparaṁ vegāccharānāśu vimuṁcatoḥ \|\| 7.1,22.24

dvayossamabhavadyuddhaṁ tumulaṁ romaharṣaṇam \|\| 7.1,22.24

taddṛṣṭvā tumulaṁ yuddhaṁ tayoreva parasparam \|\| 7.1,22.25

hāhākāro mahānāsīdākāśe khecareritaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.25

tatastvanalatuṁḍena śareṇādityavarcasā \|\| 7.1,22.26

vivyādha sudṛḍhaṁ bhadro viṣṇormahati vakṣasi \|\| 7.1,22.26

sa tu tīvraprapātena śareṇa dṛḍhamāhataḥ \|\| 7.1,22.27

mahatīṁ rujamāsādya nipapāta vimohitaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.27

punaḥ kṣaṇādivotthāya labdhasaṁjñastadā hariḥ \|\| 7.1,22.28

sarvāṇyapi ca divyāstrāṇyathainaṁ pratyavāsṛjat \|\| 7.1,22.28

sa ca viṣṇurdhanurmuktānsarvāñcharvacamūpatiḥ \|\| 7.1,22.29

sahasā vārayāmāsa ghoraiḥ pratiśaraiḥ śarān \|\| 7.1,22.29

tato viṣṇussvanāmāṁkaṁ bāṇamavyāhataṁ kvacit \|\| 7.1,22.30

sasarja krodharaktā kṣastamuddiśya gaṇeśvaram \|\| 7.1,22.30

taṁ bāṇaṁ bāṇavaryeṇa bhadro bhadrāhvayeṇa tu \|\| 7.1,22.30

aprāptameva bhagavāñciccheda śatadhā pathi \|\| 7.1,22.31

athaikeneṣuṇā śārṅgaṁ dvābhyāṁ pakṣau garutmataḥ \|\| 7.1,22.31

nimeṣādeva ciccheda tadadbhutamivābhavat \|\| 7.1,22.32

tato yogabalādviṣṇurdehāddevānsudāruṇān \|\| 7.1,22.32

śaṁkhacakragadāhastān visasarja sahasraśaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.33

sarvāṁstānkṣaṇamātreṇa traipurāniva śaṁkaraḥ \|\| 7.1,22.33

nirdadāha mahābāhurnetrasṛṣṭena vahninā \|\| 7.1,22.34

tataḥ kruddhataro viṣṇuścakramudyamya satvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,22.34

tasminvīro samutsraṣṭuṁ tadānīmudyato 'bhavat \|\| 7.1,22.35

taṁ dṛṣṭvā cakramudyamya purataḥ samupasthitam \|\| 7.1,22.35

smayanniva gaṇeśāno vyaṣṭaṁbhayadayatnataḥ \|\| 7.1,22.36

staṁbhitāṁgastu taccakraṁ ghoramapratimaṁ kvacit \|\| 7.1,22.36

icchannapi samutsraṣṭuṁ na viṣṇurabhavatkṣamaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.37

śvasannivaikamuddhṛtya bāhuṁ cakrasamanvitam \|\| 7.1,22.37

atiṣṭhadalaso bhūtvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.38

viśarīro yathājīvo viśṛṅgo vā yathā vṛṣaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.38

vidaṁṣṭraśca yathā siṁhastathā viṣṇuravasthitaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.39

taṁ dṛṣṭvā durdaśāpannaṁ viṣṇumiṁdrādayaḥ surāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.39

samunnaddhā gaṇendreṇa mṛgeṁdreṇeva govṛṣāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.39

pragṛhītāyudhā yauddhuṁkruddhāḥ samupatasthire \|\| 7.1,22.40

tāndṛṣṭvā samare bhadraḥkṣudrāniva harirmṛgān \|\| 7.1,22.40

sākṣādrudratanurvīro varavīragaṇāvṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.41

aṭṭahāsena ghoreṇa vyaṣṭaṁ bhayadaniṁditaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.41

tathā śatamakhasyāpi savajro dakṣiṇaḥ karaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.42

sisṛkṣoreva udvajraścitrīkṛta ivābhavat \|\| 7.1,22.42

anyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṁ saraktā api bāhavaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.43

alasānāmivāraṁbhāstādṛśāḥ pratiyāṁtyuta \|\| 7.1,22.43

evaṁ bhagavatā tena vyāhatāśeṣavaibhavāt \|\| 7.1,22.44

amarāḥ samare tasya purataḥ sthātumakṣamāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.44

stabdhairavayavaireva dudruvurbhayavihvalāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.45

sthitiṁ ca cakrire yuddhe vīratejobhayākulāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.45

vidrutāṁstridaśānvīrānvīrabhadro mahābhujaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.46

vivyādha niśitairbāṇairmagho varṣairivācalān \|\| 7.1,22.46

bahavastasya vīrasya bāhavaḥ parighopamāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.47

śastraiścakāśire dīptaiḥ sāgnijvālā ivoragāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.47

astraśastrāṇyanekānisavīro visṛjanbabhau \|\| 7.1,22.48

visṛjansarvabhūtāni yathādau viśvasaṁbhavaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.48

yathā raśmibhirādityaḥ pracchādayati medinīm \|\| 7.1,22.49

tathā vīraḥ kṣaṇādeva śaraiḥ prācchādayaddiśaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.49

khamaṁḍale gaṇendrasya śarāḥ kanakabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.50

utpataṁtastaḍidrūpairupamānapadaṁ yayuḥ \|\| 7.1,22.50

mahāṁtaste suragaṇānmaṁḍūkānivaḍuṁḍubhāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.51

prāṇairviyojayāmāsuḥ papuśca rudhirāsavam \|\| 7.1,22.51

nikṛttabāhavaḥ kecitkecillūnavarānanāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.52

pārśve vidāritāḥ kecinnipeturamarā bhuvi \|\| 7.1,22.52

viśikhonmathitairgātrairbahubhiśchinnasandhibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,22.53

vivṛttanayanāḥ kecinnipeturbhūtale mṛtāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.53

gāṁ praveṣṭumivecchaṁtaḥ khaṁ gaṁtumiva lipsavaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.53

alabdhātmanirodhānāṁ vyalīyaṁtaḥ parasparam \|\| 7.1,22.54

bhūmau kecitpraviviśuḥ parvatānāṁ guhāḥ pare \|\| 7.1,22.54

apare jagmurākāśaṁ pare ca viviśurjalam \|\| 7.1,22.55

tathā saṁchinnasarvāṁgaissa vīrastridaśairbabhau \|\| 7.1,22.55

parigrastaprajāvargo bhagavāniva bhairavaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.56

dagdhatripurasaṁvyūhastripurāriryathābhavat \|\| 7.1,22.56

evaṁ devabalaṁ sarvaṁ dīnaṁ bībhatsadarśanam \|\| 7.1,22.57

gaṇeśvarasamutpannaṁ kṛpaṇaṁ vapurādade \|\| 7.1,22.57

tadā tridaśavīrāṇāmasṛksalilavāhinī \|\| 7.1,22.58

526

prāvartata nadī ghorā prāṇināṁ bhayaśaṁsinī \|\| 7.1,22.58

rudhireṇa pariklinnā yajñabhūmistadā babhau \|\| 7.1,22.59

raktārdravasanā śyāmā hataśuṁbheva kaiśikī \|\| 7.1,22.59

tasminmahati saṁvṛtte samare bhṛśadāruṇe \|\| 7.1,22.60

bhayeneva paritrastā pracacāla vasundharā \|\| 7.1,22.60

mahormikalilāvartaścukṣubhe ca mahodadhiḥ \|\| 7.1,22.61

petuścolkā mahotpātāḥ śākhāśca mumucurdrumāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.61

aprasannā diśaḥ sarvāḥ pavanaścāśivo vavau \|\| 7.1,22.62

aho vidhiviparyāsastvaśvamedhoyamadhvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,22.62

yajamānassvayaṁ dakṣau brahmaputraprajāpatiḥ \|\| 7.1,22.62

dharmādayassadasyāśca rakṣitā garuḍadhvajaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.63

bhāgāṁśca pratigṛhṇaṁti sākṣādiṁdrādayaḥ surāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.63

tathāpi yajamānasya yajñasya ca sahartvijaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.64

sadya eva śiraśchedassādhu saṁpadyate phalam \|\| 7.1,22.64

tasmānnāvedanirdiṣṭaṁ na ceśvarabahiṣkṛtam \|\| 7.1,22.65

nāsatparigṛhītaṁ ca karma kuryātkadācana \|\| 7.1,22. 65

kṛtvāpi sumahatpuṇyamiṣṭvā yajñaśatairapi \|\| 7.1,22.66

na tatphalamavāpnoti bhaktihīno maheśvare \|\| 7.1,22.66

kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṁ bhaktyā yajati yaśśivam \|\| 7.1,22.67

mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairnātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 7.1,22.67

bahunātra kimuktena vṛthā dānaṁ vṛthā tapaḥ \|\| 7.1,22.68

vṛthā yajño vṛthā homaḥ śivanindāratasya tu \|\| 7.1,22.68

tataḥ sanārāyaṇakāssarudrāḥ salokapālāssamare suraughāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.69

gaṇeṁdracāpacyutabāṇaviddhāḥ pradudruvurgāḍharujābhibhūtāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.69

celuḥ kvacitkecana śīrṇakeśāḥ seduḥ kvacitkecana dīrghagātrāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.70

petuḥ kvacitkecana bhinnavaktrā neśuḥ kvacitkecana devavīrāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.70

kecicca tatra tridaśā vipannā visrastavastrābharaṇāstraśastrāḥ \|\| 7.1,22.71

nipeturudbhāsitadīnamudrā madaṁ ca darpaṁ ca balaṁ ca hitvā \|\| 7.1,22.71

sasmutpathaprasthitamapradhṛṣyo vikṣipya dakṣādhvaramakṣatāstraiḥ \|\| 7.1,22.72

babhau gaṇeśassa gaṇeśvarāṇāṁ madhye sthitaḥ siṁha ivarṣabhāṇām \|\| 7.1,22.72

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrkhaṇḍe dakṣayajñavidhvaṁsavarṇanaṁ nāma dvāviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 23

vāyuruvāca

iti sañchinnabhinnāṁgā devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.1

kṣaṇātkaṣṭāṁ daśāmetya tresuḥ stokāvaśeṣitā \|\| 7.1,23.1

trastāṁstānsamare vīrān devānanyāṁśca vai gaṇāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.2

pramathāḥ paramakruddhā vīrabhadrapraṇoditāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.2

pragṛhya ca tathā doṣaṁ nigaḍairāyasairdṛḍhaiḥ \|\| 7.1,23.3

babandhuḥ pāṇipādeṣu kaṁdhareṣūdareṣu ca \|\| 7.1,23.3

tasminnavasare brahmā bhadramadrīndrajānutam \|\| 7.1,23.4

sārathyāllabdhavātsalyaḥ prārthayan praṇato 'bravīt \|\| 7.1,23.4

527

alaṁ krodhena bhagavannaṣṭāścaite divaukasaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.5

prasīda kṣamyatāṁ sarvaṁ romajaissaha suvrata \|\| 7.1,23.5

evaṁ vijñāpitastena brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā \|\| 7.1,23.6

śamaṁ jagāma saṁprīto gaṇapastasya gauravāt \|\| 7.1,23.6

devāśca labdhāvasarā devadevasya maṁtriṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.7

dhārayanto 'ñjalīnmūrdhni tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ \|\| 7.1,23.7

devā ūcuḥ

namaḥ śivāya śāntāya yajñahantre triśūline \|\| 7.1,23. 8

rudrabhadrāya rudrāṇāṁ pataye rudrabhūtaye \|\| 7.1,23.8

kālāgnirudrarūpāya kālakāmāṁgahāriṇe \|\| 7.1,23.9

devatānāṁ śirohantre dakṣasya ca durātmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.9

saṁsargādasya pāpasya dakṣasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.10

śāsitāḥ samare vīra tvayā vayamaninditā \|\| 7.1,23.10

dagdhāścāmī vayaṁ sarve tvatto bhītāśca bho prabho \|\| 7.1,23.11

tvameva gatirasmākaṁ trāhi naśśaraṇāgatān \|\| 7.1,23.11

vāyuruvāca

tuṣṭastvevaṁ stuto devān visṛjya nigaḍātprabhuḥ \|\| 7.1,23.12

ānayaddevadevasya samīpamamarāniha \|\| 7.1,23.12

devopi tatra bhagavānantarikṣe sthitaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 7.1,23.13

sagaṇaḥ sarvagaḥ śarvassarvalokamaheśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,23.13

taṁ dṛṣṭvā parameśānaṁ devā viṣṇupurogamāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.14

prītā api ca bhītāśca namaścakrurmaheśvaram \|\| 7.1,23.14

dṛṣṭvā tānamarānbhītānpraṇatārtiharo haraḥ \|\| 7.1,23.15

idamāha mahādevaḥ prahasan prekṣya pārvatīm \|\| 7.1,23.15

mahādeva uvāca

mābhaiṣṭa tridaśāssarve yūyaṁ vai māmikāḥ prajāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.16

anugrahārthameveha dhṛto daṁḍaḥ kṛpālunā \|\| 7.1,23.16

bhavatāṁ nirjarāṇāṁ hi kṣānto 'smābhirvyatikramaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.17

kruddheṣvasmāsu yuṣmākaṁ na sthitirna ca jīvitam \|\| 7.1,23.17

vāyuruvāca

ityuktāstridaśāssarve śarveṇāmitatejasā \|\| 7.1,23.18

sadyo vigatasandehā nanṛturvibudhā mudā \|\| 7.1,23.18

prasannamanaso bhūtvānandavihvalamānasāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.19

stutimārebhire kartuṁ śaṁkarasya divaukasaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.19

devā ūcuḥ

tvameva devākhilalokakartā pātā ca hartā parameśvaro 'si \|\| 7.1,23.20

kaviṣṇurudrākhyasvarūpabhedai rajastamassattvadhṛtātmamūrte \|\| 7.1,23.20

sarvamūrte namaste 'stu viśvabhāvana pāvana \|\| 7.1,23.21

amūrte bhaktahetorhi gṛhītākṛtisaukhyada \|\| 7.1,23.21

caṁdro 'gado hi deveśa kṛpātastava śaṁkara \|\| 7.1,23.22

nimajjanānmṛtaḥ prāpa sukhaṁ mihirajājaliḥ \|\| 7.1,23.22

sīmantinī hatadhavā tava pūjanataḥ prabho \|\| 7.1,23.23

saubhāgyamatulaṁ prāpa somavāravratātsutān \|\| 7.1,23.23

śrīkarāya dadau devaḥ svīyaṁ padamanuttamam \|\| 7.1,23.24

sudarśanamarakṣastvaṁ nṛpamaṁḍalabhītitaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.24

meduraṁ tārayāmāsa sadāraṁ ca ghṛṇānidhiḥ \|\| 7.1,23.25

śāradāṁ vidhavāṁ cakre sadhavāṁ kriyayā bhavān \|\| 7.1,23.25

bhadrāyuṣo vipattiṁ ca vicchidya tvamadāḥ sukham \|\| 7.1,23.26

527

sauminī bhavabandhādvai muktā 'bhūttava sevanāt \|\| 7.1,23.26

viṣṇuruvāca

tvaṁ śaṁbho kaharīśāśca rajassattvatamoguṇaiḥ \|\| 7.1,23.27

kartā pātā tathā hartā janānugrahakāṁkṣayā \|\| 7.1,23.27

sarvagarvāpahārī ca sarvatejovilāsakaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.28

sarvavidyādigūḍhaśca sarvānugrahakārakaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.28

tvattaḥ sarvaṁ ca tvaṁ sarvaṁ tvayi sarvaṁ girīśvara \|\| 7.1,23.29

trāhi trāhi punastrāhi kṛpāṁ kuru mamopari \|\| 7.1,23.29

athāsminnantare brahmā praṇipatya kṛtāṁjaliḥ \|\| 7.1,23.30

evaṁ tvavasaraṁ prāpya vyajñāpayata śūline \|\| 7.1,23.30

brahmovāca

jaya deva mahādeva praṇatārtivibhaṁjana \|\| 7.1,23.31

īdṛśeṣvaparādheṣu ko 'nyastvattaḥ prasīdati \|\| 7.1,23.31

labdhamāno bhaviṣyaṁti ye purā nihitā mṛdhe \|\| 7.1,23.32

pratyāpattirna kasya syātprasanne parameśvare \|\| 7.1,23.32

yadidaṁ devadevānāṁ kṛtamantuṣu dūṣaṇam \|\| 7.1,23.33

tadidaṁ bhūṣaṇaṁ manyeta aṁgīkāragauravāt \|\| 7.1,23.33

iti vijñāpyamānastu brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā \|\| 7.1,23.34

vilokya vadanaṁ devyā devadevassmayanniva \|\| 7.1,23.34

putrabhūtasya vātsalyādbrahmaṇaḥ padmajanmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.35

devādīnāṁ yathāpūrvamaṁgāni pradadau prabhuḥ \|\| 7.1,23.35

prathamādyaiśca yā devyo daṁḍitā devamātaraḥ \|\| 7.1,23.36

tāsāmapi yathāpūrvāṇyaṁgāni giriśo dadau \|\| 7.1,23.36

dakṣasya bhagavāneva svayaṁ brahmā pitāmahaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.37

tatpāpānuguṇaṁ cakre jaracchāgamukhaṁ mukham \|\| 7.1,23.37

so 'pi saṁjñāṁ tato labdhvā sa dṛṣṭvā jīvitaḥ sudhī \|\| 7.1,23.38

bhītaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ śaṁbhuṁ tuṣṭāva pralapanbahu \|\| 7.1,23.38

dakṣa uvāca

jaya deva jagannātha lokānugrahakāraka \|\| 7.1,23.39

kṛpāṁ kuru maheśānāparādhaṁ me kṣamasva ha \|\| 7.1,23.39

kartā bhartā ca hartā ca tvameva jagatāṁ prabho \|\| 7.1,23.40

mayā jñātaṁ viśeṣeṇa viṣṇvādisakaleśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,23.40

tvayaiva vitataṁ sarvaṁ vyāptaṁ sṛṣṭaṁ na nāśitam \|\| 7.1,23.41

na hi tvadadhikāḥ kecidīśāste 'cyutakādayaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.41

vāyuruvāca

taṁ tathā vyākulaṁ bhītaṁ pralapaṁtaṁ kṛtāgasam \|\| 7.1,23.42

smayannivāvadatprekṣya mā bhairiti 1 ghṛṇānidhiḥ \|\| 7.1,23.42

tathoktvā brahmaṇastasya pituḥ priyacikīrṣayā \|\| 7.1,23.43

gāṇapatyaṁ dadau tasmai dakṣāyākṣayamīśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,23.43

tato brahmādayo devā abhivaṁdya kṛta 2 ṁjaliḥ \|\| 7.1,23.44

tuṣṭuvuḥ praśrayā vācā śaṁkaraṁ girijādhipam \|\| 7.1,23.44

brahmādaya ūcuḥ

jaya śaṁkara deveśa dīnānātha mahāprabho \|\| 7.1,23.45

1 sijlopa ārṣaḥ

2 ekavacanamārṣam

528

kṛpāṁ kuru maheśānāparādhaṁ no kṣamasva vai \|\| 7.1,23.45

makhapāla makhādhīśa makhavidhvaṁsakāraka \|\| 7.1,23.46

kṛpāṁ kuru maśānāparādhaṁ naḥ kṣamasva vai \|\| 7.1,23.46

devadeva pareśāna bhaktaprāṇaprapoṣaka \|\| 7.1,23.47

duṣṭadaṇḍaprada svāminkṛpāṁ kuru namo 'stu te \|\| 7.1,23.47

tvaṁ prabho garvahartā vai duṣṭānāṁ tvāmajānatām \|\| 7.1,23.48

rakṣako hi viśeṣeṇa satāṁ tvatsaktacetasām \|\| 7.1,23.48

adbhutaṁ caritaṁ te hi niścitaṁ kṛpayā tava \|\| 7.1,23.49

sarvāparādhaḥ kṣaṁtavyo vibhavo dīnavatsalāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.49

vāyuruvāca

iti stuto mahādevo brahmādyairamaraiḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 7.1,23.50

sa bhaktavatsalassvāmī tutoṣa karuṇodadhiḥ \|\| 7.1,23.50

cakārānugrahaṁ teṣāṁ brahmādīnāṁ divaukasām \|\| 7.1,23.51

dadau narāṁśca suprītyā śaṁkaro dīnavatsalaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.51

sa ca tatastridaśāñcharaṇāgatān paramakāruṇikaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,23.52

anugatasmitalakṣaṇayā girā śamitasarvabhayaḥ samabhāṣata \|\| 7.1,23.52

śiva uvāca

yadidamāga ihācaritaṁ surairvidhiniyogavaśādiva yantritaiḥ \|\| 7.1,23.53

śaraṇameva gatānavalokya vastadakhilaṁ kila vismṛtameva naḥ \|\| 7.1,23.53

tadiha yūyamapi prakṛtaṁ manasyavigaṇayya vimardamapatrapāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.54

hariviriṁcisurendramukhāssukhaṁ vrajata devapuraṁ prati saṁprati \|\| 7.1,23.54

iti surānabhidhāya sureśvaro nikṛtadakṣakṛtakraturakratuḥ \|\| 7.1,23.55

sagirijānucarassaparicchadaḥ sthita ivāmbaratontaradhāddharaḥ \|\| 7.1,23.55

atha surā api te vigatavyathāḥ kathitabhadrasubhadraparākramāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.56

sapadi khena sukhena yathāsukhaṁ yayuranekamukhāḥ maghavanmukhāḥ \|\| 7.1,23.56

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe giriśānunayo nāma trayoviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 24

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ

antardhānagato devyā saha sānucaro haraḥ \|\| 7.1,24.1

kva yātaḥ kutra vāsaḥ kiṁ kṛtvā virarāma ha \|\| 7.1,24.1

vāyuruvāca

mahīdharavaraḥ śrīmānmaṁdaraścitrakaṁdaraḥ \|\| 7.1,24.2

dayito devadevasya nivāsastapaso 'bhavat \|\| 7.1,24.2

tapo mahatkṛtaṁ tena voḍhuṁ svaśirasā śivau \|\| 7.1,24.3

cireṇa labdhaṁ tatpādapaṁkajasparśajaṁ sukham \|\| 7.1,24.3

tasya śailasya saundaryaṁ sahasravadanairapi \|\| 7.1,24.4

na śakyaṁ vistarādvaktuṁ varṣakoṭiśatairapi \|\| 7.1,24.4

śakyamapyasya saundaryaṁ na varṇayitumutsahe \|\| 7.1,24.5

parvatāntarasaundaryaṁ sādhāraṇavidhāraṇāt \|\| 7.1,24.5

idantu śakyate vaktumasminparvatasundare \|\| 7.1,24.6

ṛddhyā kayāpi saundaryamīśvarāvāsayogyatā \|\| 7.1,24.6

ata eva hi devena devyāḥ priyacikīrṣayā \|\| 7.1,24.7

atīva ramaṇīyoyaṁ girirantaḥpurīkṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.7

528

mekhalābhūmayastasya vimalopalapādapāḥ \|\| 7.1,24.8

śivayornityasānnidhyānnyakkurvaṁtyakhilaṁjagat \|\| 7.1,24.8

pitṛbhyāṁ jagato nityaṁ snānapānopayogataḥ \|\| 7.1,24.9

avāptapuṇyasaṁskāraḥ prasaradbhiritastataḥ \|\| 7.1,24.9

laghuśītalasaṁsparśairacchācchairnirjharāmbubhiḥ \|\| 7.1,24.10

adhirājyena cādrīṇāmadrīreṣo 'bhiṣicyate \|\| 7.1,24.10

niśāsu śikharaprāntarvartinā sa śiloccayaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.11

caṁdreṇācala sāmrājyacchatreṇeva virājate \|\| 7.1,24.11

sa śailaścaṁcalībhūtairbālaiścāmarayoṣitām \|\| 7.1,24.12

sarvaparvatasāmrājyacāmarairiva vījyate \|\| 7.1,24.12

prātarabhyudite bhānau bhūdharo ratnabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.13

darpaṇe dehasaubhāgyaṁ draṣṭukāma iva sthitaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.13

kūjadvihaṁgavācālairvātoddhṛtalatābhujaiḥ \|\| 7.1,24.14

vimuktapuṣpaiḥ satataṁ vyālambimṛdupallavaiḥ \|\| 7.1,24.14

latāpratānajaṭilaistarubhistapasairiva \|\| 7.1,24.15

jayāśiṣā sahābhyarcya niṣevyata ivādrirāṭ \|\| 7.1,24.15

adhomukhairūrdhvamukhaiśśṛṁgaistiryaṅmukhaistathā \|\| 7.1,24.16

prapatanniva pātāle bhūpṛṣṭhādutpatanniva \|\| 7.1,24.16

parītaḥ sarvato dikṣu bhramanniva vihāyasi \|\| 7.1,24.17

paśyanniva jagatsarvaṁ nṛtyanniva nirantaram \|\| 7.1,24.17

guhāmukhaiḥ pratidinaṁ vyāttāsyo vipulodaraiḥ \|\| 7.1,24.18

ajīrṇalāvaṇyatayā jṛṁbhamāṇa ivācalaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.18

grasanniva jagatsarvaṁ pibanniva payonidhim \|\| 7.1,24.19

vamanniva tamontasthaṁ mādyanniva khamambudaiḥ \|\| 7.1,24.19

nivāsa bhūmayastāstā darpaṇapratimodarāḥ \|\| 7.1,24.20

tiraskṛtātapāssnigdhāśramacchāyāmahīruhāḥ \|\| 7.1,24.20

saritsarastaḍāgādisaṁparkaśiśirānilāḥ \|\| 7.1,24.21

tatra tatra niṣaṇṇābhyāṁ śivābhyāṁ saphalīkṛtāḥ \|\| 7.1,24.21

tamimaṁ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṁ smṛtvā sāmbastriyambakaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.22

raibhyāśramasamīpasthaścāntardhānaṁ gato yayau \|\| 7.1,24.22

tatrodyānamanuprāpya devyā saha maheśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,24.23

rarāma ramaṇīyāsu devyāntaḥpurabhūmiṣu \|\| 7.1,24.23

tathā gateṣu kāleṣu pravṛddhāsu prajāsu ca \|\| 7.1,24.24

daityau śuṁbhaniśuṁbhākhyau bhrātarau saṁbabhūvatuḥ \|\| 7.1,24.24

tābhyāṁ tapo balāddattaṁ brahmaṇā parameṣṭinā \|\| 7.1,24.25

avadhyatvaṁ jagatyasminpuruṣairakhilairapi \|\| 7.1,24.25

ayonijā tu yā kanyā hyaṁbikāṁśasamudbhavā \|\| 7.1,24.26

ajātapuṁsparśaratiravilaṁghyaparākramā \|\| 7.1,24.26

tayā tu nau vadhaḥ saṁkhye tasyāṁ kāmābhibhūtayoḥ \|\| 7.1,24.27

iti cābhyarthito brahmā tābhyāmprāha tathāstviti \|\| 7.1,24.27

tataḥ prabhṛti śakrādīnvijitya samare surān \|\| 7.1,24.28

niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṁ jagaccakraturakramāt \|\| 7.1,24.28

tayorvadhāya deveśaṁ brahmābhyarthitavānpunaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.29

viniṁdyāpi rahasyaṁ vāṁ krodhayitvā yathā tathā \|\| 7.1,24.29

529

tadvarṇakośajāṁ śaktimakāmāṁ kanyakātmikām \|\| 7.1,24.30

niśumbhaśuṁbhayorhaṁtrīṁ surebhyo dātumarhasi \|\| 7.1,24.30

evamabhyarthito dhātrā bhagavānnīlalohitaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.31

kālītyāha rahasyaṁ vāṁ nindayanniva sasmitaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.31

tataḥ kruddhā tadā devī suvarṇā varṇakāraṇāt \|\| 7.1,24.32

smayantī cāha bhartāramasamādheyayā girā \|\| 7.1,24.32

devyuvāca

īdṛśo mama varṇesminna ratirbhavato 'sti cet \|\| 7.1,24.33

evāvantaṁ ciraṁ kālaṁ kathameṣā niyamyate \|\| 7.1,24.33

aratyā vartamāno 'pi kathaṁ ca ramase mayā \|\| 7.1,24.34

na hyaśakyaṁ jagatyasminnīśvarasya jagatprabhoḥ \|\| 7.1,24.34

svātmārāmasya bhavato ratirna sukhasādhanam \|\| 7.1,24.35

iti hetoḥ smaro yasmātprasabhaṁ bhasmasātkṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.35

yā ca nābhimatā bharturapi sarvāṁgasundarī \|\| 7.1,24.36

sā vṛthaiva hi jāyeta sarvairapi guṇāntaraiḥ \|\| 7.1,24.36

bharturbhogaikaśeṣo hi sarga evaiṣa yoṣitām \|\| 7.1,24.37

tathāsatyanyathābhūtā nārī kutropayujyate \|\| 7.1,24.37

tasmādvarṇamimaṁ tyaktvā tvayā rahasi ninditam \|\| 7.1,24.38

varṇāntaraṁ bhajiṣye vā na bhajiṣyāmi vā svayam \|\| 7.1,24.38

ityuktvotthāya śayanāddevī sācaṣṭa gadgadam \|\| 7.1,24.39

yayāce 'numatiṁ bhartustapase kṛtaniścayā \|\| 7.1,24.39

tathā praṇayabhaṁgena bhīto bhūtapatiḥ svayam \|\| 7.1,24.40

pādayoḥ praṇamanneva bhavānīṁ pratyabhāṣata \|\| 7.1,24.40

īśvara uvāca

ajānatī ca krīḍoktiṁ priye kiṁ kupitāsi me \|\| 7.1,24.41

ratiḥ kuto vā jāyeta tvattaścedaratirmama \|\| 7.1,24.41

mātā tvamasya jagataḥ pitāhamadhipastathā \|\| 7.1,24.42

kathaṁ tadutpapadyeta tvatto nābhiratirmama \|\| 7.1,24.42

āvayorabhikāmo 'pi kimasau kāmakāritaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.43

yataḥ kāmasamutpattiḥ prāgeva jagadudbhavaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.43

pṛthagjanānāṁ rataye kāmātmā kalpito mayā \|\| 7.1,24.44

tataḥ kathamupālabdhaḥ kāmadāhādahaṁ tvayā \|\| 7.1,24.44

māṁ vai tridaśasāmānyaṁ manyamāno manobhavaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.45

manākparibhavaṁ kurvanmayā vai bhasmasātkṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,24.45

vihāropyāvayorasya jagatastrāṇakāraṇāt \|\| 7.1,24.46

tatastadarthaṁ tvayyadya krīḍoktiṁ kṛtavāhanam \|\| 7.1,24.46

sa cāyamacirādarthastavaivāviṣkariṣyate \|\| 7.1,24.47

krodhasya janakaṁ vākyaṁ hṛdi kṛtvedamabravīt \|\| 7.1,24.47

devyuvāca

śrutapūrvaṁ hi bhagavaṁstava cāṭu vaco mayā \|\| 7.1,24.48

yenaivamatidhīrāhamapi prāgabhivaṁcitā \|\| 7.1,24.48

prāṇānapyapriyā bharturnārī yā na parityajet \|\| 7.1,24.49

kulāṁganā śubhā sadbhiḥ kutsitaiva hi gamyate \|\| 7.1,24.49

bhūyasī ca tavāprītiragauramiti me vapuḥ \|\| 7.1,24.50

krīḍoktirapi kālīti ghaṭate kathamanyathā \|\| 7.1,24.50

sadbhirvigarhitaṁ tasmāttava kārṣṇyamasaṁmatam \|\| 7.1,24.51

529

anutsṛjya tapoyogātsthātumeveha notsahe \|\| 7.1,24.51

śiva uvāca

sa yadyevaṁvidhatāpaste tapasā kiṁ prayojanam \|\| 7.1,24.52

mamecchayā svecchayā vā varṇāntaravatī bhava \|\| 7.1,24.52

devyuvāca

necchāmi bhavato varṇaṁ svayaṁ vā kartumanyathā \|\| 7.1,24.53

brahmāṇaṁ tapasārādhya kṣipraṁ gaurī bhavāmyaham \|\| 7.1,24.53

īśvara uvāca

matprasādātpurā brahmā brahmatvaṁ prāptavānpurā \|\| 7.1,24.54

tamāhūya mahādevi tapasā kiṁ kariṣyasi \|\| 7.1,24.54

devyuvāca

tvatto labdhapadā eva sarve brahmādayaḥ surāḥ \|\| 7.1,24.55

tathāpyārādhya tapasā brahmāṇaṁ tvanniyogataḥ \|\| 7.1,24.55

purā kila satī nāmnā dakṣasya duhitā 'bhavam \|\| 7.1,24.56

jagatāṁ patimevaṁ tvāṁ patiṁ prāptavatī tathā \|\| 7.1,24.56

evamadyāpi tapasā toṣayitvā dvijaṁ vidhim \|\| 7.1,24.57

gaurī bhavitumicchāmi ko doṣaḥ kathyatāmiha \|\| 7.1,24.57

evamukto mahādevyā vāmadevaḥ smayanniva \|\| 7.1,24.58

na tāṁ nirbaṁdhayāmāsa devakāryacikīrṣayā \|\| 7.1,24.58

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe śivamandaragirinivāsakrīḍoktavarṇanaṁ nāma caturviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 25

vāyuruvāca

tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya patimambā pativratā \|\| 7.1,25.1

niyamya ca viyogārtiṁ jagāma himavadgirim \|\| 7.1,25.1

tapaḥkṛtavatī pūrvaṁ deśe yasminsakhījanaiḥ \|\| 7.1,25.2

tameva deśamavṛnottapase praṇayātpunaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.2

tataḥ svapitaraṁ dṛṣṭvā mātaraṁ ca tayorgṛhe \|\| 7.1,25.3

praṇamya vṛttaṁ vijñāpya tābhyāṁ cānumatā satī \|\| 7.1,25.3

punastapovanaṁ gatvā bhūṣaṇāni visṛjya ca \|\| 7.1,25.4

snātvā tapasvino veṣaṁ kṛtvā paramapāvanam \|\| 7.1,25.4

saṁkalpya ca mahātīvraṁ tapaḥ paramaduścaram \|\| 7.1,25.5

sadā manasi sandhāya bhartuścaraṇapaṁkajam \|\| 7.1,25.5

tameva kṣaṇike liṁge dhyātvā bāhyavidhānataḥ \|\| 7.1,25.6

trisandhyamabhyarcayantī vanyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalādibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,25.6

sa eva brahmaṇo mūrtimāsthāya tapasaḥ phalam \|\| 7.1,25.7

pradāsyati mametyevaṁ nityaṁ kṛtvā 'karottapaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.7

tathā tapaścarantīṁ tāṁ kāle bahutithe gate \|\| 7.1,25.8

dṛṣṭaḥ kaścinmahāvyāghro duṣṭabhāvādupāgamat \|\| 7.1,25.8

tathaivopagatasyāpi tasyātīvadurātmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.9

gātraṁ citrārpitamiva stabdhaṁ tasyāssakāśataḥ \|\| 7.1,25.9

taṁ dṛṣṭvāpi tathā vyāghraṁ duṣṭabhāvādupāgatam \|\| 7.1,25.10

na pṛthagjanavaddevī svabhāvena vivicyate \|\| 7.1,25.10

sa tu viṣṭabdhasarvāṁgo bubhukṣāparipīḍitaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.11

mamāmiṣaṁ tato nānyaditi matvā nirantaram \|\| 7.1,25.11

nirīkṣyamāṇaḥ satataṁ devīmeva tadā 'niśam \|\| 7.1,25.12

atiṣṭhadagratastasyā upāsanamivācarat \|\| 7.1,25.12

530

devyāśca hṛdaye nityaṁ mamaivāyamupāsakaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.13

trātā ca duṣṭasattvebhya iti pravavṛte kṛpā \|\| 7.1,25.13

tasyā eva kṛpā yogātsadyonaṣṭamalatrayaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.14

babhūva sahasā vyāghro devīṁ ca bubudhe tadā \|\| 7.1,25.14

nyavartata bubhukṣā ca tasyāṁgastambhanaṁ tathā \|\| 7.1,25.15

daurātmyaṁ janmasiddhaṁ ca tṛptiśca samajāyata \|\| 7.1,25.15

tadā paramabhāvena jñātvā kārtārthyamātmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.16

sadyopāsaka evaiṣa siṣeve parameśvarīm \|\| 7.1,25.16

duṣṭānāmapi sattvānāṁ tathānyeṣāndurātmanām \|\| 7.1,25.17

sa eva drāvako bhūtvā vicacāra tapovane \|\| 7.1,25.17

tapaśca vavṛdhe devyāstīvraṁ tīvratarātmakam \|\| 7.1,25.18

devāśca daityanirbandhādbrahmāṇaṁ śaraṇaṁ gatāḥ \|\| 7.1,25.18

cakrurnivedanaṁ devāḥ svaduḥkhasyāripīḍanāt \|\| 7.1,25.19

yathā ca dadatuḥ śumbhaniśumbhau varasammadāt \|\| 7.1,25.19

so 'pi śrutvā vidhirduḥkhaṁ surāṇāṁ kṛpayānvitaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.20

āsīddaityavadhāyaiva smṛtvā hetvāśrayāṁ kathām \|\| 7.1,25.20

sāmaraḥ prārthito brahmā yayau devyāstapovanam \|\| 7.1,25.21

saṁsmaranmanasā devaduḥkhamokṣaṁ svayatnataḥ \|\| 7.1,25.21

dadarśa ca suraśreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhe tapasi niṣṭhitām \|\| 7.1,25.22

pratiṣṭhāmiva viśvasya bhavānīṁ parameśvarīm \|\| 7.1,25.22

nanāma cāsya jagato mātaraṁ svasya vai hareḥ \|\| 7.1,25.23

rudrasya ca piturbhāryāmāryāmadrīśvarātmajām \|\| 7.1,25.23

brahmāṇamāgataṁ dṛṣṭvā devī devagaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 7.1,25.24

arghyaṁ tadarhaṁ dattvā 'smai svāgatādyairupācarat \|\| 7.1,25.24

tāṁ ca pratyupacāroktiṁ puraskṛtyābhinaṁdya ca \|\| 7.1,25.25

papraccha tapaso hetumajānanniva padmajaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.25

brahmovāca

tīvreṇa tapasānena devyā kimiha sādhyate \|\| 7.1,25.26

tapaḥphalānāṁ sarveṣāṁ tvadadhīnā hi siddhayaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.26

yaścaiva jagatāṁ bhartā tameva parameśvaram \|\| 7.1,25.27

bhartāramātmanā prāpya prāptañca tapasaḥ phalam \|\| 7.1,25.27

athavā sarvamevaitatkrīḍāvilasitaṁ tava \|\| 7.1,25.28

idantu citraṁ devasya virahaṁ sahase katham \|\| 7.1,25.28

devyuvāca

sargādau bhavato devādutpattiḥ śrūyate yadā \|\| 7.1,25.29

tadā prajānāṁ prathamastvaṁ me prathamajaḥ sutaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.29

yadā punaḥ prajāvṛddhyai lalāṭādbhavato bhavaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.30

utpanno 'bhūttadā tvaṁ me guruḥ śvaśurabhāvataḥ \|\| 7.1,25.30

yadā bhavadgirīndraste putro mama pitā svayam \|\| 7.1,25.31

tadā pitāmahastvaṁ me jāto lokapitāmaha \|\| 7.1,25.31

tadīdṛśasya bhavato lokayātrāvidhāyinaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.32

vṛttavantaḥpure bhartā kathayiṣye kathaṁ punaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.32

kimatra bahunā dehe yaścāyaṁ mama kālimā \|\| 7.1,25.33

tyaktvā sattvavidhānena gaurī bhavitumutsahe \|\| 7.1,25.33

530

brahmovāca

etāvatā kimarthena tīvraṁ devi tapaḥ kṛtam \|\| 7.1,25.34

svecchaiva kimaparyāptā krīḍeyaṁ hi tavedṛśī \|\| 7.1,25.34

krīḍā 'pi ca jaganmātastava lokahitāya vai \|\| 7.1,25.35

ato mameṣṭamanayā phalaṁ kimapi sādhyatām \|\| 7.1,25.35

niśuṁbhaśuṁbhanāmānau daityau dattavarau mayā \|\| 7.1,25.36

dṛptau devānprabādhete tvatto labdhastayorvadhaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.36

alaṁ vilaṁbanenātra tvaṁ kṣaṇena sthirā bhava \|\| 7.1,25.37

śaktirvisṛjyamānā 'dya tayormṛtyurbhaviṣyati \|\| 7.1,25.37

brāhmaṇābhyarthitā caiva devī girivarātmajā \|\| 7.1,25.38

tvakkośaṁ sahasotsṛjya gaurī sā samajāyata \|\| 7.1,25.38

sā tvakkośātmanotsṛṣṭā kauśikī nāma nāmataḥ \|\| 7.1,25.39

kālī kālāmbudaprakhyā kanyakā samapadyata \|\| 7.1,25.39

sā tu māyātmikā śaktiryoganidrā ca vaiṣṇavī \|\| 7.1,25.40

śaṁkhacakratriśūlādisāyudhāṣṭamahābhujā \|\| 7.1,25.40

saumyā ghorā ca miśrā ca trinetrā candraśekharā \|\| 7.1,25.41

ajātapuṁsparśaratiradhṛṣyā cātisundarī \|\| 7.1,25.41

dattā ca brahmaṇe devyā śaktireṣā sanātanī \|\| 7.1,25.42

niśuṁbhasya ca śuṁbhasya nihaṁtrī daityasiṁhayoḥ \|\| 7.1,25.42

brahmaṇāpi prahṛṣṭena tasyai paramaśaktaye \|\| 7.1,25.43

prabalaḥ kesarī datto vāhanatve samāgataḥ \|\| 7.1,25.43

vindhye ca vasatiṁ tasyāḥ pūjāmāsavapūrvakaiḥ \|\| 7.1,25.44

māṁsairmatsyairapūpaiśca nirvartyāsau samādiśat \|\| 7.1,25.44

sā caiva saṁmatā śaktirbrahmaṇo viśvakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.45

praṇamya mātaraṁ gaurīṁ brahmāṇaṁ cānupūrvaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.45

śaktibhiścāpi tulyābhiḥ svātmajābhiranekaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.46

parītā prayayau vindhyaṁ daityendrau hantumudyatā \|\| 7.1,25.46

nihatau ca tayā tatra samare daityapuṁgavau \|\| 7.1,25.47

tadbāṇaiḥ kāmabāṇaiśca cchinnabhinnāṁgamānasau \|\| 7.1,25.47

tadyuddhavistaraścātra na kṛto 'nyatra varṇanāt \|\| 7.1,25.48

ūhanīyaṁ parasmācca prastutaṁ varṇayāmi vaḥ \|\| 7.1,25.48

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe devīgauratvabhavanaṁ nāma pañcaviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 26

vāyuruvāca

utpādya kauśikīṁ gaurī brahmaṇe pratipādya tām \|\| 7.1,26.1

tasya pratyupakārāya pitāmahamathābravīt \|\| 7.1,26.1

devyuvāca

dṛṣṭaḥ kimeṣa bhavatā śārdūlo madupāśrayaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.2

anena duṣṭasattvebhyo rakṣitaṁ mattapovanam \|\| 7.1,26.2

mayyarpitamanā eṣa bhajate māmananyadhīḥ \|\| 7.1,26.3

asya saṁrakṣaṇādanyatpriyaṁ mama na vidyate \|\| 7.1,26.3

bhavitavyamanenāto mamāntaḥpuracāriṇā \|\| 7.1,26.4

gaṇeśvarapadaṁ cāsmai prītyā dāsyati śaṁkaraḥ \|\| 7.1,26.4

enamagresaraṁ kṛtvā sakhībhirgantumutsahe \|\| 7.1,26.5

pradīyatāmanujñā me prajānāṁ patinā 1 tvayā \|\| 7.1,26.5

1 dhitvamārṣam

531

ityuktaḥ prahasanbrahmā devīmmugdhāmiva smayan \|\| 7.1,26.6

tasya tīvraiḥ purāvṛttairdaurātmyaṁ samavarṇayat1 \|\| 7.1,26.6

brahmovāca

paśau devi mṛgāḥ krūrāḥ kva ca te 'nugrahaḥ śubhaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.7

āśīviṣamukhe sākṣādamṛtaṁ kiṁ niṣicyate \|\| 7.1,26.7

vyāghramātreṇa sanneṣa duṣṭaḥ ko 'pi niśācaraḥ \|\| 7.1,26.8

anena bhakṣitā gāvo brāhmaṇāśca tapodhanāḥ \|\| 7.1,26.8

tarpayaṁstānyathākāmaṁ kāmarūpī caratyasau \|\| 7.1,26.9

avaśyaṁ khalu bhoktavyaṁ phalaṁ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.9

ataḥ kiṁ kṛpayā kṛtyamīdṛśeṣu durātmasu \|\| 7.1,26.10

anena devyāḥ kiṁ kṛtyaṁ prakṛtyā kaluṣātmanā \|\| 7.1,26.10

devyuvāca

yaduktaṁ bhavatā sarvaṁ tathyamastvayamīdṛśaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.11

tathāpi māṁ prapanno 'bhūnna tyājyo māmupāśritaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.11

brahmovāca

asya bhaktimavijñāya prāgvṛttaṁ te niveditam \|\| 7.1,26.12

bhaktiścedasya kiṁ pāpairna te bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati \|\| 7.1,26.12

puṇyakarmāpi kiṁ kuryāttvadīyājñānapekṣayā \|\| 7.1,26.13

ajā prajñā purāṇī ca tvameva parameśvarī \|\| 7.1,26.13

tvadadhīnā hi sarveṣāṁ baṁdhamokṣavyavasthitiḥ \|\| 7.1,26.14

tvadṛte paramā śaktiḥ saṁsiddhiḥ kasya karmaṇā \|\| 7.1,26.14

tvameva vividhā śaktiḥ bhavānāmatha vā svayam \|\| 7.1,26.15

aśaktaḥ karmakaraṇe kartā vā kiṁ kariṣyati \|\| 7.1,26.15

viṣṇośca mama cānyeṣāṁ devadānavarakṣasām \|\| 7.1,26.16

tattadaiśvaryasamprāptyai tavaivājñā hi kāraṇam \|\| 7.1,26.16

atītāḥ khalvasaṁkhyātā brahmāṇo harayo bhavāḥ \|\| 7.1,26.17

anāgatāstvasaṁkhyātāstvadājñānuvidhāyinaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.17

tvāmanārādhya deveśi puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam \|\| 7.1,26.18

labdhuṁ na śakyamasmābhirapi sarvaiḥ surottamaiḥ \|\| 7.1,26.18

vyatyāso 'pi bhavetsadyo brahmatvasthāvaratvayoḥ \|\| 7.1,26.19

sukṛtaṁ duṣkṛtaṁ cāpi tvayeva sthāpitaṁ yataḥ \|\| 7.1,26.19

tvaṁ hi sarvajagadbhartuśśivasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.20

anādimadhyanidhanā śaktirādyā sanātanī \|\| 7.1,26.20

samastalokayātrārthaṁ mūrtimāviśya kāmapi \|\| 7.1,26.21

krīḍase 2 vividhairbhāvaiḥ kastvāṁ jānāti tattvataḥ \|\| 7.1,26.21

ato duṣkṛtakarmāpi vyāghro 'yaṁ tvadanugrahāt \|\| 7.1,26.22

prāpnotu paramāṁ siddhimatra kaḥ pratibandhakaḥ \|\| 7.1,26.22

ityātmanaḥ paraṁ bhāvaṁ smārayitvānurūpataḥ \|\| 7.1,26.23

brahmaṇābhyarthitā gaurī tapaso 'pi nyavartata \|\| 7.1,26.23

tato devīmanujñāpya brahmaṇyantarhite sati \|\| 7.1,26.24

devīṁ ca mātaraṁ dṛṣṭvā menāṁ himavatā saha \|\| 7.1,26.24

531

## adhyāya 27

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ

kṛtvā gauraṁ vapurdivyaṁ devī girivarātmajā \|\| 7.1,27.1

kathaṁ dadarśa bhartāraṁ praviṣṭā manditaṁ satī \|\| 7.1,27.1

praveśasamaye tasyā bhavanadvāragocaraiḥ \|\| 7.1,27.2

gaṇeśaiḥ kiṁ kṛtaṁ devastāndṛṣṭvā kintadā 'karot \|\| 7.1,27.2

vāyuruvāca

pravaktumaṁjasā 'śakyaḥ tādṛśaḥ paramo rasaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.3

yena praṇayagarbheṇa bhāvo bhāvavatāṁ hṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.3

dvāsthaissasaṁbhramaireva devo devyāgamotsukaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.4

śaṁkamānā praviṣṭāntastañca sā samapaśyata \|\| 7.1,27.4

taistaiḥ praṇayabhāvaiśca bhavanāntaravartibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,27.5

gaṇendrairvanditā vācā praṇanāma triyambakam \|\| 7.1,27.5

praṇamya notthitā yāvattāvattāṁ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,27.6

pragṛhya dorbhyāmāśliṣya paritaḥ parayā mudā \|\| 7.1,27.6

svāṁke dhartuṁ pravṛtto 'pi sā paryaṁke nyaṣīdata \|\| 7.1,27.7

paryaṁkato balāddevīṁ soṅkamāropya susmitām \|\| 7.1,27.7

sasmito vivṛtairnetraistadvaktraṁ prapibanniva \|\| 7.1,27.8

tayā saṁbhāṣaṇāyeśaḥ pūrvabhāṣitamabravīt \|\| 7.1,27.8

devadeva uvāca

sā daśā ca vyatītā kiṁ tava sarvāṁgasundari \|\| 7.1,27.9

yasyāmanunayopāyaḥ ko 'pi kopānna labhyate \|\| 7.1,27.9

svecchayāpi na kālīti nānyavarṇavatīti ca \|\| 7.1,27.10

tvatsvabhāvāhṛtaṁ cittaṁ subhru ciṁtāvahaṁ mama \|\| 7.1,27.10

vismṛtaḥ paramo bhāvaḥ kathaṁ svecchāṁgayogataḥ \|\| 7.1,27.11

na sambhavanti ye tatra cittakāluṣyahetavaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.11

pṛthagjanavadanyonyaṁ vipriyasyāpi kāraṇam \|\| 7.1,27.12

āvayorapi yadyasti nāstyevaitaccarācaram \|\| 7.1,27.12

ahamagniśironiṣṭhastvaṁ somaśirasi sthitā \|\| 7.1,27.13

agnīṣomātmakaṁ viśvamāvābhyāṁ samadhiṣṭhitam \|\| 7.1,27.13

jagaddhitāya caratoḥ svecchādhṛtaśarīrayoḥ \|\| 7.1,27.14

āvayorviprayoge hi syānnirālambanaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,27.14

asti hetvantaraṁ cātra śāstrayuktiviniścitam \|\| 7.1,27.15

vāgarthamiva me vaitajjagatsthāvarajaṁgamam \|\| 7.1,27.15

tvaṁ hi vāgamṛtaṁ sākṣādahamarthāmṛtaṁ param \|\| 7.1,27.16

dvayamapyamṛtaṁ kasmādviyuktamupapadyate \|\| 7.1,27.16

532

vidyāpratyāyikā tvaṁ me vedyo 'haṁ pratyayāttava \|\| 7.1,27.17

vidyāvedyātmanoreva viśleṣaḥ kathamāvayoḥ \|\| 7.1,27.17

na karmaṇā sṛjāmīdaṁ jagatpratisṛjāmi ca \|\| 7.1,27.18

sarvasyājñaikalabhyatvādājñātvaṁ hi garīyasī \|\| 7.1,27.18

ājñaikasāramaiśvaryaṁ yasmātsvātaṁtryalakṣaṇam \|\| 7.1,27.19

ājñayā viprayuktasya caiśvaryaṁ mama kīdṛśam \|\| 7.1,27.19

na kadācidavasthānamāvayorviprayuktayoḥ \|\| 7.1,27.20

devānāṁ kāryamuddiśya līloktiṁ kṛtavānaham \|\| 7.1,27.20

tvayāpyaviditaṁ nāsti kathaṁ kupitavatyasi \|\| 7.1,27.21

tatastrilokarakṣārthe kopo mayyapi te kṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.21

yadanarthāya bhūtānāṁ na tadasti khalu tvayi \|\| 7.1,27.22

iti priyaṁvade sākṣādīśvare parameśvare \|\| 7.1,27.22

śṛṁgārabhāvasārāṇāṁ janmabhūmirakṛtrimā \|\| 7.1,27.23

svabhartrā lalitantathyamuktaṁ matvā smitottaram \|\| 7.1,27.23

lajjayā na kimapyūce kauśikī varṇanātparam \|\| 7.1,27.24

tadeva varṇayāmyadya śṛṇu devyāśca varṇanam \|\| 7.1,27.24

devyuvāca

kiṁ devena na sā dṛṣṭā yā sṛṣṭā kauśikī mayā \|\| 7.1,27.25

tādṛśī kanyakā loke na bhūtā na bhaviṣyati \|\| 7.1,27.25

tasyā vīryaṁ balaṁ vindhyanilayaṁ vijayaṁ tathā \|\| 7.1,27.26

śuṁbhasya ca niśuṁbhasya māraṇe ca raṇe tayoḥ \|\| 7.1,27.26

pratyakṣaphaladānaṁ ca lokāya bhajate sadā \|\| 7.1,27.27

lokānāṁ rakṣaṇaṁ śaśvadbrahmā vijñāpayiṣyati \|\| 7.1,27.27

iti saṁbhāṣamāṇāyā devyā evājñayā tadā \|\| 7.1,27.28

vyāghraḥ sakhyā samānīya puro 'vasthāpitastadā \|\| 7.1,27.28

taṁ prekṣyāha punardevī devānītamupāyatam \|\| 7.1,27.29

vyāghraṁ paśya na cānena sadṛśo madupāsakaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.29

anena duṣṭasaṁghebhyo rakṣitaṁ mattapovanam \|\| 7.1,27.30

atīva mama bhaktaśca viśrabdhaśca svarakṣaṇāt \|\| 7.1,27.30

svadeśaṁ ca parityajya prasādārthaṁ samāgataḥ \|\| 7.1,27.31

yadi prītirabhūnmattaḥ parāṁ prītiṁ karoṣi me \|\| 7.1,27.31

nityamantaḥpuradvāri niyogānnandinaḥ svayam \|\| 7.1,27.32

rakṣibhissaha taccihnairvartatāmayamīśvara \|\| 7.1,27.32

vāyuruvāca

madhuraṁ praṇayodarkaṁ śrutvā devyāḥ śubhaṁ vacaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.33

prīto 'smītyāha taṁ devassa cādṛśyata tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 7.1,27.33

bibhradvetralatāṁ haimīṁ ratnacitraṁ ca kaṁcukam \|\| 7.1,27.34

churikāmuragaprakhyāṁ gaṇeśo rakṣaveṣadhṛk \|\| 7.1,27.34

yasmātsomo mahādevo nandī cānena nanditaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.35

somanandīti vikhyātastasmādeṣa samākhyayā \|\| 7.1,27.35

itthaṁ devyāḥ priyaṁ kṛtvā devaścardhendubhūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.36

bhūṣayāmāsa tandivyairbhūṣaṇai ratnabhūṣitaiḥ \|\| 7.1,27.36

tatassa gaurīṁ giriśo girīndrajāṁ sagauravāṁ sarvamanoharāṁ haraḥ \|\| 7.1,27.37

paryaṁkamāropya varāṁgabhūṣaṇairvibhūṣayāmāsa śaśāṁkabhūṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,27.37

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe saptaviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 28

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ

devīṁ samādadhānena devenedaṁ kimīritam \|\| 7.1,28.1

agniṣomātmakaṁ viśvaṁ vāgarthātmakamityapi \|\| 7.1,28.1

ājñaikasāramaiśvaryamājñā tvamiti coditam \|\| 7.1,28.2

tadidaṁ śrotumicchāmo yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.2

vāyuruvāca

agnirityucyate raudrī ghorā yā taijasī tanuḥ \|\| 7.1,28.3

somaḥ śākto 'mṛtamayaḥ śakteḥ śāntikarī tanuḥ \|\| 7.1,28.3

amṛtaṁ yatpratiṣṭhā sā tejo vidyā kalā svayam \|\| 7.1,28.4

bhūtasūkṣmeṣu sarveṣu ta eva rasatejasī \|\| 7.1,28.4

dvividhā tejaso vṛttisūryātmā cānalātmikā \|\| 7.1,28.5

tathaiva rasavṛttiśca somātmā ca jalātmikā \|\| 7.1,28.5

vidyudādimayantejo madhurādimayo rasaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.6

tejorasavibhedaistu dhṛtametaccarācaram \|\| 7.1,28.6

agneramṛtaniṣpattiramṛtenāgniredhate \|\| 7.1,28.7

ata eva hi vikrāntamagnīṣomaṁ jagaddhitam \|\| 7.1,28.7

haviṣe sasyasampattirvṛṣṭiḥ sasyābhivṛddhaye \|\| 7.1,28.8

vṛṣṭereva havistasmādagnīṣomadhṛtaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,28.8

agnirūrdhvaṁ jvalatyeṣa yāvatsaumyaṁ parāmṛtam \|\| 7.1,28.9

yāvadagnyāspadaṁ saumyamamṛtaṁ ca sravatyadhaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.9

ata eva hi kālāgniradhastācchaktirūrdhvataḥ \|\| 7.1,28.10

yāvadādahanaṁ cordhvamadhaścāplāvanaṁ bhavet \|\| 7.1,28.10

ādhāraśaktyaiva dhṛtaḥ kālāgnirayamūrdhvagaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.11

tathaiva nimnagaḥ somaśśivaśaktipadāspadaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.11

śivaścordhvamadhaśśaktirūrdhvaṁ śaktiradhaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.12

taditthaṁ śivaśaktibhyānnāvyāptamiha kiñcana \|\| 7.1,28.12

asakṛccāgninā dagdhaṁ jagadyadbhasmasātkṛtam \|\| 7.1,28.13

agnervīryamidaṁ cāhustadvīryaṁ bhasma yattataḥ \|\| 7.1,28.13

yaścetthaṁ bhasmasadbhāvaṁ jñātvā snāti ca bhasmanā \|\| 7.1,28.14

agnirityādibhirmantrairbaddhaḥ pāśātpramucyate \|\| 7.1,28.14

agnervīryaṁ tu yadbhasma somenāplāvitampunaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.15

ayogayuktyā prakṛteradhikārāya kalpate \|\| 7.1,28.15

yogayuktyā tu tadbhasma plāvyamānaṁ samantataḥ \|\| 7.1,28.16

śāktenāmṛtavarṣeṇa cādhikārānnivartayet \|\| 7.1,28.16

ato mṛtyuṁjayāyetthamamṛtaplāvanaṁ sadā \|\| 7.1,28.17

śivaśaktyamṛtasparśe labdhaṁ yena kuto mṛtiḥ \|\| 7.1,28.17

yo veda dahanaṁ guhyaṁ plāvanaṁ ca yathoditam \|\| 7.1,28.18

agnīṣomapadaṁ hitvā na sa bhūyo 'bhijāyate \|\| 7.1,28.18

śivāgninā tanuṁ dagdhvā śaktisaumyā mṛtena yaḥ \|\| 7.1,28.19

plāvayedyogamārgeṇa so 'mṛtatvāya kalpate \|\| 7.1,28.19

hṛdi kṛtvemamarthaṁ vai devena samudāhṛtam \|\| 7.1,28.20

agnīṣomātmakaṁ viśvaṁ jagadityanurūpataḥ \|\| 7.1,28.20

533

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe bhasmatattvavarṇanaṁ nāmāṣṭāviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 29

vāyuruvāca

nivedayāmi jagato vāgarthātmyaṁ kṛtaṁ yathā \|\| 7.1,29.1

ṣaḍadhvavedanaṁ samyaksamāsānna tu vistarāt \|\| 7.1,29.1

nāsti kaścidaśabdārtho nāpi śabdo nirarthakaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.2

tato hi samaye śabdassarvassarvārthabodhakaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.2

prakṛteḥ pariṇāmo 'yaṁ dvidhā śabdārthabhāvanā \|\| 7.1,29.3

tāmāhuḥ prākṛtīṁ mūrtiṁ śivayoḥ paramātmanoḥ \|\| 7.1,29.3

śabdātmikā vibhūtiryā sā tridhā kathyate budhaiḥ \|\| 7.1,29.4

sthūlā sūkṣmā parā ceti sthūlā yā śrutigocarā \|\| 7.1,29.4

sūkṣmā cintāmayī proktā ciṁtayā rahitā parā \|\| 7.1,29.5

yā śaktiḥ sā parā śaktiśśivatattvasamāśrayā \|\| 7.1,29.5

jñānaśaktisamāyogādicchopodbalikā tathā \|\| 7.1,29.6

sarvaśaktisamaṣṭyātmā śaktitattvasamākhyayā \|\| 7.1,29.6

samastakāryajātasya mūlaprakṛtitāṁ gatā \|\| 7.1,29.7

saiva kuṇḍalinī māyā śuddhādhvaparamā satī \|\| 7.1,29.7

sā vibhāgasvarūpaiva ṣaḍadhvātmā vijṛṁbhate \|\| 7.1,29.8

tatra śabdāstrayo 'dhvānastrayaścārthāḥ samīritāḥ \|\| 7.1,29.8

sarveṣāmapi vai puṁsāṁ naijaśuddhyanurūpataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.9

layabhogādhikārāssyussarvatattvavibhāgataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.9

kalābhistāni tattvāni vyāptānyeva yathātatham \|\| 7.1,29.10

parasyāḥ prakṛterādau pañcadhā pariṇāmataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.10

kalāśca tā nivṛttyādyāḥ paryāptā iti niścayaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.11

maṁtrādhvā ca padādhvā ca varṇādhvā ceti śabdataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.11

bhuvanādhvā ca tattvādhvā kalādhvā cārthataḥ kramāt \|\| 7.1,29.12

atrānyonyaṁ ca sarveṣāṁ vyāpyavyāpakatocyate \|\| 7.1,29.12

maṁtrāḥ sarvaiḥ padairvyāptā vākyabhāvātpadāni ca \|\| 7.1,29.13

varṇairvarṇasamūhaṁ hi padamāhurvipaścitaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.13

varṇāstu bhuvanairvyāptāsteṣāṁ teṣūpalaṁbhanāt \|\| 7.1,29.14

bhuvanānyapi tattvaughairutpattyāṁtarbahiṣkramāt \|\| 7.1,29.14

vyāptāni kāraṇaistattvairārabdhatvādanekaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.15

aṁtarādutthitānīha bhuvanāni tu kānicit \|\| 7.1,29.15

paurāṇikāni cānyāni vijñeyāni śivāgame \|\| 7.1,29.16

sāṁkhyayogaprasiddhāni tattvānyapi ca kānicit \|\| 7.1,29.16

śivaśāstraprasiddhāni tatonyānyapi kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.17

kalābhistāni tattvāni vyāptānyeva yathātatham \|\| 7.1,29.17

parasyāḥ prakṛterādau pañcadhā pariṇāmataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.18

kalāśca tā nivṛttyādyā vyāptāḥ pañca yathottaram \|\| 7.1,29.18

vyāpikātaḥ parā śaktiravibhaktā ṣaḍadhvanām \|\| 7.1,29.19

paraprakṛtibhāvasya tatsattvācchivatattvataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.19

śaktyādi ca pṛthivyantaṁ śivatattvasamudbhavam \|\| 7.1,29.20

vyāptamekena tenaiva mṛdā kuṁbhādikaṁ yathā \|\| 7.1,29.20

śaivaṁ tatparamaṁ dhāma yatprāpyaṁ ṣaḍbhiradhvabhiḥ \|\| 7.1,29.21

533

vyāpikā 'vyāpikā śaktiḥ pañcatattvaviśodhanāt \|\| 7.1,29.21

nivṛttyā rudraparyantaṁ sthitiraṇḍasya śodhyate \|\| 7.1,29.22

pratiṣṭhayā tadūrdhvaṁ tu yāvadavyaktagocaram \|\| 7.1,29.22

tadūrdhvaṁ vidyayā madhye yāvadviśveśvarāvadhi \|\| 7.1,29.23

śāntyā tadūrdhvaṁ madhvānte viśuddhiḥ śāntyatītayā \|\| 7.1,29.23

yāmāhuḥ paramaṁ vyoma paraprakṛtiyogataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.24

etāni pañcatattvāni yairvyāptamakhilaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,29.24

tatraiva sarvamevedaṁ draṣṭavyaṁ khalu sādhakaiḥ \|\| 7.1,29.25

adhvavyāptimavijñāya śuddhiṁ yaḥ kartumicchati \|\| 7.1,29.25

sa vipralambhakaḥ śuddhernālamprāpayituṁ phalam \|\| 7.1,29.26

vṛthā pariśramastasya nirayāyaiva kevalam \|\| 7.1,29.26

śaktipātasamāyogādṛte tattvāni tattvataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.27

tadvyāptistadvivṛddhiśca jñātumevaṁ na śakyate \|\| 7.1,29.27

śaktirājñā parā śaivī cidrūpā marameśvarī \|\| 7.1,29.28

śivo 'dhitiṣṭhatyakhilaṁ yayā kāraṇabhūtayā \|\| 7.1,29.28

nātmano naiva māyaiṣā na vikāro vicārataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.29

na baṁdho nāpi muktiśca baṁdhamuktividhāyinī \|\| 7.1,29.29

sarvaiśvaryaparākāṣṭā śivasya vyabhicāriṇī \|\| 7.1,29.30

samānadharmiṇī tasya taistairbhāvairviśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.30

sa tayaiva gṛhī sāpi tenaiva gṛhiṇī sadā \|\| 7.1,29.31

tayorapatyaṁ yatkāryaṁ paraprakṛtijaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,29.31

sa kartā kāraṇaṁ seti tayorbhedo vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.32

eka eva śivaḥ sākṣāddvidhā 'sau samavasthitaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.32

strīpuṁsabhāvena tayorbheda ityapi kecana \|\| 7.1,29.33

apare tu parā śaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī \|\| 7.1,29.33

prabheva bhānościdrūpā bhinnaiveti vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.34

tasmācchivaḥ paro hetustasyājñā parameśvarī \|\| 7.1,29.34

tayaiva preritā śaivī mūlaprakṛtiravyayā \|\| 7.1,29.35

mahāmāyā ca māyā ca prakṛtistriguṇeti ca \|\| 7.1,29.35

trividhā kāryavedhena sā prasūte ṣaḍadhvanaḥ \|\| 7.1,29.36

sa vāgarthamayaścādhvā ṣaḍvidho nikhilaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,29.36

asyaiva vistaraṁ prāhuḥ śāstrajātamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.1,29.37

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe vāgarthakatattvavarṇanaṁ nāmaikonatriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 30

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ

caritāni vicitrāṇi gṛhyāṇi gahanāni ca \|\| 7.1,30.1

durvijñeyāni devaiśca mohayaṁti manāṁsi naḥ \|\| 7.1,30.1

śivayostattvasambandhe na doṣa upalabhyate \|\| 7.1,30.2

caritaiḥ prākṛto bhāvastayorapi vibhāvyate \|\| 7.1,30.2

brahmādayo 'pi lokānāṁ sṛṣṭisthityantahetavaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.3

nigrahānugrahau prāpya śivasya vaśavartinaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.3

śivaḥ punarna kasyāpi nigrahānugrahāspadam \|\| 7.1,30.4

ato 'nāyattamaiśvaryaṁ tasyaiveti viniścitam \|\| 7.1,30.4

534

yadyevamīdṛśaiśvaryaṁ tattu svātantryalakṣaṇam \|\| 7.1,30.5

svabhāvasiddhaṁ caitasya mūrtimattāspadaṁ bhavet \|\| 7.1,30.5

na mūrtiśca svataṁtrasya ghaṭate mūlahetunā \|\| 7.1,30.6

mūrterapi ca kāryatvāttatsiddhiḥ syādahaitukī \|\| 7.1,30.6

sarvatra paramo bhāvo 'paramaścānya ucyate \|\| 7.1,30.7

paramāparamau bhāvau kathamekatra saṁgatau \|\| 7.1,30.7

niṣphalo hi svabhāvo 'sya paramaḥ paramātmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.8

sa eva sakalaḥ kasmātsvabhāvo hyaviparyayaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.8

svabhāvo viparītaścetsvataṁtraḥ svecchayā yadi \|\| 7.1,30.9

na karoti kimīśāno nityānityaviparyayam \|\| 7.1,30.9

mūrtātmā sakalaḥ kaścitsa cānyo niṣphalaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.10

śivenādhiṣṭhitaśceti sarvatra laghu kathyate \|\| 7.1,30.10

mūrtyātmaiva tadā mūrtiḥ śivasyāsya bhavediti \|\| 7.1,30.11

tasya mūrtau mūrtimatoḥ pārataṁtryaṁ hi niścitam \|\| 7.1,30.11

anyathā nirapekṣeṇa mūrtiḥ svīkriyate katham \|\| 7.1,30.12

mūrtisvīkaraṇaṁ tasmānmūrtau sādhyaphalepsayā \|\| 7.1,30.12

na hi svecchāśarīratvaṁ svātaṁtryāyopapadyate \|\| 7.1,30.13

svecchaiva tādṛśī puṁsāṁ yasmātkarmānusāriṇī \|\| 7.1,30.13

svīkartuṁ svecchayā dehaṁ hātuṁ ca prabhavantyuta \|\| 7.1,30.14

brahmādayaḥ piśācāṁtāḥ kiṁ te karmātivartinaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.14

icchayā dehanirmāṇamindrajālopamaṁ viduḥ \|\| 7.1,30.15

aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryavaśīkārānatikramāt \|\| 7.1,30.15

viśvarūpaṁ dadhadviṣṇurdadhīcena maharṣiṇā \|\| 7.1,30.16

yudhyatā samupālabdhastadrūpaṁ dadhatā svayam \|\| 7.1,30.16

sarvasmādadhikasyāpi śivasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.17

śarīravattayānyātmasādharmyaṁ pratibhāti naḥ \|\| 7.1,30.17

sarvānugrāhakaṁ prāhuśśivaṁ paramakāraṇam \|\| 7.1,30.18

sa nirgṛhṇāti devānāṁ sarvānugrāhakaḥ katham \|\| 7.1,30.18

ciccheda bahuśo devo brahmaṇaḥ pañcamaṁ śiraḥ \|\| 7.1,30.19

śivanindāṁ prakurvaṁtaṁ putreti kumaterhaṭhāt \|\| 7.1,30.19

viṣṇorapi nṛsiṁhasya rabhasā śarabhākṛtiḥ \|\| 7.1,30.20

bibheda padbhyāmākramya hṛdayaṁ nakharaiḥ kharaiḥ \|\| 7.1,30.20

devastrīṣu ca deveṣu dakṣasyādhvarakāraṇāt \|\| 7.1,30.21

vīreṇa vīrabhadreṇa na hi kaścidadaṇḍitaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.21

puratrayaṁ ca sastrīkaṁ sadaityaṁ saha bālakaiḥ \|\| 7.1,30.22

kṣaṇenaikena devena netrāgneriṁdhanīkṛtam \|\| 7.1,30.22

prajānāṁ ratihetuśca kāmo ratipatissvayam \|\| 7.1,30.23

krośatāmeva devānāṁ huto netrahutāśane \|\| 7.1,30.23

gāvaśca kaściddugdhaughaṁ sravantyo mūrdhni khecarāḥ \|\| 7.1,30.24

saruṣā prekṣya devena tatkṣaṇe bhasmasātkṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.24

jalaṁdharāsuro dīrṇaścakrīkṛtya jalaṁ padā \|\| 7.1,30.25

baddhvānaṁtena yo viṣṇuṁ cikṣepa śatayojanam \|\| 7.1,30.25

tameva jalasaṁdhāyī śūlenaiva jaghāna saḥ \|\| 7.1,30.26

taccakraṁ tapasā labdhvā labdhavīryo harissadā \|\| 7.1,30.26

534

jighāṁsatāṁ surārīṇāṁ kulaṁ nirghṛṇacetasām \|\| 7.1,30.27

triśūlenāndhakasyoraḥ śikhinaivopatāpitam \|\| 7.1,30.27

kaṇṭhātkālāṁganāṁ sṛṣṭvā dārako 'pi nipātitaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.28

kauśikīṁ janayitvā tu gauryāstvakkośagocarām \|\| 7.1,30.28

śuṁbhassaha niśuṁbhena prāpito maraṇaṁ raṇe \|\| 7.1,30.29

śrutaṁ ca mahadākhyānaṁ skānde skandasamāśrayam \|\| 7.1,30.29

vadhārthe tārakākhyasya daityendrasyendravidviṣaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.30

brahmaṇābhyarthito devo mandarāntaḥpuraṁ gataḥ \|\| 7.1,30.30

vihṛtya suciraṁ devyā vihārā 'tiprasaṅgataḥ \|\| 7.1,30.31

rasāṁ rasātalaṁ nītāmiva kṛtvābhidhāṁ tataḥ \|\| 7.1,30.31

devīṁ ca vaṁcayaṁstasyāṁ svavīryamatidurvaham \|\| 7.1,30.32

avisṛjya visṛjyāgnau haviḥ pūtamivāmṛtam \|\| 7.1,30.32

gaṁgādiṣvapi nikṣipya vahnidvārā tadaṁśataḥ \|\| 7.1,30.33

tatsamāhṛtya śanakaistokaṁstokamitastataḥ \|\| 7.1,30.33

svāhayā kṛttikārūpātsvabhartrā ramamāṇayā \|\| 7.1,30.34

suvarṇībhūtayā nyastaṁ merau śaravaṇe kvacit \|\| 7.1,30.34

saṁdīpayitvā kālena tasya bhāsā diśo daśa \|\| 7.1,30.35

rañjayitvā girīnsarvānkāṁcanīkṛtya meruṇā \|\| 7.1,30.35

tataścireṇa kālena saṁjāte tatra tejasi \|\| 7.1,30.36

kumāre sukumārāṁge kumārāṇāṁ nidarśane \|\| 7.1,30.36

tacchaiśavaṁ svarūpaṁ ca tasya dṛṣṭvā manoharam \|\| 7.1,30.37

saha devasurairlokairvismite ca vimohite \|\| 7.1,30.37

devo 'pi svayamāyātaḥ putradarśanalālasaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.38

saha devyāṁkamāropya tato 'sya smeramānanam \|\| 7.1,30.38

pītāmṛtamiva snehavivaśenāntarātmanā \|\| 7.1,30.39

deveṣvapi ca paśyatsu vītarāgaistapasvibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,30.39

svasya vakṣaḥsthale svairaṁ nartayitvā kumārakam \|\| 7.1,30.40

anubhūya ca tatkrīḍāṁ saṁbhāvya ca parasparam \|\| 7.1,30.40

stanyamājñāpayandevyāḥ pāyayitvāmṛtopamam \|\| 7.1,30.41

tavāvatāro jagatāṁ hitāyetyanuśāsya ca \|\| 7.1,30.41

svayandevaśca devī ca na tṛptimupajagmatuḥ \|\| 7.1,30.42

tataḥ śakreṇa saṁdhāya bibhyatā tārakāsurāt \|\| 7.1,30.42

kārayitvābhiṣekaṁ ca senāpatye divaukasām \|\| 7.1,30.43

putramantarataḥ kṛtvā devena tripuradviṣā \|\| 7.1,30.43

svayamaṁtarhitenaiva skandamindrādirakṣitam \|\| 7.1,30.44

tacchaktyā krauñcabhedinyā yudhi kālāgnikalpayā \|\| 7.1,30.44

cheditaṁ tārakasyāpi śiraśśakrabhiyā saha \|\| 7.1,30.45

stutiṁ cakrurviśeṣeṇa haridhātṛmukhāḥ surāḥ \|\| 7.1,30.45

tathā rakṣodhipaḥ sākṣādrāvaṇo balagarvitaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.46

uddharansvabhujairdīrghaiḥ kailāsaṁ girimātmanaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.46

tadāgo 'sahamānasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.47

padāṁguṣṭhaparispandānmamajja mṛdito bhuvi \|\| 7.1,30.47

baṭoḥ kenacidarthena svāśritasya gatāyuṣaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.48

535

tvarayāgatya devena pādāṁtaṁ gamitontakaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.48

svavāhanamavijñāya vṛṣendraṁ vaḍavānalaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.49

sagalagrahamānītastato 'styekodakaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,30.49

alokaviditaistaistairvṛttairānandasundaraiḥ \|\| 7.1,30.50

aṁgahārasvasenedamasakṛccālitaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,30.50

śānta eva sadā sarvamanugṛhṇāti cecchivaḥ \|\| 7.1,30.51

sarvāṇi pūrayedeva kathaṁ śaktena mocayet \|\| 7.1,30.51

anādikarma vaicitryamapi nātra niyāmakam \|\| 7.1,30.52

kāraṇaṁ khalu karmāpi bhavedīśvarakāritam \|\| 7.1,30.52

kimatra bahunoktena nāstikyaṁ hetukārakam \|\| 7.1,30.53

yathā hyāśu nivarteta tathā kathaya māruta \|\| 7.1,30.53

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe śivatattvapraśno nāma triṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 31

vāyuruvāca

sthane saṁśayitaṁ viprā bhavadbhirhetucoditaiḥ \|\| 7.1,31.1

jijñāsā hi na nāstikyaṁ sādhayetsādhubuddhiṣu \|\| 7.1,31.1

pramaṇamatra vakṣyāmi satāmmohanivartakam \|\| 7.1,31.2

asatāṁ tvanyathābhāvaḥ prasādena vinā prabhoḥ \|\| 7.1,31.2

śivasya paripūrṇasya parānugrahamantarā \|\| 7.1,31.3

na kiṁcidapi kartavyamiti sādhu viniścitam \|\| 7.1,31.3

svabhāva eva paryāptaḥ parānugrahakarmaṇi \|\| 7.1,31.4

anyathā nissvabhavena na kimapyanugṛhyate \|\| 7.1,31.4

paraṁ sarvamanugrāhyaṁ paśupāśātmakaṁ jagat \|\| 7.1,31.5

parasyānugrahārthaṁ tu patyurājñāsamanvayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.5

patirājñāpakaḥ sarvamanugṛhṇāti sarvadā \|\| 7.1,31.6

tadarthamarthasvīkāre parataṁtraḥ kathaṁ śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.6

anugrāhyanapekṣo 'sti na hi kaścidanugrahaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.7

ataḥ svātantryaśabdārthānanapekṣatvalakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.7

etatpunaranugrāhyaṁ parataṁtraṁ tadiṣyate \|\| 7.1,31.8

anugrahādṛte tasya bhuktimuktyorananvayāt \|\| 7.1,31.8

mūrtātmano 'pyanugrāhyā śivājñānanivartanāt \|\| 7.1,31.9

ajñānādhiṣṭhitaṁ śambhorna kiṁcidiha vidyate \|\| 7.1,31.9

yenopalabhyate 'smābhissakalenāpi niṣkalaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.10

sa mūrtyātmā śivaḥ śaivamūrtirityupacaryate \|\| 7.1,31.10

na hyasau niṣkalaḥ sākṣācchivaḥ paramakāraṇam \|\| 7.1,31.11

sākāreṇānubhāvena kenāpyanupalakṣitaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.11

pramāṇagamyatāmātraṁ tatsvabhāvopapādakam \|\| 7.1,31.12

na tāvatātropekṣādhīrupalakṣaṇamaṁtarā \|\| 7.1,31.12

ātmopamolvaṇaṁ sākṣānmūrtireva hi kācana \|\| 7.1,31.13

śivasya mūrtirmūrtyātmā parastasyopalakṣaṇam \|\| 7.1,31.13

yathā kāṣṭheṣvanārūḍho na vahnirupalabhyate \|\| 7.1,31.14

evaṁ śivo 'pi mūrtyātmanyanārūḍha iti sthitiḥ \|\| 7.1,31.14

yathāgnimānayetyukte jvalatkāṣṭhādṛte svayam \|\| 7.1,31.15

nāgnirānīyate tadvatpūjyo mūrtyātmanā śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.15

ata eva hi pūjādau mūrtyātmaparikalpanam \|\| 7.1,31.16

mūrtyātmani kṛtaṁ sākṣācchiva eva kṛtaṁ yataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.16

liṁgādāvapi tatkṛtyamarcāyāṁ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.17

tattanmūrtyātmabhāvena śivo 'smābhirupāsyate \|\| 7.1,31.17

yathānugṛhyate so 'pi mūrtyātmā pārameṣṭhinā \|\| 7.1,31.18

tathā mūrtyātmaniṣṭhena śivena paśavo vayam \|\| 7.1,31.18

lokānugrahaṇāyaiva śivena parameṣṭhinā \|\| 7.1,31.19

sadāśivādayassarve mūrtyātmano 'pyadhiṣṭhitāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.19

ātmanāmeva bhogāya mokṣāya ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.20

tattvātattvasvarūpeṣu mūrtyātmasu śivānvayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.20

bhogaḥ karmavipākātmā sukhaduḥkhātmako mataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.21

na ca karma śivo 'stīti tasya bhogaḥ kimātmakaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.21

sarvaṁ śivo 'nugṛhṇāti na nigṛhṇāti kiṁcana \|\| 7.1,31.22

nigṛhṇatāṁ tu ye doṣāśśive teṣāmasaṁbhavāt \|\| 7.1,31.22

ye punarnigrahāḥ kecidbrahmādiṣu nidarśitāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.23

te 'pi lokahitāyaiva kṛtāḥ śrīkaṇṭhamūrtinā \|\| 7.1,31.23

brahmāṇḍasyādhipatyaṁ hi śrīkaṇṭhasya na saṁśayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.24

śrīkaṇṭhākhyāṁ śivo mūrtiṁ krīḍatīmadhitiṣṭhati \|\| 7.1,31.24

sadoṣā eva devādyā nigṛhītā yathoditam \|\| 7.1,31.25

tatastepi vipāpmānaḥ prajāścāpi gatajvarāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.25

nigraho 'pi svarūpeṇa viduṣāṁ na jugupsitaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.26

ata eva hi daṇḍyeṣu daṇḍo rājñāṁ praśasyate \|\| 7.1,31.26

yatsiddhirīśvaratvena kāryavargasya kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.27

na sa cedīśatāṁ kuryājjagataḥ kathamīśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,31.27

īśecchā ca vidhātṛtvaṁ vidherājñāpanaṁ param \|\| 7.1,31.28

ājñāvaśyamidaṁ kuryānna kuryāditi śāsanam \|\| 7.1,31.28

tacchāsanānuvartitvaṁ sādhubhāvasya lakṣaṇam \|\| 7.1,31.29

viparītasamādhoḥ syānna sarvaṁ tattu dṛśyate \|\| 7.1,31.29

sādhu saṁrakṣaṇīyaṁ cedvinivartyamasādhu yat \|\| 7.1,31.30

nivartate ca sāmāderaṁte daṇḍo hi sādhanam \|\| 7.1,31.30

hitārthalakṣaṇaṁ cedaṁ daṇḍāntamanuśāsanam \|\| 7.1,31.31

ato yadviparītaṁ tadahitaṁ saṁpracakṣate \|\| 7.1,31.31

hite sadā niṣaṇṇānāmīśvarasya nidarśanam \|\| 7.1,31.32

sa kathaṁ duṣyate sadbhirasatāmeva nigrahāt \|\| 7.1,31.32

ayuktakāriṇo loke garhaṇīyāvivekitā \|\| 7.1,31.33

yadudvejayate lokantadayuktaṁ pracakṣate \|\| 7.1,31.33

sarvo 'pi nigraho loke na ca vidveṣapūrvakaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.34

na hi dveṣṭi pitā putraṁ yo nigṛhyāti śikṣayet \|\| 7.1,31.34

mādhyasthenāpi nigrāhyānyo nigṛhṇāti mārgataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.35

tasyāpyavaśyaṁ yatkiṁcinnairghṛṇyamanuvartate \|\| 7.1,31.35

anyathā na hinastyeva sadoṣānapyasau parān \|\| 7.1,31.36

hinasti cāyamapyajñānparaṁ mādhyasthyamācaran \|\| 7.1,31.36

tasmādduḥkhātmikāṁ hiṁsāṁ kurvāṇo yaḥ sanirghṛṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.37

536

iti nirbaṁdhayaṁtyeke niyamo neti cāpare \|\| 7.1,31.37

nidānajñasya bhiṣajo rugṇo hiṁsāṁ prayuṁjataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.38

na kiṁcidapi nairghṛṇyaṁ ghṛṇaivātra prayojikā \|\| 7.1,31.38

ghṛṇāpi na guṇāyaiva hiṁsreṣu pratiyogiṣu \|\| 7.1,31.39

tādṛśeṣu ghṛṇī bhrāntyā ghṛṇāntaritanirghṛṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.39

upekṣāpīha doṣāha rakṣyeṣu pratiyogiṣu \|\| 7.1,31.40

śaktau satyāmupekṣāto rakṣyassadyo vipadyate \|\| 7.1,31.40

sarpasyā"syagatampaśyanyastu rakṣyamupekṣate \|\| 7.1,31.41

doṣābhāsānsamutprekṣya phalataḥ so 'pi nirghṛṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.41

tasmādghṛṇā guṇāyaiva sarvatheti na saṁmatam \|\| 7.1,31.42

saṁmataṁ prāptakāmitvaṁ sarvaṁ tvanyadasammatam \|\| 7.1,31.42

mūrtyātmasvapi rāgādyā doṣāḥ santyeva vastutaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.43

tathāpi teṣāmevaite na śivasya tu sarvathā \|\| 7.1,31.43

agnāvapi samāviṣṭaṁ tāmraṁ khalu sakālikam \|\| 7.1,31.43

iti nāgnirasau duṣyettāmrasaṁsargakāraṇāt \|\| 7.1,31.44

nāgneraśucisaṁsargādaśucitvamapekṣate \|\| 7.1,31.44

aśucestvagnisaṁyogācchucitvamapi jāyate \|\| 7.1,31.45

evaṁ śodhyātmasaṁsargānna hyaśuddhaḥ śivo bhavet \|\| 7.1,31.45

śivasaṁsargatastveṣa śodhyātmaiva hi śudhyati \|\| 7.1,31.46

ayasyagnau samāviṣṭe dāho 'gnereva nāyasaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.46

mūrtātmanyevamaiśvaryamīśvarasyaiva nātmanām \|\| 7.1,31.47

na hi kāṣṭhaṁ jvalatyūrdhvamagnireva jvalatyasau \|\| 7.1,31.47

kāṣṭhasyāṁgāratā nāgnerevamatrāpi yojyatām \|\| 7.1,31.48

ata eva jagatyasminkāṣṭhapāṣāṇamṛtsvapi \|\| 7.1,31.48

śivāveśavaśādeva śivatvamupacaryate \|\| 7.1,31.49

maitryādayo guṇā gauṇāstasmātte bhinnavṛttayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.49

tairguṇairuparaktānāṁ doṣāya ca guṇāya ca \|\| 7.1,31.50

yattu gauṇamagauṇaṁ ca tatsarvamanugṛhṇataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.50

na guṇāya na doṣāya śivasya guṇavṛttayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.50

na cānugrahaśabdārthaṁ gauṇamāhurvipaścitaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.51

saṁsāramocanaṁ kiṁ tu śaivamājñāmayaṁ hitam \|\| 7.1,31.51

hitaṁ tadājñākaraṇaṁ yaddhitaṁ tadanugrahaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.52

sarvaṁ hite niyuñjāvaḥ sarvānugrahakārakaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.52

yastūpakāraśabdārthastamapyāhuranugraham \|\| 7.1,31.53

tasyāpi hitarūpatvācchivaḥ sarvopakārakaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.53

hite sadā niyuktaṁ tu sarvaṁ cidacidātmakam \|\| 7.1,31.54

svabhāvapratibandhaṁ tatsamaṁ na labhate hitam \|\| 7.1,31.54

yathā vikāsayatyeva raviḥ padmāni bhānubhiḥ \|\| 7.1,31.55

samaṁ na vikasantyeva svasvabhāvānurodhataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.55

svabhāvo 'pi hi bhāvānāṁ bhāvino 'rthasya kāraṇam \|\| 7.1,31.56

na hi svabhāvo naśyantamarthaṁ kartṛṣu sādhayet \|\| 7.1,31.56

suvarṇameva nāṁgāraṁ drāvayatyagnisaṁgamaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.57

evaṁ pakvamalāneva mocayenna śivaparān \|\| 7.1,31.57

536

yadyathā bhavituṁ yogyaṁ tattathā na bhavetsvayam \|\| 7.1,31.58

vinā bhāvanayā kartā svatantrassantato bhavet \|\| 7.1,31.58

svabhāvavimalo yadvatsarvānugrāhakaśśivaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.59

svabhāvamalināstadvadātmano jīvasaṁjñitāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.59

anyathā saṁsarantyete niyamānna śivaḥ katham \|\| 7.1,31.60

karmamāyānubandhosya saṁsāraḥ kathyate budhaiḥ \|\| 7.1,31.60

anubandho 'yamasyaiva na śivasyeti hetumān \|\| 7.1,31.61

sa heturātmanāmeva nijo nāgantuko malaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.61

āgantukatve kasyāpi bhāvyaṁ kenāpi hetunā \|\| 7.1,31.62

yo 'yaṁ heturasāvekastvavicitrasvabhāvataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.62

ātmatāyāḥ samatve 'pi baddhā muktāḥ pare yataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.63

baddheṣveva punaḥ kecillayabhogādhikārataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.63

jñānaiśvaryādivaiṣamyaṁ bhajante sottarādharāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.64

kecinmūrtyātmatāṁ yānti kecidāsannagocarāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.64

mūrtyātmasu śivāḥ kecidadhvanāṁ mūrdhasu sthitāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.65

madhye maheśvarā rudrāstvarvācīnapade sthitāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.65

āsanne 'pi ca māyāyāḥ parasmātkāraṇāttrayam \|\| 7.1,31.66

tatrāpyātmā sthito 'dhastādantarātmā ca madhyataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.66

parastātparamātmeti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.67

vartante vasavaḥ kecitparamātmapadāśrayāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.67

antarātmapade kecitkecidātmapade tathā \|\| 7.1,31.68

śāntyatītapade śaivāḥ śānte māheśvare tataḥ \|\| 7.1,31.68

vidyāyāntu yathā raudrāḥ pratiṣṭhāyāṁ tu vaiṣṇavāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.69

nivṛttau ca tathātmāno brahmā brahmāṁgayonayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.69

devayonyaṣṭakaṁ mukhyaṁ mānuṣyamatha madhyamam \|\| 7.1,31.70

pakṣyādayo 'dhamāḥ pañcayonayastāścaturdaśa \|\| 7.1,31.70

uttarādharabhāvo 'pi jñeyassaṁsāriṇo malaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.71

yathāmabhāvo muktasya pūrvaṁ paścāttu pakvatā \|\| 7.1,31.71

malo 'pyāmaśca pakvaśca bhavetsaṁsārakāraṇam \|\| 7.1,31.72

āme tvadharatā puṁsāṁ pakve tūttaratā kramāt \|\| 7.1,31.72

paśvātmānastridhābhinnā ekadvitrimalāḥ kramāt \|\| 7.1,31.73

atrottarā ekamalā dvimalā madhyamā matāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.73

trimalāstvadhamā jñeyā yathottaramadhiṣṭhitāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.73

trimalānadhitiṣṭhaṁti dvimalaikamalāḥ kramāt \|\| 7.1,31.74

itthamaupādhiko bhedo viśvasya parikalpitaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.74

ekadvitrimalānsarvāñchiva eko 'dhitiṣṭhati \|\| 7.1,31.75

aśivātmakamapyetacchivenādhiṣṭhitaṁ yathā \|\| 7.1,31.75

arudrātmakamityevaṁ rudrairjagadadhiṣṭhitam \|\| 7.1,31.76

aṇḍāntā hi mahābhūmiśśatarudrādyadhiṣṭhitā \|\| 7.1,31.76

māyāntamantarikṣaṁ tu hyamareśādibhiḥ kramāt \|\| 7.1,31.77

aṁguṣṭhamātraparyantaissamaṁtātsaṁtataṁ tatam \|\| 7.1,31.77

mahāmāyāvasānā dyaurvāyvādyairbhuvanādhipaiḥ \|\| 7.1,31.78

537

anāśritāntairadhvāntarvartibhissamadhiṣṭhitāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.78

te hi sākṣāddiviṣadastvantarikṣasadastathā \|\| 7.1,31.79

pṛthivīpada ityevaṁ devā devavrataiḥ stutā \|\| 7.1,31.79

evantribhirmalairāmaiḥ pakvaireva pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 7.1,31.80

nidānabhūtaissaṁsārarogaḥ puṁsāṁ pravartate \|\| 7.1,31.80

asya rogasya bhaiṣajyaṁ jñānameva na cāparam \|\| 7.1,31.81

bhiṣagājñāpakaḥ śambhuśśivaḥ paramakāraṇam \|\| 7.1,31.81

aduḥkhenā 'pi śakto 'sau paśūnmocayituṁ śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.82

kathaṁ duḥkhaṁ karotīti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 7.1,31.82

duḥkhameva hi sarvo 'pi saṁsāra iti niścitam \|\| 7.1,31.83

kathaṁ duḥkhamaduḥkhaṁ syātsvabhāvo hyaviparyayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.83

na hi rogī hyarogī syādbhiṣagbhaiṣajyakāraṇāt \|\| 7.1,31.84

rogārtaṁ tu bhiṣagrogādbhaiṣajaissukhamuddharet \|\| 7.1,31.84

evaṁ svabhāvamalinānsvabhāvādduḥkhinaḥ paśūn \|\| 7.1,31.85

svājñauṣadhavidhānena duḥkhānmocayate śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.85

na bhiṣakkāraṇaṁ roge śivaḥ saṁsārakāraṇam \|\| 7.1,31.86

ityetadapi vaiṣamyaṁ na doṣāyāsya kalpate \|\| 7.1,31.86

duḥkhe svabhāvasaṁsiddhe kathantatkāraṇaṁ śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.87

svābhāviko malaḥ puṁsāṁ sa hi saṁsārayatyamūn \|\| 7.1,31.87

saṁsārakāraṇaṁ yattu malaṁ māyādyacetanam \|\| 7.1,31.88

tatsvayaṁ na pravarteta śivasānnidhyamantarā \|\| 7.1,31.88

yathā maṇirayaskāṁtassānnidhyādupakārakaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.89

ayasaścalatastadvacchivo 'pyasyeti sūrayaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.89

na nivartayituṁ śakyaṁ sānnidhyaṁ sadakāraṇam \|\| 7.1,31.90

adhiṣṭhātā tato nityamajñāto jagataśśivaḥ \|\| 7.1,31.90

na śivena vinā kiṁcitpravṛttamiha vidyate \|\| 7.1,31.91

tatpreritamidaṁ sarvaṁ tathāpi na sa muhyati \|\| 7.1,31.91

śaktirājñātmikā tasya niyantrī viśvatomukhī \|\| 7.1,31.92

tayā tatamidaṁ śaśvattathāpi sa na duṣyati \|\| 7.1,31.92

anidaṁ prathamaṁ sarvamīśitavyaṁ sa īśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,31.93

īśanācca tadīyājñā tathāpi sa na duṣyati \|\| 7.1,31.93

yo 'nyathā manyate mohātsa vinaṣyati durmatiḥ \|\| 7.1,31.94

tacchaktivaibhavādeva tathāpi sa na duṣyati \|\| 7.1,31.94

etasminnaṁtare vyomnaḥ śrutāḥ vāgarīriṇī \|\| 7.1,31.95

satyamomamṛtaṁ saumyamityāvirabhavatsphuṭam \|\| 7.1,31.95

tato hṛṣṭatarāḥ sarve vinaṣṭāśeṣasaṁśayāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.96

munayo vismayāviṣṭāḥ preṇemuḥ pavanaṁ prabhum \|\| 7.1,31.96

tathā vigatasandehānkṛtvāpi pavano munīn \|\| 7.1,31.97

naite pratiṣṭhitajñānā iti matvaivamabravīt \|\| 7.1,31.97

vāyuruvācva

parokṣamaparokṣaṁ ca dvividhaṁ jñānamiṣyate \|\| 7.1,31.98

parokṣamasthiraṁ prāhuraparokṣaṁ tu susthiram \|\| 7.1,31.98

hetūpadeśagamyaṁ yattatparokṣaṁ pracakṣate \|\| 7.1,31.99

537

aparokṣaṁ punaḥ śreṣṭhādanuṣṭhānādbhaviṣyati \|\| 7.1,31.99

nāparokṣādṛte mokṣa iti kṛtvā viniścayam \|\| 7.1,31.100

śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānasiddhyarthaṁ prayatadhvamatandritāḥ \|\| 7.1,31.100

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe jñānopadeśo nāmaikatriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 32

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ

kiṁ tacchreṣṭamanuṣṭhānaṁ mokṣo yenaparokṣitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.1

tattasya sādhanaṁ cādya vaktumarhasi māruta \|\| 7.1,32.1

vāyuruvāca

śaivo hi paramo dharmaḥ śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānaśabditaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.2

yatrāparokṣo lakṣyeta sākṣānmokṣapradaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.2

sa tu pañcavidho jñeyaḥ pañcabhiḥ parvabhiḥ kramāt \|\| 7.1,32.3

kriyātapojapadhyānajñānātmabhiranuttaraiḥ \|\| 7.1,32.3

taireva sottaraissiddho dharmastu paramo mataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.4

parokṣamaparokṣaṁ ca jñānaṁ yatra ca mokṣadam \|\| 7.1,32.4

paramo 'paramaścobhau dharmau hi śruticoditau \|\| 7.1,32.5

dharmaśabdābhidheyerthe pramāṇaṁ śrutireva naḥ \|\| 7.1,32.5

paramo yogaparyanto dharmaḥ śrutiśirogataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.6

dharmastvaparamastadvadadhaḥ śrutimukhotthitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.6

apaśvātmādhikāratvādyo dharamaḥ paramo mataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.7

sādhāraṇastato 'nyastu sarveṣāmadhikārataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.7

sa cāyaṁ paramo dharmaḥ paradharmasya sādhanam \|\| 7.1,32.8

dharmaśāstrādibhissamyaksāṁga evopabṛṁhitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.8

śaivo yaḥ paramo dharmaḥ śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānaśabditaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.9

itihāsapurāṇābhyāṁ kathaṁcidupabṛṁhitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.9

śaivāgamaistu saṁpannaḥ sahāṁgopāṁvistaraḥ \|\| 7.1,32.10

tatsaṁskārādhikāraiśca samyagevopabṛṁhitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.10

śaivāgamo hi dvividhaḥ śrauto 'śrautaśca saṁskṛtaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.11

śrutisāramayaḥ śrautassvataṁtra itaro mataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.11

svataṁtro daśadhā pūrvaṁ tathāṣṭādaśadhā punaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.12

kāmikādisamākhyābhissiddhaḥ siddhāntasaṁjñitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.12

śrutisāramayo yastu śatakoṭipravistaraḥ \|\| 7.1,32.13

paraṁ pāśupataṁ yatra vrataṁ jñānaṁ ca kathyate \|\| 7.1,32.13

yugāvarteṣu śiṣyeta yogācāryasvarūpiṇā \|\| 7.1,32.14

tatratatrāvatīrṇena śivenaiva pravartyate \|\| 7.1,32.14

saṁkṣipyāsya pravaktāraścatvāraḥ paramarṣaya \|\| 7.1,32.15

rururdadhīco 'gastyaśca upamanyurmahāyaśāḥ \|\| 7.1,32.15

te ca pāśupatā jñeyāssaṁhitānāṁ pravartakāḥ \|\| 7.1,32.16

tatsaṁtatīyā guravaḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.16

tatroktaḥ paramo dharmaścaryādyātmā caturvidhaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.17

teṣu pāśupato yogaḥ śivaṁ pratyakṣayeddṛḍham \|\| 7.1,32.17

tasmācchreṣṭhamanuṣṭhānaṁ yogaḥ pāśupato mataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.18

tatrāpyupāyako yukto brahmaṇā sa tu kathyate \|\| 7.1,32.18

nāmāṣṭakamayo yogaśśivena parikalpitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.19

tena yogena sahasā śaivī prajñā prajāyate \|\| 7.1,32.19

prajñayā paramaṁ jñānamacirāllabhate sthiram \|\| 7.1,32.20

538

prasīdati śivastasya yasya jñānaṁ pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 7.1,32.20

prasādātparamo yogo yaḥ śivaṁ cāparokṣayet \|\| 7.1,32.21

śivāparokṣātsaṁsārakāraṇena viyujyate \|\| 7.1,32.21

tataḥ syānmuktasaṁsāro muktaḥ śivasamo bhavet \|\| 7.1,32.22

brahmaprokta ityupāyaḥ sa eva pṛthagucyate \|\| 7.1,32.22

śivo maheśvaraścaiva rudro viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.23

saṁsāravaidyaḥ sarvajñaḥ paramātmeti mukhyataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.23

nāmāṣṭakamidaṁ mukhyaṁ śivasya pratipādakam \|\| 7.1,32.24

ādyantu pañcakaṁ jñeyaṁ śāntyatītādyanukramāt \|\| 7.1,32.24

saṁjñā sadāśivādīnāṁ pañcopādhiparigrahāt \|\| 7.1,32.25

upādhivinivṛttau tu yathāsvaṁ vinivartate \|\| 7.1,32.25

padameva hi tannityamanityāḥ padinaḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 7.1,32.26

padānāṁ pratikṛttau tu mucyante padino yataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.26

parivṛttyantare bhūyastatpadaprāptirucyate \|\| 7.1,32.27

ātmāntarābhidhānaṁ syādyadādyaṁ nāma pañcakam \|\| 7.1,32.27

anyattu tritayaṁ nāmnāmupādānādiyogataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.28

trividhopādhivacanācchiva evānuvartate \|\| 7.1,32.28

anādimalasaṁśleṣaḥ prāgabhāvātsvabhāvataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.29

atyaṁtaṁ pariśuddhātmetyato 'yaṁ śiva ucyate \|\| 7.1,32.29

athavāśeṣakalyāṇaguṇaikadhana īśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,32.30

śiva ityucyate sadbhiśśivatattvārthavādibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,32.30

trayoviṁśatitattvebhyaḥ prakṛtirhi parā matā \|\| 7.1,32.31

prakṛtestu paraṁ prāhuḥ puruṣaṁ pañcaviṁśakam \|\| 7.1,32.31

yaṁ vedādau svaraṁ prāhurvācyavācakabhāvataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.32

vedaikavedyayāthātmyādvedānte ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.32

tasya prakṛtilīnasya yaḥ parassa maheśvaraḥ \|\| 7.1,32.33

tadadhīnapravṛttitvātprakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca \|\| 7.1,32.33

athavā triguṇaṁ tattvamupeyamidamavyayam \|\| 7.1,32.34

māyāntu prakṛtiṁ vidyānmāyinaṁ tu maheśvaram \|\| 7.1,32.34

māyāvikṣobhako 'naṁto maheśvarasamanvayāt \|\| 7.1,32.35

kālātmā paramātmādiḥ sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.35

rudduḥkhaṁ duḥkhaheturvā tadrāvayati naḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 7.1,32.36

rudra ityucyate sadbhiḥ śivaḥ paramakāraṇam \|\| 7.1,32.36

tattvādibhūtaparyantaṁ śarīrādiṣvatandritaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.37

vyāpyādhitiṣṭhati śivastato rudra itastataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.37

jagataḥ pitṛbhūtānāṁ śivo mūrtyātmanāmapi \|\| 7.1,32.38

pitṛbhāvena sarveṣāṁ pitāmaha udīritaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.38

nidānajño yathā vaidyo rogasya vinivartakaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.39

upāyairbheṣajaistadvallayabhogādhikārataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.39

saṁsārasyeśvaro nityaṁ samūlasya nivartakaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.40

saṁsāravaidya ityuktaḥ sarvatattvārthavedibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,32.40

daśārthajñānasiddhyarthamindriyeṣveṣu satsvapi \|\| 7.1,32.41

trikālabhāvino bhāvānsthūlānsūkṣmānaśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.41

aṇavo naiva jānanti māyayaiva malāvṛtāḥ \|\| 7.1,32.42

asatsvapi ca sarveṣu sarvārthajñānahetuṣu \|\| 7.1,32.42

538

yadyathāvasthitaṁ vastu tattathaiva sadāśivaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.43

ayatnenaiva jānāti tasmātsarvajña ucyate \|\| 7.1,32.43

sarvātmā paramairebhirguṇairnityasamanvayāt \|\| 7.1,32.44

svasmātparātmavirahātparamātmā śivaḥ svayam \|\| 7.1,32.44

nāmāṣṭakamidaṁ caiva labdhvācāryaprasādataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.45

nivṛttyādikalāgranthiṁ śivādyaiḥ pañcanāmabhiḥ \|\| 7.1,32.45

yathāsvaṁ kramaśaśchitvā śodhayitvā yathāguṇam \|\| 7.1,32.46

guṇitaireva soddhātairaniruddhairathāpi vā \|\| 7.1,32.46

hṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrasamanvitām \|\| 7.1,32.47

chittvā paryaṣṭakākāraṁ svātmānaṁ ca suṣumṇayā \|\| 7.1,32.47

dvādaśāṁtaḥsthitasyendornītvopari śivaujasi \|\| 7.1,32.48

saṁhṛtyaṁ vadanaṁ paścādyathāsaṁskaraṇaṁ layāt \|\| 7.1,32.48

śāktenāmṛtavarṣeṇa saṁsiktāyāṁ tanau punaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.49

avatārya svamātmānamamṛtātmākṛtiṁ hṛdi \|\| 7.1,32.49

dvādaśāṁtaḥsthitasyendoḥ parastācchvetapaṁkaje \|\| 7.1,32.50

samāsīnaṁ mahādevaṁ śaṁkarambhaktavatsalam \|\| 7.1,32.50

ardhanārīśvaraṁ devaṁ nirmalaṁ madhurākṛtim \|\| 7.1,32.51

śuddhasphaṭikasaṁkāśaṁ prasannaṁ śītaladyutim \|\| 7.1,32.51

dhyātvā hi mānase devaṁ svasthacitto 'tha mānavaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.52

śivanāmāṣṭakenaiva bhāvapuṣpaissamarcayet \|\| 7.1,32.52

abhyarcanānte tu punaḥ prāṇānāyamya mānavaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.53

samyakcittaṁ samādhāya śārvaṁ nāmāṣṭakaṁ japet \|\| 7.1,32.53

nābhau cāṣṭāhutīrhutvā pūrṇāhutyā namastataḥ \|\| 7.1,32.54

aṣṭapuṣpapradānena kṛtvābhyarcanamaṁtimam \|\| 7.1,32.54

nivedayetsvamātmānaṁ culukodakavartmanā \|\| 7.1,32.55

evaṁ kṛtvā cirādeva jñānaṁ pāśupataṁ śubham \|\| 7.1,32.55

labhate tatpratiṣṭhāṁ ca vṛttaṁ cānuttamaṁ tathā \|\| 7.1,32.56

yogaṁ ca paramaṁ labdhvā mucyate nātra saṁśayaḥ \|\| 7.1,32.56

iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ pūrvakhaṇḍe śreṣṭhānuṣṭhānavarṇanaṁ nāma dvātriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 33

ṛṣaya ūcuḥ

bhagavañchrotumicchāmo vrataṁ pāśupataṁ param \|\| 7.1,33.1

brahmādayo 'pi yatkṛtvā sarve pāśupatāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 7.1,33.1

vāyuruvāca

rahasyaṁ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpanikṛntanam \|\| 7.1,33.2

vrataṁ pāśupataṁ śrautamatharvaśirasi śrutam \|\| 7.1,33.2

kālaścaitrī paurṇamāsī deśaḥ śivaparigrahaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.3

kṣetrārāmādyaraṇyaṁ vā praśastaśśubhalakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.3

tatra pūrvaṁ trayodaśyāṁ susnātaḥ sukṛtāhnikaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.4

anujñāpya svamācāryaṁ saṁpūjya praṇipatya ca \|\| 7.1,33.4

pūjāṁ vaiśeṣikīṁ kṛtvā śuklāṁbaradharaḥ svayam \|\| 7.1,33.5

śuklayajñopavītī ca śuklamālyānulepanaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.5

darbhāsane samāsīno darbhamuṣṭiṁ pragṛhya ca \|\| 7.1,33.6

539

prāṇāyāmatrayaṁ kṛtvā prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.6

dhyātvā devaṁ ca devīṁ ca tadvijñāpanavartmanā \|\| 7.1,33.6

vratametatkaromīti bhavetsaṁkalpya dīkṣitaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.7

yāvaccharīrapātaṁ vā dvādaśābdamathāpi vā \|\| 7.1,33.7

tadardhaṁ vā tadardhaṁ vā māsadvādaśakaṁ tu vā \|\| 7.1,33.8

tadardhaṁ vā tadardhaṁ vā māsamekamathāpi vā \|\| 7.1,33.8

dinadvādaśakaṁ vā 'tha dinaṣaṭkamathāpi vā \|\| 7.1,33.9

tadardhaṁ dinamekaṁ vā vratasaṁkalpanāvadhi \|\| 7.1,33.9

agnimādhāya vidhivadvirajāhomakāraṇāt \|\| 7.1,33.10

hutvājyena samidbhiśca caruṇā ca yathākramam \|\| 7.1,33.10

pūrṇāmāpūrya tāṁ bhūyastattvānāṁ śuddhimuddiśan \|\| 7.1,33.11

juhuyānmūlamantreṇa taireva samidādibhiḥ \|\| 7.1,33.11

tattvānyetāni maddehe śuddhyaṁtām 1 tyanusmaran \|\| 7.1,33.12

pañcabhūtāni tanmātrāḥ pañcakarmendriyāṇi ca \|\| 7.1,33.12

jñānakarmavibhedena pañcakarmavibhāgaśaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.13

tvagādidhātavassapta pañca prāṇādivāyavaḥ \|\| 7.1,33.13

manobuddhirahaṁ khyātirguṇāḥ prakṛtipūruṣau \|\| 7.1,33.14

rāgo vidyākale caiva niyatiḥ kāla eva ca \|\| 7.1,33.14

māyā ca śuddhividyā ca maheśvarasadāśivau \|\| 7.1,33.15

śaktiśca śivatattvaṁ ca tattvāni kramaśo viduḥ \|\| 7.1,33.15

mantraistu virajairhutvā hotāsau virajā bhavet \|\| 7.1,33.16

śivānugrahamāsādya jñānavānsa hi jāyate \|\| 7.1,33.16

atha gomayamādāya piṇḍīkṛtyābhimaṁtrya ca \|\| 7.1,33.17

vinyasyāgnau ca samprokṣya dine tasminhaviṣyabhuk \|\| 7.1,33.17

prabhāte tu caturdaśyāṁ kṛtvā sarvaṁ puroditam \|\| 7.1,33.18

dine tasminnirāhāraḥ kālaṁ śeṣaṁ samāpayet \|\| 7.1,33.18

prātaḥ parvaṇi cāpyevaṁ kṛtvā homā vasānataḥ \|\| 7.1,33.19

upasaṁhṛtya rudrāgniṁ gṛhṇīyādbhasma yatnataḥ \|\| 7.1,33.19

tataśca jaṭilo muṇḍī śikhaikajaṭa eva vā \|\| 7.1,33.20

bhūtvā snātvā tato vītalajjaścetsyāddigambaraḥ \|\| 7.1,33.20

api kāṣāyavasanaścarmacīrāmbaro 'tha vā \|\| 7.1,33.21

ekāmbaro valkalī vā bhaveddaṇḍī ca mekhalī \|\| 7.1,33.21

prakṣālya caraṇau paścāddvirācamyātmanastanum \|\| 7.1,33.22

saṁkulīkṛtya tadbhasma virajānalasaṁbhavam \|\| 7.1,33.22

agnirityādibhirmaṁtraiḥ ṣaḍbhirātharvaṇaiḥ kramāt \|\| 7.1,33.23

vibhṛjyāṁgāni mūrdhādicaraṇāṁtāni taisspṛśet \|\| 7.1,33.23
