vahnibījaṁ samuccārya tvādadhītāgnimāsane \|\| 7.2,27.15

yonimārgeṇa vā tadvadātmanaḥ saṁmukhena vā \|\| 7.2,27.15

niyogaḥ pradeśa sarvaṁ kuṁḍaṁ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.16

svanābhyaṁtaḥsthitaṁ vahniṁ tadraṁdhrādvisphuliṁgavad \|\| 7.2,27.16

nirgamya pāvake bahye līnaṁ biṁbākṛti smaret \|\| 7.2,27.17

ājyasaṁskāraparyaṁtamanvādhānapurassaram \|\| 7.2,27.17

svasūtroktakramātkuryānmūlamantreṇa mantravit \|\| 7.2,27.18

śivamūrtiṁ samabhyarcya tato dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.18

nyasya mantraṁ ghṛte mudrāṁ darśayeddhenusaṁjñitām \|\| 7.2,27.19

sruksruvau taijasau grāhyau na kāṁsyāyasasaisakau \|\| 7.2,27.19

yajñadārumayau vāpi smārtau vā śilpasammatau \|\| 7.2,27.20

parṇe vā brahmavṛkṣāderacchidre madhya utthite \|\| 7.2,27.20

saṁsṛjya darbhaistau vahnau saṁtāpya prokṣayetpunaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.21

pārārṣarcyasvasūtroktakrameṇa śivapūrvakaiḥ \|\| 7.2,27.21

juhuyādaṣṭabhirbījairagnisaṁskārasiddhaye \|\| 7.2,27.22

bhruṁstuṁbruśruṁ krameṇaiva puṁḍraṁdramityataḥ param \|\| 7.2,27.22

bījāni sapta saptānāṁ jihvānāmanupūrvaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.23

triśikhā madhyamā jihvā bahurūpasamāhvayā \|\| 7.2,27.23

raktāgneyī nairṛtī ca kṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matā \|\| 7.2,27.24

atiriktā marujjihvā svanāmānuguṇaprabhā \|\| 7.2,27.24

svabijānantaraṁ vācyā svāhāṁtañca yathākramam \|\| 7.2,27.25

jihvāmaṁtraistu tairhutvājyaṁ jihvāstvekaikaśa kramāt \|\| 7.2,27.25

raṁ vahnayeti svāheti madhye hutvāhutitrayam \|\| 7.2,27.26

sarpiṣā vā samidbhirvā pariṣecanamācaret \|\| 7.2,27.26

evaṁ kṛte śivāgniḥ syātsmarettatra śivāsanam \|\| 7.2,27.27

tatrāvāhya yajeddevamardhanārīśvaraṁ śivam \|\| 7.2,27.27

dīpāntaṁ pariṣicyātha samiddhomaṁ samācaret \|\| 7.2,27.27

tāḥ pālāśyaḥ parā vāpi yājñiyā dvādaśāṁgulāḥ \|\| 7.2,27.28

avakrā na svayaṁ śuṣkāssatvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ \|\| 7.2,27.28

daśāṁgulā vā vihitāḥ kaniṣṭhāṁgulisaṁmitāḥ \|\| 7.2,27.29

prādeśamātrā vālābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā api \|\| 7.2,27.29

dūrvāpatrasamākārāṁ caturaṁgulamāyatām \|\| 7.2,27.30

dadyādājyāhutiṁ paścādannamakṣapramāṇataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.30

lājāṁstathā sarṣapāṁśca yavāṁścaiva tilāṁstathā \|\| 7.2,27.31

sarpiṣāktāni bhakṣyāṇi lehyacoṣyāṇi sambhave \|\| 7.2,27.31

daśaivāhutayastatra pañca vā tritayaṁ ca vā \|\| 7.2,27.32

hotavyāḥ śaktito dadyādekamevātha vāhutim \|\| 7.2,27.32

śruveṇājyaṁ samityādyāsrucāśeṣātkareṇa vā \|\| 7.2,27.33

tatra divyena hotavyaṁ tīrthenārṣeṇa vā tathā \|\| 7.2,27.33

dravyeṇaikena vā 'lābhe juhuyācchraddhayā punaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.34

prāyaścittāya juhuyānmaṁtrayitvāhutitrayam \|\| 7.2,27.34

577

tato homaviśiṣṭena ghṛtenāpūrya vai srucam \|\| 7.2,27.35

nidhāya puṣpaṁ tasyāgre śruveṇādhomukhena tām \|\| 7.2,27.35

sadarbhena samācchādya mūlenāṁjalinotthitaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.36

vauṣaḍaṁtena juhuyāddhārāṁ tu yavasaṁmitām \|\| 7.2,27.36

itthaṁ pūrṇāhutiṁ kṛtvā pariṣiṁcecca pūrvavat \|\| 7.2,27.37

tata udvāsya deveśaṁ gopayettu hutāśanam \|\| 7.2,27.37

tamapyudvāsya vā nābhau yajetsaṁdhāya nityaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.38

athavā vahnimānīya śivaśāstroktavartmanā \|\| 7.2,27.38

vāgīśīgarbhasaṁbhūtaṁ saṁskṛtya vidhivadyajet \|\| 7.2,27.39

anvādhānaṁ punaḥ kṛtvā paridhīn paridhāya ca \|\| 7.2,27.39

pātrāṇi dvandvarūpeṇa nikṣipyeṣṭvā śivaṁ tataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.40

saṁśodhya prokṣaṇīpātraṁ prokṣyatāni tadaṁbhasā \|\| 7.2,27.40

praṇītāpātramaiśānyāṁ vinyasyā pūritaṁ jalaiḥ \|\| 7.2,27.41

ājyasaṁskāraparyaṁtaṁ kṛtvā saṁśodhya sraksruvau \|\| 7.2,27.41

garbhādhānaṁ puṁsavanaṁ sīmantonnayanaṁ tataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.42

kṛtvā pṛthakpṛthagghutvā jātamagniṁ vicintayet \|\| 7.2,27.42

tripādaṁ saptahastaṁ ca catuḥśṛṁgaṁ dviśīrṣakam \|\| 7.2,27.43

madhupiṁgaṁ trinayanaṁ sakapardenduśekharam \|\| 7.2,27.43

raktaṁ raktāmbarālepaṁ mālyabhūṣanabhūṣitam \|\| 7.2,27.44

sarvalakṣaṇasaṁpannaṁ sopavītaṁ trimekhalam \|\| 7.2,27.44

śaktimantaṁ sruksruvau ca dadhānaṁ dakṣiṇe kare \|\| 7.2,27.45

tomaraṁ tālavṛṁtaṁ ca ghṛtapātraṁ tathetaraiḥ \|\| 7.2,27.45

jātaṁ dhyātvaivamākāraṁ jātakarma samācaret \|\| 7.2,27.46

nālāpanayanaṁ kṛtvā tataḥ saṁśodhya sūtakam \|\| 7.2,27.46

śivāgnirucināmāsya kṛtvāhutipurassaram \|\| 7.2,27.47

pitrorvisarjanaṁ kṛtvā caulopanayanādikam \|\| 7.2,27.47

aptoryāmāvasānāntaṁ kṛtvā saṁskāramasya tu \|\| 7.2,27.48

ājyadhārādihomaṁ ca kṛtvā sviṣṭakṛtaṁ tataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.48

ramityanena bījena pariṣiṁcettataḥ param \|\| 7.2,27.49

brahmaviṣṇuśiveśānāṁ lokeśānāṁ tathaiva ca \|\| 7.2,27.49

tadastrāṇāṁ ca paritaḥ kṛtvā pūjāṁ yathākramam \|\| 7.2,27.50

dhūpadīpādisiddhyarthaṁ vahnimuddhṛtya kṛtyavit \|\| 7.2,27.50

sādhayitvājyapūrvāṇi dravyāṇi punareva ca \|\| 7.2,27.51

kalpayitvāsanaṁ vahnau tatrāvāhya yathāpurā \|\| 7.2,27.51

saṁpūjya devaṁ devīṁ ca tataḥ pūrṇāṁtamācaret \|\| 7.2,27.52

atha vā svāśramoktaṁ tu vahnikarma śivārpaṇam \|\| 7.2,27.52

buddhvā śivāśramī kuryānna ca tatrāparo vidhiḥ \|\| 7.2,27.53

śivāgnerbhasmasaṁgrāhyamagnihotrodbhavaṁ tu vā \|\| 7.2,27.53

vaivāhognibhavaṁ vāpi pakvaṁ śuci sugaṁdhi ca \|\| 7.2,27.54

kapilāyāḥ śakṛcchastaṁ gṛhītaṁ gagane patat \|\| 7.2,27.54

na klinnaṁ nātikaṭhinaṁ na durgandhaṁ na śoṣitam \|\| 7.2,27.55

uparyadhaḥ parityajya gṛhṇīyātpatitaṁ yadi \|\| 7.2,27.55

piṁḍīkṛtya śivāgnyādau tatkṣipenmūlamaṁtrataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.56

577

apakvamatipākvaṁ ca saṁtyajya bhasitaṁ sitam \|\| 7.2,27.56

ādāya vā samāloḍya bhasmādhāre vinikṣipet \|\| 7.2,27.57

taijasaṁ dāravaṁ vāpi mṛnmayaṁ śailameva ca \|\| 7.2,27.57

anyadvā śobhanaṁ śuddhaṁ bhasmādhāraṁ prakalpayet \|\| 7.2,27.58

same deśe śubhe śuddhe dhanavadbhasma nikṣipet \|\| 7.2,27.58

na cāyuktakare dadyānnaivāśucitale kṣipet \|\| 7.2,27.59

na saṁspṛśecca nīcāṁgairnopekṣeta na laṁghayet \|\| 7.2,27.59

tasmādbhasitamādāya viniyuṁjīta mantrataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.60

kāleṣūkteṣu nānyatra nāyogyebhyaḥ pradāpayet \|\| 7.2,27.60

bhasmasaṁgrahaṇaṁ kuryāddeve 'nudvāsite sati \|\| 7.2,27.61

udvāsane kṛte yasmāccaṇḍabhasma prajāpate \|\| 7.2,27.61

agnikārye kṛte paścācchivaśāstroktamārgataḥ \|\| 7.2,27.62

svasūtroktaprakārādvā balikarma samācaret \|\| 7.2,27.62

atha vidyāsanaṁ nyasya supralipte tu maṇdale \|\| 7.2,27.63

vidyākośaṁ pratiṣṭhāpya yajetpuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,27.63

vidyāyāḥ purataḥ kṛtvā gurorapi ca maṇḍalam \|\| 7.2,27.64

tatrāsanavaraṁ kṛtvā puṣpādyai gurumarcayet \|\| 7.2,27.64

tatonupūjayetpūjyān bhojayecca bubhukṣitān \|\| 7.2,27.65

tatassvayaṁ ca bhuṁjīta śuddhamannaṁ yathāsukham \|\| 7.2,27.65

niveditaṁ ca vā deve taccheṣaṁ cātmaśuddhaye \|\| 7.2,27.66

śraddadhāno na lobhena na caṇḍāya samarpitam \|\| 7.2,27.66

gandhamālyādi yaccānyattatrāpyeṣa samo vidhiḥ \|\| 7.2,27.67

na tu tatra śivosmīti buddhiṁ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.67

bhuktvācamya śivaṁ dhyātvā hṛdaye mūlamuccaret \|\| 7.2,27.68

kālaśeṣaṁ nayedyogyaiḥ śivaśāstrakathādibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,27.68

rātrau vyatīte pūrvāṁśe kṛtvā pūjāṁ manoharām \|\| 7.2,27.69

śivayoḥ śayanaṁ tvekaṁ kalpayedatiśobhanam \|\| 7.2,27.69

bhakṣyabhojyāṁbarālepapuṣpamālādikaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,27.70

manasā karmaṇā vāpi kṛtvā sarvaṁ manoharam \|\| 7.2,27.70

tato devasya devyāśca pādamūle śucissvapet \|\| 7.2,27.71

gṛhastho bhāryayā sārdhaṁ tadanye 'pi tu kevalāḥ \|\| 7.2,27.71

pratyūṣasamayaṁ buddhvā mātrāmādyāmudīrayet \|\| 7.2,27.72

praṇamya manasāṁ devaṁ sāṁbaṁ sagaṇamavyayam \|\| 7.2,27.72

deśakālocitaṁ kṛtvā śaucādyamapi śaktitaḥ \|\| 7.2,27.73

śaṁkhādininadairdivyairdevaṁ devīṁ ca bodhayet \|\| 7.2,27.73

tatastatsamayonnidraiḥ puṣpairatisugaṁdhibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,27.74

nirvartya śivayoḥ pūjāṁ prārabheta puroditam \|\| 7.2,27.74

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe agnikāryavarṇanaṁ nāma saptaviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 28

upamanyuruvāca

ataḥ paraṁ pravakṣyāmi śivāśramaniṣeviṇām \|\| 7.2,28.1

śivaśāstroktamārgeṇa naimittikavidhikramam \|\| 7.2,28.1

sarveṣvapi ca māseṣu pakṣayorubhayorapi \|\| 7.2,28.2

578

aṣṭābhyāṁ ca caturdaśyāṁ tathā parvāṇi ca kramāt \|\| 7.2,28.2

ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,28.3

kartavyā mahatī pūjā hyadhikā vāpi śaktitaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.3

māsimāsi yathānyāyaṁ brahmakūrcaṁ prasādhya tu \|\| 7.2,28.4

snāpayitvā śivaṁ tena pibeccheṣamupoṣitaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.4

brahmahatyādidoṣāṇāmatīva mahatāmapi \|\| 7.2,28.5

niṣkṛtirbrahmakūrcasya pānānnānyā viśiṣyate \|\| 7.2,28.5

pauṣe puṣyanakṣatre kuryānnīrājanaṁ vibhoḥ \|\| 7.2,28.6

māghe maghākhye nakṣatre pradadyādghṛtakaṁbalam \|\| 7.2,28.6

phālgune cottarānte vai prārabheta mahotsavam \|\| 7.2,28.7

caitre citrāpaurṇamāsyāṁ dolāṁ kuryādyathāvidhi \|\| 7.2,28.7

vaiśākhyāṁ tu viśākhāyāṁ kuryātpuṣpamahālayam \|\| 7.2,28.8

jyeṣṭhe mūlākhyanakṣatre śītakumbhaṁ pradāpayet \|\| 7.2,28.8

āṣāḍhe cottarāṣāḍhe pavitrāropaṇaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,28.9

śrāvaṇe prākṛtānyāpi maṇḍalāni prakalpayet \|\| 7.2,28.9

śraviṣṭhākhye tu nakṣatre prauṣṭhapadyāṁ tataḥ param \|\| 7.2,28.10

prokṣayecca jalakrīḍāṁ pūrvāṣāḍhāśraye dine \|\| 7.2,28.10

āśvayujyāṁ tato dadyātpāyasaṁ ca navodanam \|\| 7.2,28.11

agnikāryaṁ ca tenaiva kuryācchatabhiṣagdine \|\| 7.2,28.11

kārtikyāṁ kṛtikāyoge dadyāddīpasahasrakam \|\| 7.2,28.12

mārgaśīrṣe tathārdrāyāṁ ghṛtena snāpayecchivam \|\| 7.2,28.12

aśaktasteṣu kāleṣu kuryādutsavameva vā \|\| 7.2,28.13

āsthānaṁ vā mahāpūjāmadhikaṁ vā samarcanam \|\| 7.2,28.13

āvṛtte 'pi ca kalyāṇe praśasteṣvapi karmasu \|\| 7.2,28.14

daurmanasye durācāre duḥsvapne duṣṭadarśane \|\| 7.2,28.14

utpāte vāśubhenyasminroge vā prabale 'tha vā \|\| 7.2,28.15

snānapūjājapadhyānahomadānādikāḥ kriyaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.15

nirmitānuguṇāḥ kāryāḥ puraścaraṇapūrvikāḥ \|\| 7.2,28.16

śivānale ca vihate punassandhānamācaret \|\| 7.2,28.16

ya evaṁ śarvadharmiṣṭho vartate nityamudyataḥ \|\| 7.2,28.17

tasyaikajanmanā muktiṁ prayacchati maheśvaraḥ \|\| 7.2,28.17

etadyathottaraṁ kuryānnityanaimittikeṣu yaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.18

divyaṁ śrīkaṁṭhanāthasya sthānamādyaṁ sa gacchati \|\| 7.2,28.18

tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānkalpakoṭiśatannaraḥ \|\| 7.2,28.19

kālāṁtarecyutastasmādaumaṁ kaumārameva ca \|\| 7.2,28.19

saṁprāpya vaiṣṇavaṁ brāhmaṁ rudralokaṁ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,28.20

tatroṣitvā ciraṁ kālaṁ bhuktvā bhogānyathoditān \|\| 7.2,28.20

punaścordhvaṁ gatastasmādatītya sthānapañcakam \|\| 7.2,28.21

śrīkaṇṭhājjñānamāsādya tasmācchaivapuraṁ vrajet \|\| 7.2,28.21

ardhacaryārataścāpi dvirāvṛttyaivameva tu \|\| 7.2,28.22

paścājjñānaṁ samāsādya śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt \|\| 7.2,28.22

ardhārdhacarito yastu dehī dehakṣayātparam \|\| 7.2,28.23

aṁḍāṁtaṁ vordhvamavyaktamatītya bhuvanadvayam \|\| 7.2,28.23

saṁprāpya pauruṣaṁ raudrasthānamadrīndrajāpateḥ \|\| 7.2,28.24

578

anekayugasāhasraṁ bhuktvā bhogānanekadhā \|\| 7.2,28.24

puṇyakṣaye kṣitiṁ prāpya kule mahati jāyate \|\| 7.2,28.25

tatrāpi pūrvasaṁskāravaśena sa mahādyutiḥ \|\| 7.2,28.25

paśudharmānparityajya śivadharmarato bhavet \|\| 7.2,28.26

taddharmagauravādeva dhyātvā śivapuraṁ vrajet \|\| 7.2,28.26

bhogāṁśca vividhānbhuktvā vidyeśvarapadaṁ vrajet \|\| 7.2,28.27

tatra vidyeśvaraissārdhaṁ bhuktvā bhogānbahūnkramāt \|\| 7.2,28.27

aṇḍasyāṁtarbahirvātha sakṛdāvartate punaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.28

tato labdhvā śivajñānaṁ parāṁ bhaktimavāpya ca \|\| 7.2,28.28

śivasādharmyamāsādya na bhūyo vinivartate \|\| 7.2,28.29

yaścātīva śive bhakto viṣayāsaktacittavat \|\| 7.2,28.29

śivadarmānaso kurvannakurvanvāpi mucyate \|\| 7.2,28.30

ekāvṛtto dvirāvṛttastrirāvṛtto nivartakaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.30

na punaścakravartī syācchivadharmādhikāravān \|\| 7.2,28.31

tasmāccchivāśrito bhūtvā yena kenāpi hetunā \|\| 7.2,28.31

śivadharme matiṁ kuryācchreyase cetkṛtodyamaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.32

nātra nirbaṁdhayiṣyāmo vayaṁ kecana kenacit \|\| 7.2,28.32

nirbandhebhyo 'tivādebhyaḥ prakṛtyaitanna rocate \|\| 7.2,28.33

rocate vā parebhyastu puṇyasaṁskāragauravāt \|\| 7.2,28.33

saṁsārakāraṇaṁ yeṣāṁ na praroḍhumalaṁ bhavet \|\| 7.2,28.34

prakṛtyanuguṇaṁ tasmādvimṛśyaitadaśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,28.34

śivadharme 'dhikurvīta yadīcchecchivamātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,28.35

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe nityanaimittikavidhivarṇanaṁ nāmāṣṭāviṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 29

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca

bhagavaṁstvanmukhādeva śrutaṁ śrutisamaṁ mayā \|\| 7.2,29.1

svāśritānāṁ śivaproktaṁ nityanaimittikaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,29.1

idānīṁ śrotumicchāmi śivadharmādhikāriṇām \|\| 7.2,29.2

kāmyamapyasti cetkarma vaktumarhasi sāmpratam \|\| 7.2,29.2

upamanyuruvāca

astyaihikaphalaṁ kiñcidāmuṣmikaphalaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,29.3

aihikāmuṣmikañcāpi tacca pañcavidhaṁ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,29.3

kiṁcitkriyāmayaṁ karma kiṁcitkarma tapo mayam \|\| 7.2,29.4

japadhyānamayaṁ kiṁcitkiṁcitsarvamayaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,29.5

kriyāmayaṁ tathā bhinnaṁ homadānārcanakramāt \|\| 7.2,29.5

sarvaśaktimatāmeva nānyeṣāṁ saphalaṁ bhavet \|\| 7.2,29.6

śaktiścājñā madeśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,29.6

tasmātkāmyāni karmāṇi kuryādājñādharodvijaḥ \|\| 7.2,29.7

atha vakṣyāmi kāmyaṁ hi cehāmutra phalapradam \|\| 7.2,29.7

śaivairmāheśvaraiścaiva kāryamaṁtarbahiḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,29.8

śivo maheśvaraśceti nātyaṁtamiha bhidyate \|\| 7.2,29.8

yathā tathā na bhidyaṁte śaivā māheśvarā api \|\| 7.2,29.9

śivāśritā hi te śaivā jñānayajñaratā narāḥ \|\| 7.2,29.9

māheśvarāssamākhyātā karmayajñaratā bhuvi \|\| 7.2,29.10

579

tasmādābhyantare kuryuḥ śaivā māheśvarā vahiḥ \|\| 7.2,29.10

na tu prayogo bhidyeta vakṣyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ \|\| 7.2,29.11

parīkṣya bhūmiṁ vidhivadgaṁdhavarṇarasādibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,29.11

manobhilaṣite tatra vitānavitatāṁbare \|\| 7.2,29.12

supralipte mahīpṛṣṭhe darpaṇodarasaṁnibhe \|\| 7.2,29.12

prācīmutpādayetpūrvaṁ śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā \|\| 7.2,29.13

ekahastaṁ dvihastaṁ vā maṇḍalaṁ parikalpayet \|\| 7.2,29.13

ālikhedvimalaṁ padmamaṣṭapatraṁ sakarṇikam \|\| 7.2,29.14

ratnahemādibhiścūrṇairyathāsaṁbhavasaṁbhṛtaiḥ \|\| 7.2,29.14

pañcāvaraṇasaṁyuktaṁ bahuśobhāsamanvitam \|\| 7.2,29.15

daleṣu siddhayaḥ kalpyāḥ kesareṣu saśaktikāḥ \|\| 7.2,29.15

rudrā vāmādayastvaṣṭau pūrvādidalataḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,29.16

karṇikāyāṁ ca vairāgyaṁ bījeṣu nava śaktayaḥ \|\| 7.2,29.16

skande śivātmako dharmo nāle jñānaṁ śivāśrayam \|\| 7.2,29.17

karṇikopari cāgneyaṁ maṁḍalaṁ sauramaindavam \|\| 7.2,29.17

śivavidyātmatattvākhyaṁ tattvatrayamataḥ param \|\| 7.2,29.18

sarvāsanopari sukhaṁ vicitrakusumānvitam \|\| 7.2,29.18

pañcāvaraṇasaṁyuktaṁ pūjayedaṁbayā saha \|\| 7.2,29.19

śuddhasphaṭikasaṁkāśaṁ prasannaṁ śītaladyutim \|\| 7.2,29.19

vidyudvalayasaṁkāśajaṭāmukuṭabhūṣitam \|\| 7.2,29.20

śārdūlacarmavasanaṁ kiñcitsmitamukhāṁbujam \|\| 7.2,29.20

raktapadmadalaprakhyapādapāṇitalādharam \|\| 7.2,29.21

sarvalakṣaṇasaṁpannaṁ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 7.2,29.21

divyāyudhavarairyuktaṁ divyagaṁdhānulepanam \|\| 7.2,29.22

pañcavaktraṁ daśabhujaṁ candrakhaṇḍaśikhāmaṇim \|\| 7.2,29.22

asya pūrvamukhaṁ saumyaṁ bālārkasadṛśaprabham \|\| 7.2,29.23

trilocanāraviṁdāḍhyaṁ kṛtabāleṁduśekharam \|\| 7.2,29.23

dakṣiṇaṁ nīlajīmūtasamānaruciraprabham \|\| 7.2,29.24

bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṁ ghoraṁ raktavṛttekṣaṇatrayam \|\| 7.2,29.24

daṁṣṭrākarālaṁ durdharṣaṁ sphuritādharapallavam \|\| 7.2,29.25

uttaraṁ vidrumaprakhyaṁ nīlālakavibhūṣitam \|\| 7.2,29.25

savilāsaṁ trinayanaṁ candrābharaṇaśekharam \|\| 7.2,29.26

paścimaṁ pūrṇacandrābhaṁ locanatritayojjvalam \|\| 7.2,29.26

candrarekhādharaṁ saumyaṁ maṁdasmitamanoharam \|\| 7.2,29.27

pañcamaṁ sphaṭikaprakhyamiṁdurekhāsamujjvalam \|\| 7.2,29.27

atīva saumyamutphullalocanatritayojjvalam \|\| 7.2,29.28

dakṣiṇe śūlaparaśuvajrakhaḍgānalojjvalam \|\| 7.2,29.28

savye ca nāganārācaghaṇṭāpāśāṁkuśojjvalam \|\| 7.2,29.29

nivṛttyājānusaṁbaddhamānābheśca pratiṣṭhayā \|\| 7.2,29.29

ākaṁṭhaṁ vidyayā tadvadālalāṭaṁ tu śāṁtayā \|\| 7.2,29.30

tadūrdhvaṁ śāṁtyatītākhyakalayā parayā tathā \|\| 7.2,29.30

pañcādhvavyāpinaṁ sākṣātkalāpañcakavigraham \|\| 7.2,29.31

īśānamukuṭaṁ devaṁ puruṣākhyaṁ purātanam \|\| 7.2,29.31

aghorahṛdayaṁ tadvadvāmaguhyaṁ maheśvaram \|\| 7.2,29.32

579

sadyapādaṁ ca tanmūrtimaṣṭatriṁśatkalāmayam \|\| 7.2,29.32

mātṛkāmayamīśānaṁ pañcabrahmamayaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,29.33

oṁkārākhyamayaṁ caiva haṁsaśaktyā samanvitam \|\| 7.2,29.33

tathecchātmikayā śaktyā samārūḍhāṁkamaṁḍalam \|\| 7.2,29.34

jñānākhyayā dakṣiṇato vāmataśca kriyākhyayā \|\| 7.2,29.34

tattvatrayamayaṁ sākṣādvidyāmūrtiṁ sadāśivam \|\| 7.2,29.35

mūrtimūlena saṁkalpya sakalīkṛtya ca kramāt \|\| 7.2,29.35

saṁpūjya ca yathānyāyamarghāntaṁ mūlavidyayā \|\| 7.2,29.36

mūrtimantaṁ śivaṁ sākṣācchaktyā paramayā saha \|\| 7.2,29.36

tatrāvāhya mahādevaṁ sadasadvyaktivarjitam \|\| 7.2,29.37

pañcopakaraṇaṁ kṛtvā pūjayetparameśvaram \|\| 7.2,29.37

brahmabhiśca ṣaḍaṅgaiśca tato mātṛkayā saha \|\| 7.2,29.38

praṇavena śivenaiva śaktiyuktena ca kramāt \|\| 7.2,29.38

śāṁtena vā tathānyaiśca vedamantraiśca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,29.39

pūjayetparamaṁ devaṁ kevalena śivena vā \|\| 7.2,29.39

pādyādimukhavāsāṁtaṁ kṛtvā prasthāpanaṁ vinā \|\| 7.2,29.40

pañcāvaraṇapūjāṁ tu hyārabheta yathākramam \|\| 7.2,29.40

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe kāmyakarmavarṇanaṁ nāmaikonatriṁśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 30

tatrādau śivayoḥ pārśve dakṣiṇe vāmataḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.1

gaṁdhādyairarcayetpūrvaṁ devau heraṁbaṣaṇmukhau \|\| 7.2,30.1

tato brahmāṇi parita īśānādi yathākramam \|\| 7.2,30.2

saśaktikāni sadyāṁtaṁ prathamāvaraṇe yajet \|\| 7.2,30.2

ṣaḍaṁgānyapi tatraiva hṛdayādīnyanukramāt \|\| 7.2,30.3

śivasya ca śivāyāśca vāhneyādi samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.3

tatra vāmādikānrudrānaṣṭau vāmādiśaktibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,30.4

arcayedvā na vā paścātpūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.4

prathamāvaraṇaṁ proktaṁ mayā te yadunaṁdana \|\| 7.2,30.5

dvitīyāvaraṇaṁ prītyā procyate śraddhayā śṛṇu \|\| 7.2,30.5

anaṁtaṁ pūrvādikpatre tacchaktiṁ tasya vāmataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.6

sūkṣmaṁ dakṣiṇadikpatre saha śaktyā samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.6

tataḥ paścimadikpatre saha śaktyā śivottamam \|\| 7.2,30.7

tathaivottaradikpatre caikanetraṁ samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.7

ekarudraṁ ca tacchaktiṁ paścādīśadale 'rcayet \|\| 7.2,30.8

trimūrtiṁ tasya śaktiṁ ca pūjayedagnidigdale \|\| 7.2,30.8

śrīkaṇṭhaṁ nairṛte patre tacchaktiṁ tasya vāmataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.9

tathaiva mārute patre śikhaṁḍīśaṁ samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.9

dvitīyāvaraṇe cejyāssarvartaścakravartinaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.10

tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ śaktibhiścāṣṭamūrtayaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.10

aṣṭasu kramaśo dikṣu pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.11

bhavaḥ śarvastatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatistataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.11

ugro bhīmo mahādeva ityaṣṭau mūrtayaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.12

anaṁtaraṁ tataścaiva mahādevādayaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.12

śaktibhissaha saṁpūjyāstatraikādaśamūrtayaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.12

580

mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṁkaro nīlalohitaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.13

īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.13

kapardīśaśca kathyaṁte tathaikādaśaśaktayaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.14

tatrāṣṭau prathamaṁ pūjyāḥ vāhneyādi yathākramam \|\| 7.2,30.14

devadevaḥ pūrvapatre īśānaṁ cāgnigocare \|\| 7.2,30.15

bhavodbhavastayormadhye kapālīśastataḥ param \|\| 7.2,30.15

tasminnāvaraṇe bhūyo vṛṣendraṁ purato yajet \|\| 7.2,30.16

naṁdinaṁ dakṣiṇe tasya mahākālaṁ tathottare \|\| 7.2,30.16

śāstāraṁ vahnidikpatre mātḥrdakṣiṇadigdale \|\| 7.2,30.17

gajāsyaṁ nairṛte patre ṣaṇmukhaṁ vāruṇe punaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.17

jyeṣṭhāṁ vāyudale gaurīmuttare caṁḍamaiśvare \|\| 7.2,30.18

śāstṛnandīśayormadhye munīndraṁ vṛṣabhaṁ yajet \|\| 7.2,30.18

mahākālasyottarataḥ piṁgalaṁ tu samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.19

śāstṛmātṛsamūhasya madhye bhṛṁgīśvaraṁ tataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.19

mātṛvighneśamadhye tu vīrabhadraṁ samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.20

skandavighneśayormadhye yajeddevīṁ sarasvatīm \|\| 7.2,30.20

jyeṣṭhākumārayormadhye śriyaṁ śivapadārcitām \|\| 7.2,30.21

jyeṣṭhāgaṇāmbayormadhye mahāmoṭīṁ samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.21

gaṇāmbācaṇḍayormadhye devīṁ durgāṁ prapūjayet \|\| 7.2,30.22

atraivāvaraṇe bhūyaḥ śivānucarasaṁhatim \|\| 7.2,30.22

rudraprathamabhūtākhyāṁ vividhāṁ ca saśaktikām \|\| 7.2,30.23

śivāyāśca sakhīvargaṁ japeddhyātvā samāhitaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.23

evaṁ tṛtīyāvaraṇe vitate pūjite sati \|\| 7.2,30.24

caturthāvaraṇaṁ dhyātvā bahistasya samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.24

bhānuḥ pūrvadale pūjyo dakṣiṇe caturānanaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.25

rudro varuṇadikpatre viṣṇuruttaradigdale \|\| 7.2,30.25

caturṇāmapi devānāṁ pṛthagāvaraṇānyatha \|\| 7.2,30.26

tasyāṁgāni ṣaḍevādau dīptādyābhiśca śaktibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,30.26

dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.27

amoghā vidyutā caiva pūrvādi paritaḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.27

dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyāścatasro mūrtayaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.28

pūrvādyuttaraparyaṁtāḥ śaktayaśca tataḥ param \|\| 7.2,30.28

ādityo bhāskaro bhānū raviścetyanupūrvaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.29

arko brahmā tathā rudro viṣṇuścaite vivasvataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.29

vistārā pūrvadigbhāge sutarāṁ dakṣiṇe sthitāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.30

bodhanī paścime bhāge āpyāyinyuttare punaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.30

uṣāṁ prabhāṁ tathā prājñāṁ sandhyāmapi tataḥ param \|\| 7.2,30.31

aiśānādiṣu vinyasya dvitīyāvaraṇe yajet \|\| 7.2,30.31

somamaṁgārakaṁ caiva budhaṁ buddhimatāṁ varam \|\| 7.2,30.32

bṛhaspatiṁ bṛhadbuddhiṁ bhārgavaṁ tejasāṁ nidhim \|\| 7.2,30.32

śanaiścaraṁ tathā rāhuṁ ketuṁ dhūmraṁ bhayaṁkaram \|\| 7.2,30.33

samaṁtato yajedetāṁstṛtīyāvaraṇe kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.33

athavā dvādaśādityā dvitīyāvaraṇe yajet \|\| 7.2,30.34

580

tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva rāśīndvādaśa pūjayet \|\| 7.2,30.34

saptasapta gaṇāṁścaiva bahistasya samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.35

ṛṣīndevāṁśca gaṁdharvānpannagānapsarogaṇān \|\| 7.2,30.35

grāmaṇyaśca tathā yakṣānyātudhānāṁstathā hayān \|\| 7.2,30.36

saptacchaṁdomayāṁścaiva vālakhilyāṁśca pūjayet \|\| 7.2,30.36

evaṁ tṛtīyāvaraṇe samabhyarcya divākaram \|\| 7.2,30.37

brahmāṇamarcayetpaścāttribhirāvaraṇaiḥ sahaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.37

hiraṇyagarbhaṁ pūrvasyāṁ virājaṁ dakṣiṇe tataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.38

kālaṁ paścimadigbhāge puruṣaṁ cottare yajet \|\| 7.2,30.38

hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prathamo brahmā kamalasannibhaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.39

kālo jātyaṁjanaprakhyaḥ puruṣaḥ sphaṭikopamaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.39

triguṇo rājasaścaiva tāmasaḥ sāttvikastathā \|\| 7.2,30.40

catvāra ete kramaśaḥ prathamāvaraṇe sthitāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.40

dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.41

sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanaṁdaśca sanātanaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.41

tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścādarcayecca prajāpatīn \|\| 7.2,30.42

aṣṭau pūrvāṁśca pūrvādau trīnprākpaścādanukramāt \|\| 7.2,30.42

dakṣo rucirbhṛguścaiva marīciśca tathāṁgirāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.43

pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kraturatriśca kaśyapaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.43

vasiṣṭhaśceti vikhyātāḥ prajānāṁ patayastvime \|\| 7.2,30.44

teṣāṁ bhāryāśca taissārdhaṁ pūjanīyā yathākramam \|\| 7.2,30.44

prasūtiśca tathā"kūtiḥ khyātiḥ sambhūtireva ca \|\| 7.2,30.45

dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ kṣamā caiva sannatiścānasūyakā \|\| 7.2,30.45

devamātārundhatī ca sarvāḥ khalu pativratāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.46

śivārcanarato nityaṁ śrīmatyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.46

prathamāvaraṇe vedāṁścaturo vā prapūjayet \|\| 7.2,30.47

itihāsapurāṇāni dvitīyāvaraṇe punaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.47

tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścāddharmaśāstrapurassarāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.48

vaidikyo nikhilā vidyāḥ pūjyā eva samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.48

pūrvādipurato vedāstadanye tu yathāruci \|\| 7.2,30.49

aṣṭadhā vā caturdhā vā kṛtvā pūjāṁ samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.49

evaṁ brahmāṇamabhyarcya tribhirāvaraṇairyutam \|\| 7.2,30.50

dakṣiṇe paścime paścādrudraṁ sāvaraṇaṁ yajet \|\| 7.2,30.50

tasya brahmaṣaḍaṁgāni prathamāvaraṇaṁ smṛtam \|\| 7.2,30.51

dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva vidyeśvaramayaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,30.51

tṛtīyāvaraṇe bhedo vidyate sa tu kathyate \|\| 7.2,30.52

catasro mūrtayastasya pūjyāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,30.52

triguṇāssakalo devaḥ purastācchivasaṁjñakaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.53

rājaso dakṣiṇe brahmā sṛṣṭikṛtpūjyate bhavaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.53

tāmasaḥ paścime cāgniḥ pūjyassaṁhārako haraḥ \|\| 7.2,30.54

sāttvikassukhakṛtsaumye viṣṇurviśvapatirmṛḍaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.54

evaṁ paścimadigbhāge śambhoḥ ṣaḍviṁśakaṁ śivam \|\| 7.2,30.55

samabhyarcyottare pārśve tato vaikuṁṭhamarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.55

vāsudevaṁ puraskṛtvā prathamāvaraṇe yajet \|\| 7.2,30.56

581

aniruddhaṁ dakṣiṇataḥ pradyumnaṁ paścime tataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.56

saumye saṁkarṣaṇaṁ paścādvyatyastau vā yajedimau \|\| 7.2,30.57

prathamāvaraṇaṁ proktaṁ dvitīyāvaraṇaṁ śubham \|\| 7.2,30.57

matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṁhotha vāmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.58

rāmaścānyatamaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavānaśvamukhopi ca \|\| 7.2,30.58

tṛtīyāvaraṇe cakruḥ pūrvabhāge samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.59

nārāyaṇākhyāṁ yāmyestraṁ kvacidavyāhataṁ yajet \|\| 7.2,30.59

paścime pāṁcajanyaṁ ca śārṅgaṁdhanurathottare \|\| 7.2,30.60

evaṁ tryāvaraṇaiḥ sākṣādviśvākhyāṁ paramaṁ harim \|\| 7.2,30.60

mahāviṣṇuṁ sadāviṣṇuṁ mūrtīkṛtya samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.61

itthaṁ viṣṇoścaturvyūhakramānmūrticatuṣṭayam \|\| 7.2,30.61

pūjayitvā ca tacchaktīścatasraḥ pujayetkramāt \|\| 7.2,30.61

prabhāmāgneyadigbhāge nairṛte tu sarasvatīm \|\| 7.2,30.62

gaṇāṁbikā ca vāyavye lakṣmīṁ raudre samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.62

evaṁ bhānvādimūrtīnāṁ tacchaktīnāmanaṁtaram \|\| 7.2,30.63

pūjāṁ vidhāya lokeśāṁstatraivāvaraṇe yajet \|\| 7.2,30.63

indramagniṁ yamaṁ caiva nirṛtiṁ varuṇaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,30.64

vāyuṁ somaṁ kuberaṁ ca paścādīśānamarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.64

evaṁ caturthāvaraṇaṁ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.65

āyudhāni maheśasya paścādbāṁhyaṁ samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.65

śrīmantriśūlamaiśāne vajraṁ māhendradiṅmukhe \|\| 7.2,30.66

paraśuṁ vahnidigbhāge yāmye sāyakamarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.66

nairṛte tu yajetkhaḍgaṁ pāśaṁ vāruṇagocare \|\| 7.2,30.67

aṁkuśaṁ mārute bhāge pinākaṁ cottare yajet \|\| 7.2,30.67

paścimābhimukhaṁ raudraṁ kṣetrapālaṁ samarcayet \|\| 7.2,30.68

pañcamāvaraṇaṁ caiva sampūjyānantaraṁ bahiḥ \|\| 7.2,30.68

sarvāvaraṇadevānāṁ bahirvā pañcame 'thavā \|\| 7.2,30.69

pañcame mātṛbhissārdhaṁ mahokṣa purato yajet \|\| 7.2,30.69

tataḥ samaṁtataḥ pūjyāssarvā vai devayonayaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.70

khecarā ṛṣayassiddhā daityā yakṣāśca rākṣasāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.70

anaṁtādyāśca nāgeṁdrā nāgaistattatkulodbhavaiḥ \|\| 7.2,30.71

ḍākinībhūtavetālapretabhairavanāyakāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.71

pātālavāsinaścānye nānāyonisamudbhavāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.72

nadyassamudrā girayaḥ kānanāni sarāṁsi ca \|\| 7.2,30.72

paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo vṛkṣāḥ kīṭādyāḥ kṣudrayonayaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.73

narāśca vividhākārā mṛgāśca kṣudrayonayaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.73

bhuvanānyantaraṇḍasya tato brahmāṇḍakoṭayaḥ \|\| 7.2,30.74

bahiraṁḍānyasaṁkhyāni bhuvanāni sahādhipaiḥ \|\| 7.2,30.74

brahmāṁḍādhārakā rudrā daśadikṣu vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 7.2,30.75

yadgauḍa yacca māmeyaṁ yadvā śāktaṁ tataḥ param \|\| 7.2,30.75

yatkiñcidasti śabdasya vācyaṁ cidacidātmakam \|\| 7.2,30.76

tatsarvaṁ śivayoḥ pārśve buddhvā sāmānyato yajet \|\| 7.2,30.76

kṛtāṁjalipuṭāḥ sarve 'ciṁtyāḥ smitamukhāstathā \|\| 7.2,30.77

581

prītyā saṁprekṣamāṇāśca devaṁ devīṁ ca sarvadā \|\| 7.2,30.77

itthamāvaraṇābhyarcāṁ kṛtvāvikṣepaśāṁtaye \|\| 7.2,30.78

punarabhyarcya deveśaṁ paktvākṣaramudīrayet \|\| 7.2,30.78

nivedayettataḥ paścācchivayoramṛtopamam \|\| 7.2,30.79

suvyañjanasamāyuktaṁ śuddhaṁ cāru mahācarum \|\| 7.2,30.79

dvātriṁśadāḍhakairmukhyamadhamaṁ tvāḍhakāvaram \|\| 7.2,30.80

sādhayitvā yathāsaṁpacchraddhayā vinivedayet \|\| 7.2,30.80

tato nivedya pānīyaṁ tāṁbūlaṁ copadaṁśakaiḥ \|\| 7.2,30.81

nīrājanādikaṁ kṛtvā pūjāśeṣaṁ samāpayet \|\| 7.2,30.81

bhogopayogyadravyāṇi viśiṣṭānyeva sādhayet \|\| 7.2,30.82

vittaśāṭhyaṁ na kurvīta bhaktimānvibhave sati \|\| 7.2,30.82

śaṭhasyopekṣakasyāpi vyaṁgyaṁ caivānutiṣṭhataḥ \|\| 7.2,30.83

na phalaṁtyeva karmāṇi kāmyānīti satāṁ kathā \|\| 7.2,30.83

siddhamantro 'pyadṛṣṭena prabalena tu kenacit \|\| 7.2,32.4
