tasya tu pratibandhasya kartuṁ śakyeha niṣkṛtiḥ \|\| 7.2,32.5

parīkṣya śakunādyaistadādau niṣkṛtimācaret \|\| 7.2,32.5

yo 'nyathā kurute mohātkarmaihikaphalaṁ naraḥ \|\| 7.2,32.6

na tena phalabhāksa syātprāpnuyāccopahāsyatām \|\| 7.2,32.6

abisrabdho na kurvīta karma dṛṣṭaphalaṁ kvacit \|\| 7.2,32.7

sa khalvaśraddhadhānaḥ syānnāśraddhaḥ phalamṛcchati \|\| 7.2,32.7

nāparādhosti devasya karmaṇyapi tu niṣphale \|\| 7.2,32.8

yathoktakāriṇāṁ puṁsāmihaiva phaladarśanāt \|\| 7.2,32.8

sādhakaḥ siddhamaṁtraśca nirastapratibaṁdhakaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.9

viśvastaḥ śraddhadhānaśca kurvannāpnoti tatphalam \|\| 7.2,32.9

athavā tatphalāvāptyai brahmacaryarato bhavet \|\| 7.2,32.10

rātrau haviṣyamaśnīyātpāyasaṁ vā phalāni vā \|\| 7.2,32.10

hiṁsādi yanniṣiddhaṁ syānna kuryānmanasāpi tat \|\| 7.2,32.11

sadā bhasmānuliptāṁ gassuveṣaśca śucirbhavet \|\| 7.2,32.11

itthamācāravānbhūtvā svānukūle śubhe 'hani \|\| 7.2,32.12

pūrvoktalakṣaṇe deśe puṣpadāmādyalaṁkṛte \|\| 7.2,32.12

ālipya śakṛtā 1 bhūmiṁ hastamānāvarāṁ yathā \|\| 7.2,32.13

vilikhetkamale bhadre dīpyamānaṁ svatejasā \|\| 7.2,32.13

taptajāṁbūnadamayamaṣṭapatraṁ sakesaram \|\| 7.2,32.14

madhye karṇikayā yuktaṁ sarvaratnairalaṁkṛtam \|\| 7.2,32.14

svākārasadṛśenaiva nālena ca samanvitam \|\| 7.2,32.15

tādṛśe svarṇanirmāṇe kaṁde samyagvidhānataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.15

tatrāṇimādikaṁ sarvaṁ saṁkalpya manasā punaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.16

ratnajaṁ vātha sauvarṇaṁ sphaṭikaṁ vā salakṣaṇam \|\| 7.2,32.16

liṅgaṁ savedikaṁ caiva sthāpayitvā vidhānataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.16

tatrāvāhya yajeddevaṁ sāṁbaṁ sagaṇamavyayam \|\| 7.2,32.17

tatra māheśvarī kalpyā mūrtirmūrtimataḥ prabhoḥ \|\| 7.2,32.17

1 goriti śeṣaḥ

587

caturbhujā caturvaktrā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā \|\| 7.2,32.18

śārdūlacarmavasanā kiṁcidvihasitānanā \|\| 7.2,32.18

varadābhayahastā ca mṛgaṭaṁkadharā tathā \|\| 7.2,32.19

atha vāṣṭabhujā ciṁtyā ciṁtakasya yathāruci \|\| 7.2,32.19

tadā triśūlaparaśukhaḍgavajrāṇi dakṣiṇe \|\| 7.2,32.20

vāme pāśāṁkuśau tadvatkheṭaṁ nāgaṁ ca bibhratī \|\| 7.2,32.20

bālārkasadṛśaprakhyā prativaktraṁ trilocanā \|\| 7.2,32.21

tasyāḥ pūrvamukhaṁ saumyaṁ svākārasadṛśaprabham \|\| 7.2,32.21

dakṣiṇaṁ nīlajīmūtasadṛśaṁ ghoradarśanam \|\| 7.2,32.22

uttaraṁ vidrumaprakhyaṁ nīlālakavibhūṣitam \|\| 7.2,32.22

paścimaṁ pūrṇacaṁdrābhaṁ saumyamiṁdukalādharam \|\| 7.2,32.23

tadaṁkamaṁḍalārūḍhā śaktirmāheśvarī parā \|\| 7.2,32.23

mahālakṣmīriti khyātā śyāmā sarvamanoharā \|\| 7.2,32.24

mūrtiṁ kṛtvaivamākārāṁ sakalīkṛtya ca kramāt \|\| 7.2,32.24

mūrtimaṁtamathāvāhya yajetparamakāraṇam \|\| 7.2,32.25

snānārthe kalpayettatra pañcagavyaṁ tu kāpilam \|\| 7.2,32.25

pañcāmṛtaṁ ca pūrṇāni bījāni ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.26

purastānmaṇḍalaṁ kṛtvā ratnacūrṇādyalaṁkṛtam \|\| 7.2,32.26

karṇikāyāṁ pravinyasyedīśānakalaśaṁ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.27

sadyādikalaśānpaścātparitastasya kalpayet \|\| 7.2,32.27

tato vidyeśakalaśānaṣṭau pūrvādivatkramāt \|\| 7.2,32.28

tīrthāmbupūritānkṛtvā sūtreṇāveṣṭya pūrvavat \|\| 7.2,32.28

puṇyadravyāṇi nikṣipya samantraṁ savidhānakam \|\| 7.2,32.29

dukūlādyena vastreṇa samācchādya samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.29

sarvatra maṁtraṁ vinyasya tattanmaṁtrapurassaram \|\| 7.2,32.30

snānakāle tu saṁprāpte sarvamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ \|\| 7.2,32.30

pañcagavyādibhiścaiva snāpayetparameśvaram \|\| 7.2,32.31

tataḥ kuśodakādyāni svarṇaratnodakānyapi \|\| 7.2,32.31

gaṁdhapuṣpādisiddhāni mantrasiddhāni ca kramāt \|\| 7.2,32.32

uddhṛtyoddhṛtya mantreṇa taistaissnāpya maheśvaram \|\| 7.2,32.32

gaṁdhaṁ puṣpādidīpāṁśca pūjākarma samācaret \|\| 7.2,32.33

palāvaraḥ syādālepa ekādaśapalottaraḥ \|\| 7.2,32.33

suvarṇaratnapuṣpāṇi śubhāni surabhīṇi ca \|\| 7.2,32.34

nīlotpalādyutpalāni bilvapatrāṇyanekaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.34

kamalāni ca raktāni śvetānyapi ca śaṁbhave \|\| 7.2,32.35

kṛṣṇāgurūdbhavo dhūpaḥ sakarpūrājyaguggulaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.35

kapilāghṛtasaṁsiddhā dīpāḥ karpūravartijāḥ \|\| 7.2,32.36

pañcabrahmaṣaḍaṁgāni pūjyānyāvaraṇāni ca \|\| 7.2,32.36

naivedyaḥ payasā siddhaḥ sa guḍājyo mahācaruḥ \|\| 7.2,32.37

pāṭalotpalapadmādyaiḥ pānīyaṁ ca sugandhitam \|\| 7.2,32.37

pañcasaugaṁdhikopetaṁ tāṁbūlaṁ ca susaṁskṛtam \|\| 7.2,32.38

suvarṇaratnasiddhāni bhūṣaṇāni viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.38

587

vāsāṁsi ca vicitrāṇi sūkṣmāṇi ca navāni ca \|\| 7.2,32.39

darśanīyāni deyāni gānavādyādibhissaha \|\| 7.2,32.39

japaśca mūlamaṁtrasya lakṣaḥ paramasaṁkhyayā \|\| 7.2,32.40

ekāvarā tryuttarā ca pūjā phalavaśādiha \|\| 7.2,32.40

daśasaṁkhyāvaro homaḥ pratidravyaṁ śatottaraḥ \|\| 7.2,32.41

ghorarūpaśśivaściṁtyo māraṇoccāṭanādiṣu \|\| 7.2,32.41

śivaliṁge śivāgnau ca hyanyāsu pratimāsu ca \|\| 7.2,32.42

ciṁtyassaumyatanuśśaṁbhuḥ kārye śāṁtikapauṣṭike \|\| 7.2,32.42

āyasau sruksruvau kāryau māraṇādiṣu karmasu \|\| 7.2,32.43

tadanyatra tu sauvarṇau śāṁtikādyeṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.43

dūrvayā ghṛtagokṣīramiśrayā madhunā tathā \|\| 7.2,32.44

caruṇā saghṛtenaiva kevalaṁ payasāpi vā \|\| 7.2,32.44

juhuyānmṛtyuvijaye tilai rogopaśāṁtaye \|\| 7.2,32.45

ghṛtena payasā caiva kamalairvātha kevalaiḥ \|\| 7.2,32.45

samṛddhikāmo juhuyānmahādāridryaśāṁtaye \|\| 7.2,32.46

jātīpuṣpeṇa vaśyārthī juhuyātsaghṛtena tu \|\| 7.2,32.46

ghṛtena karavīraiśca kuryādākarṣaṇaṁ dvijaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.47

tailenoccāṭanaṁ kuryātstaṁbhanaṁ madhunā punaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.47

staṁbhanaṁ sarṣapeṇāpi laśunena tu pātanam \|\| 7.2,32.48

tāḍanaṁ rudhireṇa syātkharasyoṣṭrasya cobhayoḥ \|\| 7.2,32.48

māraṇoccāṭane kuryādrohibījaistilānvitaiḥ \|\| 7.2,32.49

vidveṣaṇaṁ ca tailena kuryāllāṁgalakasya tu \|\| 7.2,32.49

baṁdhanaṁ rohibījena senāstaṁbhanameva ca \|\| 7.2,32.50

raktasarṣapasaṁmiśrairhomadravyairaśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.50

hastayaṁtrodbhavaistailairjuhuyādābhicārike \|\| 7.2,32.51

kaṭukītuṣasaṁyuktaiḥ kārpāsāsthibhireva ca \|\| 7.2,32.51

sarṣapaistailasaṁmiśrairjuhuyādābhicārike \|\| 7.2,32.52

jvaropaśāṁtidaṁ kṣīraṁ saubhāgyaphaladaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,32.52

sarvasiddhikaro homaḥ kṣaudrājyadadhibhiryutaiḥ \|\| 7.2,32.53

kṣīreṇa taṁdulaiścaiva caruṇā kevalena vā \|\| 7.2,32.53

śāṁtikaṁ pauṣṭikaṁ vāpi saptabhiḥ samidādibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,32.54

dravyairviśeṣato home vaśyamākarṣaṇaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,32.54

vaśyamākarṣaṇaṁ caiva śrīpadaṁ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.55

bilvapatraistu havanaṁ śatrorvijayadaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,32.55

samidhaḥ śāṁtikāryeṣu pālāśakhadirādikāḥ \|\| 7.2,32.56

karavīrārkajāḥ kraurye kaṇṭakinyaśca vigrahe \|\| 7.2,32.56

praśāṁtaḥ śāṁtikaṁ kuryātpauṣṭikaṁ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.57

nirghṛṇaḥ kruddhacittastu prakuryādābhicārikam \|\| 7.2,32.57

atīvaduravasthāyāṁ pratīkārāṁtaraṁ na cet \|\| 7.2,32.58

ātatāyinamuddiśya prakuryādābhicārikam \|\| 7.2,32.58

svarāṣṭrapatimuddiśya na kuryādābhicārikam \|\| 7.2,32.59

yadyāstikassudharmiṣṭho mānyo vā yo 'pi kopi vā \|\| 7.2,32.59

tamuddiśyāpi no kuryādātatāyinamapyuta \|\| 7.2,32.60

manasā karmaṇā vācā yo 'pi kopi śivāśritaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.60

588

svarāṣṭrapatimuddiśya śivā śritamathāpi vā \|\| 7.2,32.61

kṛtvābhicārikaṁ karma sadyo vinipatennaraḥ \|\| 7.2,32.61

svarāṣṭrapālakaṁ tasmācchivabhaktaṁ ca kañcana \|\| 7.2,32.62

na hiṁsyādabhicārādyairyadīcchetsukhamātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.62

anyaṁ kamapi coddiśya kṛtvā vai māraṇādikam \|\| 7.2,32.63

paścāttāpena saṁyuktaḥ prāyaścittaṁ samācaret \|\| 7.2,32.63

bāṇaliṁge 'pi vā kuryānnirdhano dhanavānapi \|\| 7.2,32.64

svayaṁbhūte 'tha vā liṁge ārṣake vaidike 'pi vā \|\| 7.2,32.64

abhāve hemaratnānāmaśaktau ca tadarjane \|\| 7.2,32.65

manasaivācaredetaddravyairvā pratirūpakaiḥ \|\| 7.2,32.65

kvacidaṁśe tu yaḥ śaktastvaśaktaḥ kvacidaṁśake \|\| 7.2,32.66

so 'pi śaktyanusāreṇa kurvaṁścetphalamṛcchati \|\| 7.2,32.66

karmaṇyanuṣṭhite 'pyasminphalaṁ yatra na dṛśyate \|\| 7.2,32.67

dvistrirvāvartayettatra sarvathā dṛśyate phalam \|\| 7.2,32.67

pūjopayuktaṁ yaddravyaṁ hemaratnādyanuttamam \|\| 7.2,32.68

tatsarvaṁ gurave dadyāddakṣiṇāṁ ca tataḥ pṛthak \|\| 7.2,32.68

sa cennecchati tatsarvaṁ śivāya vinivedayet \|\| 7.2,32.69

athavā śivabhaktebhyo nānyebhyastu pradīyate \|\| 7.2,32.69

yaḥ svayaṁ sādhayecchaktyā gurvādinirapekṣayā \|\| 7.2,32.70

so 'pyevamācaredatra na gṛhṇīyātsvayaṁ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.70

svayaṁ gṛhṇāti yo lobhātpūjāṁgadravyamuttamam \|\| 7.2,32.71

kāṁkṣitaṁ na labhenmūḍho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 7.2,32.71

arcitaṁ yattu talliṁgaṁ gṛhṇīyādvā navā svayam \|\| 7.2,32.72

gṛhṇīyādyadi tannityaṁ svayaṁ vānyo 'pi vārcayet \|\| 7.2,32.72

yathoktameva karmaitadācaredyo 'napāyataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.73

phalaṁ vyabhicarennaivamityataḥ kiṁ prarocakam \|\| 7.2,32.73

tathāpyuddeśato vakṣye karmaṇaḥ siddhimuttamam \|\| 7.2,32.74

api śatrubhirākrāṁto vyādhibhirvāpyanekaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.74

mṛtyorāsyagataścāpi mucyate nirapāyataḥ \|\| 7.2,32.75

pūjāyate 'tikṛpaṇo rikto vaiśravaṇāyate \|\| 7.2,32.75

kāmāyate virūpo 'pi vṛddho 'pi taruṇāyate \|\| 7.2,32.76

śatrurmitrāyate sadyo virodhī kiṁkarāyate \|\| 7.2,32.76

viṣāyate yadamṛtaṁ viṣamapyamṛtāyate \|\| 7.2,32.77

sthalāyate samudro 'pi sthalamapyarṇavāyate \|\| 7.2,32.77

mahīdharāyate śvabhraṁ sa ca śvabhrāyate giriḥ \|\| 7.2,32.78

padmākarāyate vahniḥ saro vaiśvānarāyate \|\| 7.2,32.78

vanāyate yadudyānaṁ tadudyānāyate vanam \|\| 7.2,32.79

siṁhāyate mṛgaḥ kṣudraḥ siṁhaḥ krīḍāmṛgāyate \|\| 7.2,32.79

striyo 'bhisārikāyante lakṣmīḥ sucaritāyate \|\| 7.2,32.80

svairapreṣyāyate vāṇī kīrtistu gaṇikāyate \|\| 7.2,32.80

svairācārāyate medhā vajrasūcīyate manaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.81

mahāvātāyate śaktirbalaṁ mattagajāyate \|\| 7.2,32.81

588

stambhāyate samudyogaiḥ śatrupakṣe sthitā kriyā \|\| 7.2,32.82

śatrupakṣāyate 'rīṇāṁ sarva eva suhṛjjanaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.82

śatravaḥ kuṇapāyante jīvantopi sabāṁdhavāḥ \|\| 7.2,32.83

āpanno 'pi gatāriṣṭaḥ svayaṁ khalvamṛtāyate \|\| 7.2,32.83

rasāya nāyate nityamapathyamapi sevitam \|\| 7.2,32.84

aniśaṁ kriyamāṇāpi ratistvabhinavāyate \|\| 7.2,32.84

anāgatādikaṁ sarvaṁ karasthāmalakāyate \|\| 7.2,32.85

yādṛcchikaphalāyante siddhayo 'pyaṇimādayaḥ \|\| 7.2,32.85

bahunātra kimuktena sarvakāmārthasiddhiṣu \|\| 7.2,32.86

asminkarmaṇi nirvṛtte tvanavāpyaṁ na vidyate \|\| 7.2,32.86

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe aihikasiddhikarmavarṇanaṁ nāma dvātriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 33

upamanyuruvāca

ataḥ paraṁ pravakṣyāmi kevalāmuṣmikaṁ vidhim \|\| 7.2,33.1

naitena sadṛśaṁ kiṁcitkarmāsti bhuvanatraye \|\| 7.2,33.1

puṇyātiśayasaṁyuktaḥ sarvairdevairanuṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 7.2,33.2

brahmaṇā viṣṇunā caiva rudreṇa ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,33.2

iṁdrādilokapāraiśca sūryādyairnavabhirgrahaiḥ \|\| 7.2,33.3

viśvāmitravasiṣṭhādyairbrahmavidbhirmaharṣibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,33.3

śvetāgastyadadhīcādyairasmābhiśca śivāśritaiḥ \|\| 7.2,33.4

naṁdīśvaramahākālabhṛṁgīśādyairgaṇeśvaraiḥ \|\| 7.2,33.4

pātālavāsibhirdaityaiḥ śeṣādyaiśca mahoragaiḥ \|\| 7.2,33.5

siddhairyakṣaiśca gaṁdharvai rakṣobhūtapiśācakaiḥ \|\| 7.2,33.5

svaṁsvaṁ padamanuprāptaṁ sarvairayamanuṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 7.2,33.6

anena vidhinā sarve devā devatvamāgatāḥ \|\| 7.2,33.6

brahmā brahmatvamāpanno viṣṇurviṣṇutvamāgataḥ \|\| 7.2,33.7

rudro rudratvamāpanna iṁdraścendratvamāgataḥ \|\| 7.2,33.7

gaṇeśaśca gaṇeśatvamanena vidhinā gataḥ \|\| 7.2,33.8

sitacaṁdanatoyena liṁgaṁ snāpya śivaṁ śivām \|\| 7.2,33.8

śvetairvikasitaiḥ padmaiḥ saṁpūjya praṇipatya ca \|\| 7.2,33.8

tatra padmāsanaṁ ramyaṁ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasaṁyutam \|\| 7.2,33.9

vibhave sati hemādyai ratnādyairvā svaśaktitaḥ \|\| 7.2,33.9

madhye kesarajālāsya sthāpya liṁgaṁ kanīyasam \|\| 7.2,33.10

aṁguṣṭhapratimaṁ ramyaṁ sarvagandhamayaṁ śubham \|\| 7.2,33.10

dakṣiṇe sthāpayitvā tu bilvapatraiḥ samarcayet \|\| 7.2,33.11

aguruṁ dakṣiṇe pārśve paścime tu manaḥśilām \|\| 7.2,33.11

uttare caṁdanaṁ dadyāddharitālaṁ tu pūrvataḥ \|\| 7.2,33.12

sugandhaiḥ kusumai ramyairvicitraiścāpi pūjayet \|\| 7.2,33.12

dhūpaṁ kṛṣṇāguruṁ dadyātsarvataśca saguggulam \|\| 7.2,33.13

vāsāṁsi cātisūkṣmāṇi vikāśāni nivedayet \|\| 7.2,33.13

pāyasaṁ ghṛtasaṁmiśraṁ ghṛtadīpāṁśca dāpayet \|\| 7.2,33.14

sarvaṁ nivedya mantreṇa tato gacchetpradakṣiṇām \|\| 7.2,33.14

praṇamya bhaktyā deveśaṁ stutvā cānte kṣamāpayet \|\| 7.2,33.15

sarvopahārasaṁmiśraṁ tato liṁgaṁ nivedayet \|\| 7.2,33.15

śivāya śivamantreṇa dakṣiṇāmūrtimāśritaḥ \|\| 7.2,33.16

evaṁ yo 'rcayate nityaṁ pañcagandhamayaṁ śubham \|\| 7.2,33.16

589

sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate \|\| 7.2,33.17

etadvratottamaṁ guhyaṁ śivaliṁgamahāvratam \|\| 7.2,33.17

bhaktasya te samākhyātaṁ na deyaṁ yasya kasyacit \|\| 7.2,33.18

deyaṁ ca śivabhaktebhyaḥ śivena kathitaṁ purā \|\| 7.2,33.18

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe āmuṣmikakarmavidhivarṇanaṁ nāma trayastriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 34

upamanyuruvāca

nityanaimittikātkāmyādyā siddhiriha kīrtitā \|\| 7.2,34.1

sā sarvā labhyeta sadyo liṁgaberapratiṣṭhayā \|\| 7.2,34.1

sarvo liṁgamayo lokassarvaṁ liṁge pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 7.2,34.2

tasmātpratiṣṭhite liṁge bhavetsarvaṁ patiṣṭhitam \|\| 7.2,34.2

brahmaṇā viṣṇunā vāpi rudreṇānyena kena vā \|\| 7.2,34.3

liṁgapratiṣṭhāmutsṛjya kriyate svapadasthitiḥ \|\| 7.2,34.3

kimanyadiha vaktavyaṁ pratiṣṭhāṁ prati kāraṇam \|\| 7.2,34.4

partiṣṭhitaṁ śivenāpi liṁgaṁ vaiśveśvaraṁ yataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.4

tasmātsarvaprayatnena paratreha ca śarmaṇe \|\| 7.2,34.5

sthāpayetparameśasya liṁgaṁ beramathāpi vā \|\| 7.2,34.5

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca

kimidaṁ liṁgamākhyātaṁ kathaṁ liṁgī maheśvaraḥ \|\| 7.2,34.6

kathaṁ ca liṁgabhāvo 'sya kasmādasmiñchivo 'rcyate \|\| 7.2,34.6

upamanyuruvāca

avyaktaṁ liṁgamākhyātaṁ triguṇaprabhavāpyayam \|\| 7.2,34.7

anādyanaṁtaṁ viśvasya yadupādānakāraṇam \|\| 7.2,34.7

tadeva mūlaprakṛtirmāyā ca gaganātmikā \|\| 7.2,34.8

tata eva samutpannaṁ jagadetaccarācaram \|\| 7.2,34.8

aśuddhaṁ caiva śuddhaṁ yacchuddhāśuddhaṁ ca tattridhā \|\| 7.2,34.9

tataḥ śivo maheśaśca rudro viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.9

bhūtāni cendriyairjātā līyante 'tra śivājñayā \|\| 7.2,34.10

ata eva śivo liṁgo liṁgamājñāpayedyataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.10

yato na tadanājñātaṁ kāryāya prabhavetsvataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.11

tato jātasya viśvasya tatraiva vilayo yataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.11

anena liṁgatāṁ tasya bhavennānyena kenacit \|\| 7.2,34.12

liṁgaṁ ca śivayordehastābhyāṁ yasmādadhiṣṭhitam \|\| 7.2,34.12

atastatra śivaḥ sāmbo nityameva samarcayet \|\| 7.2,34.13

liṁgavedī mahādevī liṁgaṁ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ \|\| 7.2,34.13

tayoḥ saṁpūjanādeva sa ca sā ca samarcitau \|\| 7.2,34.14

na tayorliṁgadehatvaṁ vidyate paramārthataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.14

yatastvetau viśuddhau tau dehastadupacārataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.15

tadeva paramā śaktiḥ śivasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.15

śaktirājñāṁ yadādatte prasūte taccarācaram \|\| 7.2,34.16

na tasya mahimā śakyo vaktuṁ varṣaśatairapi \|\| 7.2,34.16

yenādau mohitau syātāṁ brahmanārāyaṇāvapi \|\| 7.2,34.17

purā tribhuvanasyāsya pralaye samupasthite \|\| 7.2,34.17

vāriśayyāgato viṣṇuḥ suṣvāpānākulaḥ sukham \|\| 7.2,34.18

589

yadṛcchayā gatastatra brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.18

dadarśa puṇḍarīkākṣaṁ svapantaṁ tamanākulam \|\| 7.2,34.19

māyayā mohitaḥ śambhorviṣṇumāha pitāmahaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.19

kastvaṁ vadetyamarṣeṇa prahṛtyotthāpya mādhavam \|\| 7.2,34.20

sa tu hastaprahāreṇa tīvreṇābhihataḥ kṣaṇāt \|\| 7.2,34.20

prabuddhotthāya śayanāddadarśa parameṣṭhinam \|\| 7.2,34.21

tamāha cāṁtassaṁkruddhaḥ svayamakruddhavaddhariḥ \|\| 7.2,34.21

kutastvamāgato vatsa kasmāttvaṁ vyākulo vada \|\| 7.2,34.22

iti viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā prabhutvaguṇasūcakam \|\| 7.2,34.22

rajasā baddhavairastaṁ brahmā punarabhāṣata \|\| 7.2,34.23

vatseti māṁ kuto brūṣe guruḥ śiṣyamivātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.23

māṁ na jānāsi kiṁ nāthaṁ prapañco yasya me kṛtiḥ \|\| 7.2,34.24

tridhātmānaṁ vibhajyedaṁ sṛṣṭvātha paripālyate \|\| 7.2,34.24

saṁharāmi name kaścitsraṣṭā jagati vidyate \|\| 7.2,34.25

ityukte sati so 'pyāha brahmāṇaṁ viṣṇuravyayaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.25

ahamevādikartāsya hartā ca paripālakaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.26

bhavānapi mamaivāṁgādavatīrṇaḥ purāvyayāt \|\| 7.2,34.26

manniyogāttvamātmānaṁ tridhā kṛtvā jagattrayam \|\| 7.2,34.27

sṛjasyavasi cāṁte tatpunaḥ pratisṛjasyapi \|\| 7.2,34.27

vismṛtosi jagannāthaṁ nārāyaṇamanāmayam \|\| 7.2,34.28

tavāpi janakaṁ sākṣānmāmevamavamanyase \|\| 7.2,34.28

tavāparādho nāstyatra bhrāṁtosi mama māyayā \|\| 7.2,34.29

matprasādādiyaṁ bhrāṁtirapaiṣyati tavācirāt \|\| 7.2,34.29

śṛṇu satyaṁ caturvaktra sarvadeveśvaro hyaham \|\| 7.2,34.30

kartā bhartā ca hartā ca na mayāsti samo vibhuḥ \|\| 7.2,34.30

evameva vivādobhūdbrahmaviṣṇvoḥ parasparam \|\| 7.2,34.31

abhavacca mahāyuddhaṁ bhairavaṁ romaharṣaṇam \|\| 7.2,34.31

muṣṭibhirnnighnatostīvraṁ rajasā baddhavairayoḥ \|\| 7.2,34.32

tayordarpāpahārāya prabodhāya ca devayoḥ \|\| 7.2,34.32

madhye samāvirabhavalliṁgamaiśvaramadbhutam \|\| 7.2,34.33

jvālāmālāsahasrāḍhyamaprameyamanaupamam \|\| 7.2,34.33

kṣayavṛddhivinirmuktamādimadhyāṁtavarjitam \|\| 7.2,34.34

tasya jvālāsahasreṇa brahmaviṣṇū vimohitau \|\| 7.2,34.34

visṛjya yuddhaṁ kiṁ tvetadityaciṁtayatāṁ tadā \|\| 7.2,34.35

na tayostasya yāthātmyaṁ prabuddhamabhavadyadā \|\| 7.2,34.35

tadā samudyatau syātāṁ tasyādyaṁtaṁ parīkṣitum \|\| 7.2,34.36

tatra haṁsākṛtirbrahmā viśvataḥ pakṣasaṁyutaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.37

manonilajavo bhūtvā gatastūrdhvaṁ prayatnataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.37

nārāyaṇopi viśvātmā līlāñjanacayopamam \|\| 7.2,34.38

vārāhamamitaṁ rūpamasthāya gatavānadhaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.38

evaṁ varṣasahasraṁ tu tvaran viṣṇuradhogataḥ \|\| 7.2,34.39

nāpaśyadalpamapyasya mūlaṁ liṁgasya sūkaraḥ \|\| 7.2,34.39

tāvatkālaṁ gataścordhvaṁ tasyāṁtaṁ jñātumicchayā \|\| 7.2,34.40

śrāṁtotyaṁtamadṛṣṭvāṁtaṁ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.40

590

tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṁtaḥ saṁvignalocanaḥ \|\| 7.2,34.41

kleśena mahatā tūrṇamadhastādutthito 'bhavat \|\| 7.2,34.41

samāgatāvathānyonyaṁ vismayasmeravīkṣaṇau \|\| 7.2,34.42

māyayā mohitau śaṁbhoḥ kṛtyākṛtyaṁ na jagmatuḥ \|\| 7.2,34.42

pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvatastasya cāgrataśca sthitāvubhau \|\| 7.2,34.43

praṇipatya kimātmedamityaciṁtayatāṁ tadā \|\| 7.2,34.43

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe harividhimohavarṇanaṁ nāma catustriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 35

upamanyuruvāca

athāvirabhavattatra sanādaṁ śabdalakṣaṇam \|\| 7.2,35.1

omityekākṣaraṁ brahma brahmaṇaḥ pratipādakam \|\| 7.2,35.1

tadapyaviditaṁ tāvadbrahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā \|\| 7.2,35.2

rajasā tamasā cittaṁ tayoryasmāttiraskṛtam \|\| 7.2,35.2

tadā vibhaktamabhavaccaturdhaikaṁ tadakṣaram \|\| 7.2,35.3

a u meti trimātrābhiḥ parastāccārdhamātrayā \|\| 7.2,35.3

tatrākāraḥ śrito bhāge jvalalliṁgasya dakṣiṇe \|\| 7.2,35.4

ukāraścottare tadvanmakārastasya madhyataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.4

ardhamātrātmako nādaḥ śrūyate liṁgamūrdhani \|\| 7.2,35.5

vibhakte 'pi tadā tasminpraṇave paramākṣare \|\| 7.2,35.5

vibhāvārthaṁ ca tau devau na kiṁcidavajagmatuḥ \|\| 7.2,35.6

vedātmanā tadāvyaktaḥ praṇavo vikṛtiṁ gataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.6

tatrākāro ṛgabhavadukāro yajuravyayaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.7

makārassāma saṁjāto nādastvātharvaṇī śrutiḥ \|\| 7.2,35.7

ṛgayaṁ sthāpayāmāsa samāsāttvarthamātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.8

rajoguṇeṣu brahmāṇaṁ mūrtiṣvādyaṁ kriyāsvapi \|\| 7.2,35.8

sṛṣṭiṁ lokeṣu pṛthivīṁ tattveṣvātmānamavyayam \|\| 7.2,35.9

kalādhvani nivṛttiṁ ca sadyaṁ brahmasu pañcasu \|\| 7.2,35.9

liṁgabhāgeṣvadhobhāgaṁ bījākhyaṁ kāraṇatraye \|\| 7.2,35.10

catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇaiśvaryaṁ bauddhaṁ yadaṇimādiṣu \|\| 7.2,35.10

taditthamarthairdaśabhirvyāptaṁ viśvamṛcā jagat \|\| 7.2,35.11

athopasthāpayāmāsa svārthaṁ daśavidhaṁ yajuḥ \|\| 7.2,35.11

sattvaṁ guṇeṣu viṣṇuṁ ca mūrtiṣvādyaṁ kriyāsvapi \|\| 7.2,35.12

sthitiṁ lokeṣvaṁtarikṣaṁ vidyāṁ tattveṣu ca triṣu \|\| 7.2,35.12

kalādhvasu pratiṣṭhāṁ ca vāmaṁ brahmasu pañcasu \|\| 7.2,35.13

madhyaṁ tu liṁgabhāgeṣu yoniṁ ca triṣu hetuṣu \|\| 7.2,35.13

prākṛtaṁ ca yathaiśvaryaṁ tasmādviśvaṁ yajurmayam \|\| 7.2,35.14

tatopasthāpayāmāsa sāmārthaṁ daśadhātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.14

tamoguṇeṣvatho rudraṁ mūrtiṣvādyaṁ kriyāsu ca \|\| 7.2,35.15

saṁhṛtiṁ triṣu lokeṣu tattveṣu śivamuttamam \|\| 7.2,35.15

vidyākalāsvaghoraṁ ca tathā brahmasu pañcasu \|\| 7.2,35.16

liṁgabhāgeṣu pīṭhordhvaṁ bījinaṁ kāraṇatraye \|\| 7.2,35.16

pauruṣaṁ ca tathaiśvaryamitthaṁ sāmnā tataṁ jagat \|\| 7.2,35.17

athātharvāha nairguṇyamarthaṁ prathamamātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.17

tato maheśvaraṁ sākṣānmūrtiṣvapi sadāśivam \|\| 7.2,35.18

590

kriyāsu niṣkriyasyāpi śivasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.18

bhūtānugrahaṇaṁ caiva mucyaṁte yena jaṁtavaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.19

lokeṣvapi yato vāco nivṛttā manasā saha \|\| 7.2,35.19

tadūrdhvamunmanā lokātsomalokamalaukikam \|\| 7.2,35.20

somassahomayā yatra nityaṁ nivasatīśvaraḥ \|\| 7.2,35.20

tadūrdhvamunmanā lokādyaṁ prāpto na nivartate \|\| 7.2,35.21

śāṁtiṁ ca śāṁtyatītāṁ ca vyāpikāṁ cai kalāsvapi \|\| 7.2,35.21

tatpūruṣaṁ tatheśānaṁ brahma brahmasu pañcasu \|\| 7.2,35.22

mūrdhānamapi liṁgasya nādabhāgeṣvanuttamam \|\| 7.2,35.22

yatrāvāhya samārādhyaḥ kevalo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.23

tatteṣvapi tadā biṁdornādācchaktestataḥ parāt \|\| 7.2,35.23

tattvādapi paraṁ tattvamatattvaṁ paramārthataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.24

kāraṇeṣu trayātītānmāyāvikṣobhakāraṇāt \|\| 7.2,35.24

anaṁtācchuddhavidyāyāḥ parastācca maheśvarāt \|\| 7.2,35.25

sarvavidyeśvarādhīśānna parācca sadāśivāt \|\| 7.2,35.25

sarvamaṁtratanordevācchaktitrayasamanvitāt \|\| 7.2,35.26

pañcavaktrāddaśabhujātsākṣātsakalaniṣkalāt \|\| 7.2,35.26

tasmādapi parādbiṁdorardhedośca tataḥ parāt \|\| 7.2,35.27

tataḥ parānniśādhīśānnādākhyācca tataḥ parāt \|\| 7.2,35.27

tataḥ parātsuṣumneśādbrahmaraṁdhreśvarādapi \|\| 7.2,35.28

tataḥ parasmācchakteśca parastācchivatattvataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.28

paramaṁ kāraṇaṁ sākṣātsvayaṁ niṣkāraṇaṁ śivam \|\| 7.2,35.29

kāraṇānāṁ ca dhātāraṁ dhyātārāṁ dhyeyamavyayam \|\| 7.2,35.29

paramākāśamadhyasthaṁ paramātmopari sthitaṁ \|\| 7.2,35.30

sarvaiśvaryeṇa saṁpannaṁ sarveśvaramanīśvaram \|\| 7.2,35.30

aiśvaryāccāpi māyeyādaśuddhānmānuṣādikāt \|\| 7.2,35.31

aparācca parāttyājyādadhiśuddhādhvagocarāt \|\| 7.2,35.31

tatparācchuddhavidyādyādunmanāṁtātparātparāt \|\| 7.2,35.32

paramaṁ paramaiśvaryamunmanādyamanādi ca \|\| 7.2,35.32

apāramaparādhīnaṁ nirastātiśayaṁ sthiram \|\| 7.2,35.33

itthamarthairdaśavidhairiyamātharvaṇī śrutiḥ \|\| 7.2,35.33

yasmādgarīyasī tasmādviśvaṁ vyāptamatharvaṇāt \|\| 7.2,35.34

ṛgvedaḥ punarāhedaṁ jāgradrūpaṁ mayocyate \|\| 7.2,35.34

yenāhamātmatattvasya nityamasmyabhidhāyakaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.35

yajurvedo 'vadattadvatsvapnāvasthā mayocyate \|\| 7.2,35.35

bhogyātmanā pariṇatā vidyāvedyā yato mayi \|\| 7.2,35.36

sāma cāha suṣuptyākhyamevaṁ sarvaṁ mayocyate \|\| 7.2,35.36

mamārthena śivenedaṁ tāmasenābhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,35.37

atharvāha turāyākhyaṁ turīyātītameva ca \|\| 7.2,35.37

mayābhidhīyate tasmādadhvātītapadosmyaham \|\| 7.2,35.38

adhvātmakaṁ tu tritayaṁ śivavidyātmasaṁjñitam \|\| 7.2,35.38

tattraiguṇyaṁ trayīsādhyaṁ saṁśodhyaṁ ca padaiṣiṇā \|\| 7.2,35.39

591

adhvātītaṁ turīyākhyaṁ nirvāṇaṁ paramaṁ padam \|\| 7.2,35.39

tadatītaṁ ca nairguṇyādadhvanosya viśodhakam \|\| 7.2,35.40

dvayoḥ pramāpako nādo nadāṁtaśca madātmakaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.40

tasmānmamārthasvātaṁtryātpradhānaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 7.2,35.41

yadasti vastu tatsarvaṁ guṇapradhānyayogataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.41

samastaṁ vyastamapi ca praṇavārthaṁ pracakṣate \|\| 7.2,35.42

savārthavācakaṁ tasmādekaṁ brahmaitadakṣaram \|\| 7.2,35.42

tenomiti jagatkṛtsnaṁ kurute prathamaṁ śivaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.43

śivo hi praṇavo hyeṣa praṇavo hi śivaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.43

vācyavācakayorbhedo nātyaṁtaṁ vidyate yataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.44

ciṁtayā rahito rudro vācoyanmanasā saha \|\| 7.2,35.44

aprāpya tannivartaṁte vācyastvekākṣareṇa saḥ \|\| 7.2,35.45

ekākṣarādakārākhyādātmā brahmābhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,35.45

ekākṣarādukārākhyāddvidhā viṣṇurudīryate \|\| 7.2,35.46

ekākṣarānmakārākhyācchivo rudra udāhṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.46

dakṣiṇāṁgānmaheśasya jāto brahmātmasaṁjñikaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.47

vāmāṁgādabhavadviṣṇustato vidyeti saṁjñitaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.47

hṛdayānnīlarudro bhūcchivasya śivasaṁjñikaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.48

sṛṣṭeḥ pravartako brahmā sthiterviṣṇurvimohakaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.48

saṁhārasya tathā rudrastayornityaṁ niyāmakaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.49

tasmāttrayaste kathyaṁte jagataḥ kāraṇāni ca \|\| 7.2,35.50

kāraṇatrayahetuśca śivaḥ paramakāraṇam \|\| 7.2,35.50

arthametamavijñāya rajasā baddhavairayoḥ \|\| 7.2,35.51

yuvayoḥ pratibodhāya madhye liṁgamupasthitam \|\| 7.2,35.51

evamomiti māṁ prāhuryadihoktamatharvaṇā \|\| 7.2,35.52

ṛco yajūṁṣi sāmāni śākhāścānyāḥ sahasraśaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.52

vedeṣvevaṁ svayaṁ vaktrairvyaktamityavadatsvapi \|\| 7.2,35.53

svapnānubhūtamiva tattābhyāṁ nādhyavasīyate \|\| 7.2,35.53

tayostatra prabodhāya tamopanayanāya ca \|\| 7.2,35.54

liṁgepi mudritaṁ sarvaṁ yathā vedairudāhṛtam \|\| 7.2,35.54

taddṛṣṭvā mudritaṁ liṁge prasādālliṁginastadā \|\| 7.2,35.55

praśāṁtamanasau devau prabuddhau saṁbabhūvatuḥ \|\| 7.2,35.55

utpattiṁ vilayaṁ caiva yathātmyaṁ ca ṣaḍadhvanām \|\| 7.2,35.56

tataḥ parataraṁ dhāma dhāmavaṁtaṁ ca pūruṣam \|\| 7.2,35.56

niruttarataraṁ brahma niṣkalaṁ śivamīśvaram \|\| 7.2,35.57

paśupāśamayasyāsya prapañcasya sadā patim \|\| 7.2,35.57

akutobhayamatyaṁtamavṛddhikṣayamavyayam \|\| 7.2,35.58

vāhyamābhyaṁtaraṁ vyāptaṁ vāhyābhyaṁtaravarjitam \|\| 7.2,35.58

nirastātiśayaṁ śaśvadviśvalokavilakṣaṇam \|\| 7.2,35.59

alakṣaṇamanirdeśyamavāṅmanasagocaram \|\| 7.2,35.59

prakāśaikarasaṁ śāṁtaṁ prasannaṁ satatoditam \|\| 7.2,35.60

sarvakalyāṇanilayaṁ śaktyā tādṛśayānvitam \|\| 7.2,35.60

jñātvā devaṁ virūpākṣaṁ brahmanārāyaṇau tadā \|\| 7.2,35.61

racayitvāṁjaliṁ mūrdhni bhītau tau vācamūcatuḥ \|\| 7.2,35.61

591

brahmovāca

ajño vāhamabhijño vā tvayādau deva nirmitaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.62

īdṛśīṁ bhrāṁtimāpanna iti ko 'trāparādhyati \|\| 7.2,35.62

āstāṁ mamedamajñānaṁ tvayi sannihate prabho \|\| 7.2,35.63

nirbhayaḥ ko 'bhibhāṣeta kṛtyaṁ svasya parasya vā \|\| 7.2,35.63

āvayordevadevasya vivādo 'pi hi śobhanaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.64

pādapraṇāmaphalado nāthasya bhavato yataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.64

viṣṇuruvāca

stotuṁ deva na vāgasti mahimnaḥ sadṛśī tava \|\| 7.2,35.65

prabhoragre vidheyānāṁ tūṣṇīṁbhāvo vyatikramaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.65

kimatra saṁghaṭetkṛtyamityevāvasarocitam \|\| 7.2,35.66

ajānannapi yatkiṁcitpralapya tvāṁ nato 'smyaham \|\| 7.2,35.66

kāraṇatvaṁ tvayā dattaṁ vismṛtaṁ tava māyayā \|\| 7.2,35.67

mohito 'haṁkṛtaścāpi punarevāsmi śāsitaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.67

vijñāpitaiḥ kiṁ bahubhirbhītosmi bhṛśamīśvara \|\| 7.2,35.68

yato 'hamaparicchedyaṁ tvāṁ paricchettumudyataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.68

tvāmuśaṁti mahādevaṁ bhītānāmārtināśanam \|\| 7.2,35.69

ato vyatikramaṁ me 'dya kṣaṁtumarhasi śaṁkara \|\| 7.2,35.69

iti vijñāpitastābhyāmīśvarābhyāṁ maheśvaraḥ \|\| 7.2,35.70

prīto 'nugṛhya tau devau smitapūrvamabhāṣata \|\| 7.2,35.70

īśvara uvāca

vatsavatsa vidhe viṣṇo māyayā mama mohitau \|\| 7.2,35.71

yuvāṁ prabhutve 'haṁkṛtya buddhavairo parasparam \|\| 7.2,35.71

vivādaṁ yuddhaparyaṁtaṁ kṛtvā noparatau kila \|\| 7.2,35.72

tataścchinnā prajāsṛṣṭirjagatkāraṇabhūtayoḥ \|\| 7.2,35.72

ajñānamānaprabhavādvaimatyādyuvayorapi \|\| 7.2,35.73

tannivartayituṁ yuṣmaddarpamohau mayaiva tu \|\| 7.2,35.73

evaṁ nivāritāvadyaliṁgāvirbhāvalīlayā \|\| 7.2,35.74

tasmādbhūyo vivādaṁ ca vrīḍāṁ cotsṛjya kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,35.74

yathāsvaṁ karma kuryātāṁ bhavaṁtau vītamatsarau \|\| 7.2,35.75

purā mamājñayā sārdhaṁ samastajñānasaṁhitāḥ \|\| 7.2,35.75

yuvābhyāṁ hi mayā dattā kāraṇatvaprasiddhaye \|\| 7.2,35.76

maṁtraratnaṁ ca sūtrākhyaṁ pañcākṣaramayaṁ param \|\| 7.2,35.76

mayopadiṣṭaṁ sarvaṁ tadyuvayoradya vismṛtam \|\| 7.2,35.77

dadāmi ca punaḥ sarvaṁ yathāpūrvaṁ mamājñayā \|\| 7.2,35.77

yato vinā yuvāṁ tena na kṣamau sṛṣṭirakṣaṇe \|\| 7.2,35.78

evamuktvā mahādevo nārāyaṇapitāmahau \|\| 7.2,35.78

maṁtrarājaṁ dadau tābhyāṁ jñānasaṁhitayā saha \|\| 7.2,35.79

tau labdhvā mahatīṁ divyāmājñāṁ māheśvarīṁ parām \|\| 7.2,35.79

mahārthaṁ maṁtraratnaṁ ca tathaiva sakalāḥ kalāḥ \|\| 7.2,35.80

daṁḍavatpraṇatiṁ kṛtvā devadevasya pādayoḥ \|\| 7.2,35.80

atiṣṭhatāṁ vītabhayāvānaṁdāstimitau tadā \|\| 7.2,35.81

etasminnaṁtare citramiṁdrajālavadaiśvaram \|\| 7.2,35.81

liṁgaṁ kvāpi tirobhūtaṁ na tābhyāmupalabhyate \|\| 7.2,35.82

tato vilapya hāheti sadyaḥpraṇayabhaṁgataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.82

kimasatyamidaṁ vṛttamiti coktvā parasparam \|\| 7.2,35.83

aciṁtyavaibhavaṁ śaṁbhorviciṁtya ca gatavyathau \|\| 7.2,35.83

592

abhyupetya parāṁ maitrīmāliṁgya ca parasparam \|\| 7.2,35.84

jagadvyāpāramuddiśya jagmaturdevapuṁgavau \|\| 7.2,35.84

tataḥ prabhṛti śakrādyāḥ sarva eva surāsurāḥ \|\| 7.2,35.85

ṛṣayaśca narā nāgā nāryaścāpi vidhānataḥ \|\| 7.2,35.85

liṁgapratiṣṭhā kurvaṁti liṁge taṁ pūjayaṁti ca \|\| 7.2,35.85

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe harividhimohanivāraṇaṁ nāma pañcatriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 36

śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca

bhagavañchrotumicchāmi pratiṣṭhāvidhimuttamam \|\| 7.2,36.1

liṁgasyāpi ca berasya śivena vihitaṁ yathā \|\| 7.2,36.1

upamanyuruvāca

anātmapratikūle tu divase śuklapakṣake \|\| 7.2,36.2

śivaśāstroktamārgeṇa kuryālliṁgaṁ pramāṇavat \|\| 7.2,36.2

svīkṛtyātha śubhasthānaṁ bhūparīkṣāṁ vidhāya ca \|\| 7.2,36.3

daśopacārānkurvīta lakṣaṇoddhārapūrvakān \|\| 7.2,36.3

teṣāṁ daśopacārāṇāṁ pūrvaṁ pūjya 1 vināyakam \|\| 7.2,36.4

sthānaśuddhyādikaṁ kṛtvāliṁgaṁ snānālayaṁ nayet \|\| 7.2,36.4

śalākayā kāṁcanayā 2 kuṁkumādirasāktayā \|\| 7.2,36.5

lakṣitaṁ lakṣaṇaṁ śilpaśāstreṇa vilikhettataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.5

aṣṭamṛtsalilairvātha pañcamṛtsalilaistathā \|\| 7.2,36.6

liṅgaṁ piṁḍikayā sārdhaṁ pañcagavyaiśca śodhayet \|\| 7.2,36.6

savedikaṁ samabhyarcya divyādyaṁ tu jalāśayam \|\| 7.2,36.7

nītvādhivāsayettatra liṁgaṁ piṁḍikayā saha \|\| 7.2,36.7

adhivāsālaye śuddhe sarvaśobhāsamanvite \|\| 7.2,36.8

satoraṇe sāvaraṇe darbhamālāsamāvṛte \|\| 7.2,36.8

diggajāṣṭakasaṁpanne dikpālāṣṭaghaṭānvite \|\| 7.2,36.9

aṣṭamaṁgalakairyukte kṛtadikpālakārcite \|\| 7.2,36.9

tejasaṁ dāravaṁ vāpi kṛtvā padmāsanāṁkitam \|\| 7.2,36.10

vinyasenmadhyatastatra vipulaṁ pīṭhakālayam \|\| 7.2,36.10

dvārapālānsamabhyarcya bhadrādīṁścaturaḥkramāt \|\| 7.2,36.11

samudraśca vibhadraśca sunaṁdaśca vinaṁdakaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.11

snāpayitvā samabhyarcya liṁgaṁ vedikayā saha \|\| 7.2,36.12

sakūrcābhyāṁ tu vastrābhyāṁ samāveṣṭyaṁ samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.12

prāpayya śanakaistoyaṁ pīṭhikopari śāyayet \|\| 7.2,36.13

prākśiraskamadhaḥsūtraṁ piṁḍikāṁ cāsya paścime \|\| 7.2,36.13

sarvamaṁgalasaṁyuktaṁ liṁgaṁ tatrādhivāsayet \|\| 7.2,36.14

pañcarātraṁ trirātraṁ vāpyekarātramathāpi vā \|\| 7.2,36.14

visṛjya pūjitaṁ tatra śodhayitvā ca pūrvavat \|\| 7.2,36.15

saṁpūjyotsavamārgeṇa śayanālayamānayet \|\| 7.2,36.15

tatrāpi śayanasthānaṁ kuryānmaṁḍalamadhyataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.16

śuddhairjalaiḥ snāpayitvā liṁgamabhyarcayetkramāt \|\| 7.2,36.16

aiśānyāṁ padmamālikhya śuddhalipte mahītale \|\| 7.2,36.17

1 lyabārṣaḥ

2 ḍiḍhḍhaṇañiti ḍībabhāva ārṣaḥ

592

śivakuṁbhaṁ śodhayitvā tatrāvāhya śivaṁ yajet \|\| 7.2,36.17

vedīmadhye sitaṁ padmaṁ parikalpya vidhānataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.18

tasya paścimataścāpi caṁḍikāpadmamālikhet \|\| 7.2,36.18

kṣaumādyairvāhatairvastraiḥ puṣpairdarbhairathāpi vā \|\| 7.2,36.19

prakalpya śayanaṁ tasminhemapuṣpaṁ vinikṣipet \|\| 7.2,36.19

tatra liṁgaṁ samānīya sarvamaṁgalaniḥsvanaiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.20

raktena vastrayugmena sakūrcena samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.20

saha piṁḍikayāveṣṭya śāyayecca yathā purā \|\| 7.2,36.21

purastātpadmamālikhya taddaleṣu yathākramam \|\| 7.2,36.21

vidyeśakalaśānnyasyenmadhye śaivīṁ ca vardhanīm \|\| 7.2,36.22

parītya padmatritayaṁ juhuyurdvijasattamāḥ \|\| 7.2,36.22

te cāṣṭamūrtayaḥ kalpyāḥ pūrvādiparitaḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 7.2,36.23

catvāraścātha vā dikṣu svadhyetārassajāpakāḥ \|\| 7.2,36.23

juhuyuste viraṁcyādyāścatasro mūrtayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 7.2,36.24

daiśikaḥ prathamaṁ teṣāmaiśānyāṁ paścime 'tha vā \|\| 7.2,36.24

pradhānahomaṁ kurvīta saptadravyairyathākramam \|\| 7.2,36.25

ācāryātpādamardhaṁ vā juhuyuścāpare dvijāḥ \|\| 7.2,36.25

pradhānamekamevātra juhuyādatha vā guruḥ \|\| 7.2,36.26

pūrvaṁ pūrṇāhutiṁ hutvā ghṛtenāṣṭottaraṁ śatam \|\| 7.2,36.26

mūrdhni mūlena liṁgasya śivahastaṁ pravinyaset \|\| 7.2,36.27

śatamardhaṁ tadardhaṁ vā kramāddravyaiśca saptabhiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.27

hutvāhutvā spṛśelliṁgaṁ vedikāṁ ca punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.28

pūrṇāhutiṁ tato hutvā kramāddadyācca dakṣiṇām \|\| 7.2,36.28

ācāryātpādamardhaṁ vā hotḥṇāṁ sthapaterapi \|\| 7.2,36.29

tadardhaṁ deyamanyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyaśca śaktitaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.29

tataḥ śvabhre vṛṣaṁ haimaṁ kūrcaṁ vāpi niveśya ca \|\| 7.2,36.30

mṛdaṁbhasā pañcagavyaiḥ punaḥ śuddhajalena ca \|\| 7.2,36.30

śodhitāṁ caṁdanāliptāṁ śvabhre brahmaśilāṁ kṣipet \|\| 7.2,36.31

karanyāsaṁ tataḥ kṛtvā navabhiḥ śaktināmabhiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.31

haritālādidhātūṁśca bījagaṁdhauṣadhairapi \|\| 7.2,36.32

śivaśāstroktavidhinā kṣipedbrahmaśilopari \|\| 7.2,36.32

pratiliṁgaṁ tu saṁsthāpya kṣīraṁ vṛkṣasamudbhavam \|\| 7.2,36.33

sthitaṁ buddhvā tadutsṛjya liṁgaṁ brahmaśilopari \|\| 7.2,36.33

prāgudakpravarāṁ kiṁcitsthāpayenmūlavidyayā \|\| 7.2,36.34

piṁḍikāṁ cātha saṁyojya śāktaṁ mūlamanusmaran \|\| 7.2,36.34

bandhanaṁ baṁdhakadravyaiḥ kṛtvā sthānaṁ viśodhya ca \|\| 7.2,36.35

dattvā cārghyaṁ ca puṣpāṇi kuryuryavanikāṁ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.35

yathāyogyaṁ niṣekādi liṁgasya puratastadā \|\| 7.2,36.36

ānīya śayanasthānātkalaśānvinyasetkramāt \|\| 7.2,36.36

mahāpūjāmathārabhya saṁpūjya kalaśāndaśa \|\| 7.2,36.37

śivamaṁtramanusmṛtya śivakuṁbhajalāṁtare \|\| 7.2,36.37

aṁguṣṭhānāmikāyogādādāya tamudīrayet \|\| 7.2,36.38

nyasedīśānabhāgasya madhye liṁgasya maṁtravit \|\| 7.2,36.38

593

śaktiṁ nyasettathā vidyāṁ vidyeśāṁśca yathākramam \|\| 7.2,36.39

liṅgamūle śivajalaistato liṁgaṁ niṣecayet \|\| 7.2,36.39

vardhanyāṁ piṁḍikāliṁgaṁ vidyeśakalaśaiḥ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.40

abhiṣicyāsanaṁ paścādādhārādyaṁ prakalpayet \|\| 7.2,36.40

kṛtvā pañcakalānyāsaṁ dīptaṁ liṁgamanusmaret \|\| 7.2,36.41

āvāhayecchivau sākṣātprāñjaliḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.41

vṛṣādhirājamāruhya vimānaṁ vā nabhastalāt \|\| 7.2,36.42

alaṁkṛtaṁ sahāyāṁtaṁ devyā devamanusmaran \|\| 7.2,36.42

sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṁ sarvamaṁgalanisvanaiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.42

brahmaviṣṇumaheśārkaśakrādyairdevadānavaiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.43

ānaṁdaklinnasarvāṁgairvinyastāṁjalimastakaiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.43

stuvadbhireva nṛtyadbhirnāmadbhirabhito vṛtam \|\| 7.2,36.44

tataḥ pañcopacārāṁśca kṛtvā pūjāṁ samāpayet \|\| 7.2,36.44

nātaḥ parataraḥ kaścidvidhiḥ pañcopacārakāt \|\| 7.2,36.45

pratiṣṭhāṁ liṁgavatkuryātpratimāsvapi sarvataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.45

lakṣaṇoddhārasamaye kāryaṁ nayanamocanam \|\| 7.2,36.46

jalādhivāse śayane śāyayettāntvadhomukhīm \|\| 7.2,36.46

kumbhodaśāyitāṁ maṁtrairhṛdi tāṁ sanniyojayet \|\| 7.2,36.47

kṛtālayāṁ parāmāhuḥ pratiṣṭhāmakṛtālayāt \|\| 7.2,36.47

śaktaḥ kṛtālayaḥ paścātpratiṣṭhāvidhimācaret \|\| 7.2,36.48

aśaktaścetpratiṣṭhāpya liṁgaṁ beramathāpi vā \|\| 7.2,36.48

śakteranuguṇaṁ paścātprakurvīta śivālayam \|\| 7.2,36.49

gṛhārcāṁ ca punarvakṣye pratiṣṭhāvidhimuttamam \|\| 7.2,36.49

kṛtvā kanīyasaṁberaṁ liṁgaṁ vā lakṣaṇānvitam \|\| 7.2,36.50

ayane cottare prāpte śuklapakśe śubhe dine \|\| 7.2,36.50

devīṁ kṛtvā śubhe deśe tatrābjaṁ pūrvavallikhet \|\| 7.2,36.51

vikīrya patrapuṣpādyairmadhye kuṁbhaṁ nidhāya ca \|\| 7.2,36.51

paritastasya caturaḥ kalaśān dikṣu vinyaset \|\| 7.2,36.52

pañca brahmāṇi tadbījaisteṣu pañcasu pañcabhiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.52

nyasya saṁpūjya mudrādi darśayitvābhirakṣya ca \|\| 7.2,36.53

viśodhya liṁgaṁ beraṁ vā mṛttoyādyairyathā purā \|\| 7.2,36.53

sthāpayetpuṣpasaṁchannamuttarasthe varāsane \|\| 7.2,36.54

nidhāya puṣpaṁ śirasi prokṣayetprokṣaṇījalaiḥ \|\| 7.2,36.54

samabhyarcya punaḥ puṣpairjayaśabdādipūrvakam \|\| 7.2,36.55

kumbhairīśānavidyāṁtaiḥ snāpayenmūlavidyayā \|\| 7.2,36.55

tataḥ pañcakalānyāsaṁ kṛtvā pūjāṁ ca pūrvavat \|\| 7.2,36.56

nityamārādhayettatra devyā devaṁ trilocanam \|\| 7.2,36.56

ekamevātha vā kuṁbhaṁ mūrtimantrasamanvitam \|\| 7.2,36.57

nyasya padmāṁtare sarvaṁ śeṣaṁ pūrvavadācaret \|\| 7.2,36.57

atyaṁtopahataṁ liṁgaṁ viśodhya sthāpayetpunaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.58

saṁprokṣayedupahatamanāgupahataṁ yajet \|\| 7.2,36.58

liṁgāni bāṇasaṁjñāni sthāpanīyāni vā na vā \|\| 7.2,36.59

tāni pūrvaṁ śivenaiva saṁskṛtāni yatastataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.59

śeṣāṇi sthāpanīyāni yāni dṛṣṭāni bāṇavat \|\| 7.2,36.60

svayamudbhūtaliṁge ca divye cārṣe tathaiva ca \|\| 7.2,36.60

593

apīṭhe pīṭhamāveśya kṛtvā saṁprokṣaṇaṁ vidhim \|\| 7.2,36.61

yajettatra śivaṁ teṣāṁ pratiṣṭhā na vidhīyate \|\| 7.2,36.61

dagdhaṁ ślathaṁ kṣatāṁgaṁ ca kṣipelliṁgaṁ jalāśaye \|\| 7.2,36.62

saṁdhānayogyaṁ saṁdhāya pratiṣṭhāvidhimācaret \|\| 7.2,36.62

berādvā vikalālliṁgāddevapūjāpurassaram \|\| 7.2,36.63

udvāsya hṛdi saṁdhānaṁ tyāgaṁ vā yuktamācaret \|\| 7.2,36.63

ekāhapūjāvihatau kuryāddviguṇamarcanam \|\| 7.2,36.64

dvirātre ca mahāpūjāṁ saṁprokṣaṇamataḥ param \|\| 7.2,36.64

māsādūrdhvamanekāhaṁ pūjā yadi vihanyate \|\| 7.2,36.65

pratiṣṭhā procyate kaiścitkaiścitsaṁprokṣaṇakramaḥ \|\| 7.2,36.65

saṁprokṣaṇe tu liṁgāderdevamudvāsya pūrvavat \|\| 7.2,36.66

aṣṭapañcakrameṇaiva snāpayitvā mṛdaṁbhasā \|\| 7.2,36.66

gavāṁ rasaiśca saṁsnāpya darbhatoyairviśodhya ca \|\| 7.2,36.67

prokṣayetprokṣaṇītoyairmūlenāṣṭottaraṁ śatam \|\| 7.2,36.67

sapuṣpaṁ sakuśaṁ pāṇiṁ nyasya liṁgasya mastake \|\| 7.2,36.68

pañcavāraṁ japenmūlamaṣṭottaraśataṁ tataḥ \|\| 7.2,36.68

tato mūlena mūrdhādipīṭhāṁtaṁ saṁspṛśedapi \|\| 7.2,36.69

pūjāṁ ca mahatīṁ kuryāddevamāvāhya pūrvavat \|\| 7.2,36.69

alabdhe sthāpite liṁge śivasthāne jale 'tha vā \|\| 7.2,36.70

vahnau ravau tathā vyomni bhagavaṁtaṁ śivaṁ yajet \|\| 7.2,36.70

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe ptatiṣṭhāvidhivarṇanaṁ nāma ṣaṭtriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 37

śīkṛṣṇa uvāca

jñāne kriyāyāṁ caryāyāṁ sāramuddhṛtya saṁgrahāt \|\| 7.2,37.1

uktaṁ bhagavatā sarvaṁ śrutaṁ śrutisamaṁ mayā \|\| 7.2,37.1

idānīṁ śrotumicchāmi yogaṁ paramadurlabham \|\| 7.2,37.2

sādhikāraṁ ca sāṁgaṁ ca savidhiṁ saprayojanam \|\| 7.2,37.2

yadyasti maraṇaṁ pūrvaṁ yogādyanupamardataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.3

sadyaḥ sādhayituṁ śakyaṁ yena syānnātmahā naraḥ \|\| 7.2,37.3

tacca tatkāraṇaṁ caiva tatkālakaraṇāni ca \|\| 7.2,37.4

tadbhedatāratamyaṁ ca vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.4

upamanyuruvāca

sthāne pṛṣṭaṁ tvayā kṛṣṇa sarvapraśnārthavedinā \|\| 7.2,37.5

tataḥ krameṇa tatsarvaṁ vakṣye śṛṇu samāhitaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.5

niruddhavṛttyaṁtarasyaṁ śive cittasya niścalā \|\| 7.2,37.6

yā vṛttiḥ sa samāsena yogaḥ sa khalu pañcadhā \|\| 7.2,37.6

maṁtrayogaḥsparśayogo bhāvayogastathāparaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.7

abhāvayogassarvebhyo mahāyogaḥ paro mataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.7

maṁtrābhyāsavaśenaiva maṁtravācyārthagocaraḥ \|\| 7.2,37.8

avyākṣepā manovṛttirmaṁtrayoga udāhṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.8

prāṇāyāmamukhā saiva sparśe yogobhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,37.9

sa maṁtrasparśanirmukto bhāvayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.9

vilīnāvayavaṁ viśvaṁ rūpaṁ saṁbhāvyate yataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.10

594

abhāvayogaḥ saṁprokto 'nābhāsādvastunaḥ sataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.10

śivasvabhāva evaikaściṁtyate nirupādhikaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.11

yathā śaivamanovṛttirmahāyoga ihocyate \|\| 7.2,37.11

dṛṣṭe tathānuśravike viraktaṁ viṣaye manaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.12

yasya tasyādhikārosti yoge nānyasya kasyacit \|\| 7.2,37.12

viṣayadvayadoṣāṇāṁ guṇānāmīśvarasya ca \|\| 7.2,37.13

darśanādeva satataṁ viraktaṁ jāyate manaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.13

aṣṭāṁgo vā ṣaḍaṁgo vā sarvayogaḥ samāsataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.14

yamaśca niyamaścaiva svastikādyaṁ tathāsanam \|\| 7.2,37.14

prāṇāyāmaḥ pratyāhāro dhāraṇā dhyānameva ca \|\| 7.2,37.15

samādhiriti yogāṁgānyaṣṭāvuktāni sūribhiḥ \|\| 7.2,37.15

āsanaṁ prāṇasaṁrodhaḥ pratyāhārotha dhāraṇā \|\| 7.2,37.16

dhyānaṁ samādhiryogasya ṣaḍaṁgāni samāsataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.16

pṛthaglakṣaṇameteṣāṁ śivaśāstre samīritam \|\| 7.2,37.17

śivāgameṣu cānyeṣu viśeṣātkāmikādiṣu \|\| 7.2,37.17

yogaśāstreṣvapi tathā purāṇeṣvapi keṣu ca \|\| 7.2,37.18

ahiṁsā satyamasteyaṁ brahmacaryāparigrahaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.18

yama ityucyate sadbhiḥ pañcāvayavayogataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.18

śaucaṁ tuṣṭistapaścaiva japaḥ praṇidhireva ca \|\| 7.2,37.19

iti pañcaprabhedassyānniyamaḥ svāṁśabhedataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.19

svastikaṁ padmamadhyeṁduṁ vīraṁ yogaṁ prasādhitam \|\| 7.2,37.20

paryaṁkaṁ ca yatheṣṭaṁ ca proktamāsanamaṣṭadhā \|\| 7.2,37.20

prāṇaḥ svadehajo vāyustasyāyāmo nirodhanam \|\| 7.2,37.21

tadrocakaṁ pūrakaṁ ca kuṁbhakaṁ ca tridhocyate \|\| 7.2,37.21

nāsikāpuṭamaṁgulyā pīḍyaikamapareṇa tu \|\| 7.2,37.22

audaraṁ recayedvāyuṁ tathāyaṁ recakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.22

bāhyena marutā dehaṁ dṛtivatparipūrayet \|\| 7.2,37.23

nāsāpuṭenāpareṇa pūraṇātpūrakaṁ matam \|\| 7.2,37.23

na muṁcati na gṛhṇāti vāyumaṁtarbahiḥ sthitam \|\| 7.2,37.24

saṁpūrṇaṁ kuṁbhavattiṣṭhedacalaḥ sa tu kuṁbhaka \|\| 7.2,37.24

recakādyaṁ trayamidaṁ na drutaṁ na vilaṁbitam \|\| 7.2,37.25

tadyataḥ kramayogena tvabhyasedyogasādhakaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.25

recakādiṣu yobhyāso nāḍīśodhanapūrvakaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.26

svecchotkramaṇaparyaṁtaḥ prokto yogānuśāsane \|\| 7.2,37.26

kanyakādikramavaśātprāṇāyāmanirodhanam \|\| 7.2,37.27

taccaturdhopadiṣṭaṁ syānmātrāguṇavibhāgataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.27

kanyakastu caturdhā syātsa ca dvādaśamātrakaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.28

madhyamastu dviruddhātaścaturviṁśatimātrakaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.28

uttamastu triruddhātaḥ ṣaḍviṁśanmātrakaḥ paraḥ \|\| 7.2,37.29

svedakaṁpādijanakaḥ prāṇāyāmastaduttaraḥ \|\| 7.2,37.29

ānaṁdodbhavaromāṁcanetrāśrūṇāṁ vimocanam \|\| 7.2,37.30

jalpabhramaṇamūrchādyaṁ jāyate yoginaḥ param \|\| 7.2,37.30

jānuṁ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya na drutaṁ na vilaṁbitam \|\| 7.2,37.31

aṁgulīsphoṭanaṁ kuryātsā mātreti prakīrtitā \|\| 7.2,37.31

594

mātrākrameṇa vijñeyāścodvātakramayogataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.32

nāḍīviśuddhipūrvaṁ tu prāṇāyāmaṁ samācaret \|\| 7.2,37.32

agarbhaśca sagarbhaśca prāṇāyāmo dvidhā smṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.33

japaṁ dhyānaṁ vināgarbhaḥ sagarbhastatsamanvayāt \|\| 7.2,37.33

agarbhādgarbhasaṁyuktaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥśatādhikaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.34

tasmātsagarbhaṁ kurvanti yoginaḥ prāṇasaṁyamam \|\| 7.2,37.34

prāṇasya vijayādeva jīyaṁte deha 1 āyavaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.35

prāṇo 'pānaḥ samānaśca hyudāno vyāna eva ca \|\| 7.2,37.35

nāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkalo devadatto dhanaṁjayaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.36

prayāṇaṁ kurute yasmāttasmātprāṇo 'bhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,37.36

avāṅnayatyapānākhyo yadāhārādi bhujyate \|\| 7.2,37.37

vyāno vyānaśayatyaṁgānyaśeṣāṇi vivardhayan \|\| 7.2,37.37

udvejayati marmāṇītyudāno vāyurīritaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.38

samaṁ nayati sarvāṁgaṁ samānastena gīyate \|\| 7.2,37.38

udgāre nāga ākhyātaḥ kūrma unmīlane sthitaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.39

kṛkalaḥ kṣavathau jñeyo devadatto vijṛṁbhaṇe \|\| 7.2,37.39

na jahāti mṛtaṁ cāpi sarvavyāpī dhanaṁjayaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.40

krameṇābhyasyamānoyaṁ prāṇāyāmapramāṇavān \|\| 7.2,37.40

nirdahatyakhilaṁ doṣaṁ karturdehaṁ ca rakṣati \|\| 7.2,37.41

prāṇe tu vijite samyaktaccihnānyupalakṣayet \|\| 7.2,37.41

viṇmūtraśleṣmaṇāṁ tāvadalpabhāvaḥ prajāyate \|\| 7.2,37.42

bahubhojanasāmarthyaṁ cirāducchvāsanaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,37.42

laghutvaṁ śīghragāmitvamutsāhaḥ svarasauṣṭhavam \|\| 7.2,37.43

sarvarogakṣayaścaiva balaṁ tejaḥ surūpatā \|\| 7.2,37.43

dhṛtirmedhā yuvatvaṁ ca sthiratā ca prasannatā \|\| 7.2,37.44

tapāṁsi pāpakṣayatā yajñadānavratādayaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.44

prāṇāyāmasya tasyaite kalāṁ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 7.2,37.45

indriyāṇi prasaktāni yathāsvaṁ viṣayeṣviha \|\| 7.2,37.45

āhatya yannigṛhṇāti sa pratyāhāra ucyate \|\| 7.2,37.46

namaḥpūrvāṇīṁdriyāṇi svargaṁ narakameva ca \|\| 7.2,37.46

nigṛhītanisṛṣṭāni svargāya narakāya ca \|\| 7.2,37.47

tasmātsukhārthī matimāñjñānavairāgyamāsthitaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.47

iṁdriyāśvānnigṛhyāśu svātmanātmānamuddharet \|\| 7.2,37.48

dhāraṇā nāma cittasya sthānabandhassamāsataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.48

sthānaṁ ca śiva evaiko nānyaddoṣatrayaṁ yataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.49

kālaṁ kaṁcāvadhīkṛtya sthāne 'vasthāpitaṁ manaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.49

na tu pracyavate lakṣyāddhāraṇā syānna cānyathā \|\| 7.2,37.50

manasaḥ prathamaṁ sthairyaṁ dhāraṇātaḥ prajāyate \|\| 7.2,37.50

tasmāddhīraṁ manaḥ kuryāddhāraṇābhyāsayogataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.51

dhyai ciṁtāyāṁ smṛto dhātuḥ śivaciṁtā muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 7.2,37.51

avyākṣiptena manasā dhyānaṁ nāma taducyate \|\| 7.2,37.52

dhyeyāvasthitacittasya sadṛśaḥ pratyayaśca yaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.52

1 daśa vāyava iti pāṭhāntaram

595

pratyayāntaranirmuktaḥ pravāho dhyānamucyate \|\| 7.2,37.53

sarvamanyatparityajya śiva eva śivaṁkaraḥ \|\| 7.2,37.53

paro dhyeyo 'dhideveśaḥ samāptātharvaṇī śrutiḥ \|\| 7.2,37.54

tathā śivā parā dhyeyā sarvabhūtagatau śivau \|\| 7.2,37.54

tau śrutau smṛtiśāstrebhyaḥ sarvagau sarvadoditau \|\| 7.2,37.55

sarvajñau satataṁ dhyeyau nānārūpavibhedataḥ \|\| 7.2,37.55

vimuktiḥ pratyayaḥ pūrvaḥ pratyayaścāṇimādikam \|\| 7.2,37.56

ityetaddvividhaṁ jñeyaṁ dhyānasyāsya prayojanam \|\| 7.2,37.56

dhyātā dhyānaṁ tathā dhyeyaṁ yacca dhyānaprayojanam \|\| 7.2,37.57

etaccatuṣṭayaṁ jñātvā yogaṁ yuñjīta yogavit \|\| 7.2,37.57

jñānavairāgyasaṁpannaḥ śraddadhānaḥ kṣamānvitaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.58

nirmamaśca sadotsāhī dhyātetthaṁ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.58

japācchrāṁtaḥ punardhyāyeddhyānācchrāṁtaḥ punarjapet \|\| 7.2,37.59

japadhyanābhiyuktasya kṣipraṁ yogaḥ prasiddhyati \|\| 7.2,37.59

dhāraṇā dvādaśāyāmā dhyānaṁ dvādaśadhāraṇam \|\| 7.2,37.60

dhyānadvādaśakaṁ yāvatsamādhirabhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,37.60

samādhirnnāma yogāṁgamantimaṁ parikīrtitam \|\| 7.2,37.61

samādhinā ca sarvatra prajñālokaḥ pravartate \|\| 7.2,37.61

yadarthamātranirbhāsaṁ stimito dadhivatsthitam \|\| 7.2,37.62

svarūpaśūnyavadbhānaṁ samādhirabhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,37.62

dhyeye manaḥ samāveśya paśyedapi ca susthiram \|\| 7.2,37.63

nirvāṇānalavadyogī samādhisthaḥ pragīyate \|\| 7.2,37.63

na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na jalpati na paśyati \|\| 7.2,37.64

na ca sparśaṁ vijānāti na saṁkalpayate manaḥ \|\| 7.2,37.64

navābhimanyate kiṁcidbadhyate na ca kāṣṭavat \|\| 7.2,37.65

evaṁ śive vilīnātmā samādhistha ihocyate \|\| 7.2,37.65

yathā dīpo nivātasthaḥ spandate na kadācana \|\| 7.2,37.66

tathā samādhiniṣṭho 'pi tasmānna vicaletsudhīḥ \|\| 7.2,37.66

evamabhyasataścāraṁ yogino yogamuttamam \|\| 7.2,37.67

tadantarāyā naśyaṁti vighnāḥ sarve śanaiḥśanaiḥ \|\| 7.2,37.67

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāṁ vāyunaimiṣeyarṣisaṁvāde uttarakhaṇḍe yogagativarṇanaṁ nāma saptatriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 38

upamanyuruvāca

ālasyaṁ vyādhayastīvrāḥ pramādaḥ sthānasaṁśayaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.1

anavasthitacittatvamaśraddhā bhrāṁtidarśanam \|\| 7.2,38.1

duḥkhāni daurmanasyaṁ ca viṣayeṣu ca lolatā \|\| 7.2,38.2

daśaite yuñjatāṁ puṁsāmantarāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.2

ālasyamalasattvaṁ tu yogināṁ dehacetanoḥ \|\| 7.2,38.3

dhātuvaiṣamyajā doṣā vyādhayaḥ karmadoṣajāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.3

pramādo nāma yogasya sādhanā nāma bhāvanā \|\| 7.2,38.4

idaṁ vetyubhayākrāntaṁ vijñānaṁ sthānasaṁśayaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.4

apratiṣṭhā hi manasastvanavasthitirucyate \|\| 7.2,38.5

595

aśraddhā bhāvarahitā vṛttirvai yogavartmani \|\| 7.2,38.5

viparyastā matiryā sā bhrāṁtirityabhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,38.6

duḥkhamajñānajaṁ puṁsāṁ cittasyādhyātmikaṁ viduḥ \|\| 7.2,38.6

ādhibhautikamaṁgotthaṁ yacca duḥkhaṁ purā kṛtaiḥ \|\| 7.2,38.7

ādhidaivikamākhyātamaśanyastraviṣādikam \|\| 7.2,38.7

icchāvighātajaṁ mokṣaṁ daurmanasyaṁ pracakṣate \|\| 7.2,38.8

viṣayeṣu vicitreṣu vibhramastatra lolatā \|\| 7.2,38.8

śānteṣveteṣu vighneṣu yogāsaktasya yoginaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.9

upasargāḥ pravartaṁte divyāste siddhisūcakāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.9

pratibhā śravaṇaṁ vārtā darśanāsvādavedanāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.10

upasargāḥ ṣaḍityete vyaye yogasya siddhayaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.10

sūkṣme vyavahite 'tīte viprakṛṣṭe tvanāgate \|\| 7.2,38.11

pratibhā kathyate yo 'rthe pratibhāso yathātatham \|\| 7.2,38.11

śravaṇaṁ sarvaśabdānāṁ śravaṇe cāprayatnataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.12

vārttā vārttāsu vijñānaṁ sarveṣāmeva dehinām \|\| 7.2,38.12

darśanaṁ nāma divyānāṁ darśanaṁ cāprayatnataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.13

tathāsvādaśca divyeṣu raseṣvāsvāda ucyate \|\| 7.2,38.13

sparśanādhigamastadvadvedanā nāma viśrutā \|\| 7.2,38.14

gandhādīnāṁ ca divyānāmābrahmabhuvanādhipāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.14

saṁtiṣṭhante ca ratnāni prayacchaṁti bahūni ca \|\| 7.2,38.15

svacchandamadhurā vāṇī vividhāsyātpravartate \|\| 7.2,38.15

rasāyanāni sarvāṇi divyāścauṣadhayastathā \|\| 7.2,38.16

sidhyaṁti praṇipatyainaṁ diśaṁti surayoṣitaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.16

yogasiddhyaikadeśe 'pi dṛṣṭe mokṣe bhavenmatiḥ \|\| 7.2,38.17

dṛṣṭametanmayā yadvattadvanmokṣo bhavediti \|\| 7.2,38.17

kṛśatā sthūlatā bālyaṁ vārdhakyaṁ caiva yauvanam \|\| 7.2,38.18

nānācātisvarūpaṁ ca caturṇāṁ dehadhāraṇam \|\| 7.2,38.18

pārthivāṁśaṁ vinā nityaṁ surabhirgandhasaṁgrahaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.19

evamaṣṭaguṇaṁ prāhuḥ paiśācaṁ pārthivaṁ padam \|\| 7.2,38.19

jale nivasanaṁ caiva bhūmyāmevaṁ vinirgamaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.20

icchecchaktaḥ svayaṁ pātuṁ samudramapi nāturaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.20

yatrecchati jagatyasmiṁstatraiva jaladarśanam \|\| 7.2,38.21

vinā kumbhādikaṁ pāṇau jalasañcayadhāraṇam \|\| 7.2,38.21

yadvastu virasañcāpi bhoktumicchati tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 7.2,38.22

rasādikaṁ bhaveccānyattrayāṇāṁ dehadhāraṇam \|\| 7.2,38.22

nirvraṇatvaṁ śarīrasya pārthivaiśca samanvitam \|\| 7.2,38.23

tadidaṁ ṣoḍaśaguṇamāpyamaiśvaryamadbhutam \|\| 7.2,38.23

śarīrādagninirmāṇaṁ tattāpabhayavarjanam \|\| 7.2,38.24

śaktirjagadidaṁ dagdhuṁ yadīcchedaprayatnataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.24

sthāpanaṁ vānalasyā 'psu pāṇau pāvakadhāraṇam \|\| 7.2,38.25

dagdhe sarge yathāpūrvaṁ mukhe cānnādipācanam \|\| 7.2,38.25

dvābhyāṁ dehavinirmāṇamāpyaiśvaryasamanvitam \|\| 7.2,38.25

etaccaturviṁśatidhā taijasaṁ paricakṣate \|\| 7.2,38.26

manojavatvaṁ bhūtānāṁ kṣaṇādantaḥpraveśanam \|\| 7.2,38.26

596

parvatādimahābhāradhāraṇañcāprayatnataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.27

gurutvañca laghutvañca pāṇāvaniladhāraṇam \|\| 7.2,38.27

aṁgulyagranipātādyairbhūmerapi ca kampanam \|\| 7.2,38.28

ekena dehaniṣpattiryuktaṁ bhogaiśca taijasaiḥ \|\| 7.2,38.28

dvātriṁśadguṇamaiśvaryaṁ mārutaṁ kavayo viduḥ \|\| 7.2,38.29

chāyāhīnaviniṣpattirindriyāṇāmadarśanam \|\| 7.2,38.29

khecaratvaṁ yathākāmamindriyārthasamanvayaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.30

ākāśalaṁghanaṁ caiva svadehe tanniveśanam \|\| 7.2,38.30

ākāśapiṇḍīkaraṇamaśarīratvameva ca \|\| 7.2,38.31

anilaiśvaryasaṁyuktaṁ catvāriṁśadguṇaṁ mahat \|\| 7.2,38.31

aindramaiśvaryamākhyātamāmbaraṁ tatpracakṣate \|\| 7.2,38.32

yathākāmopalabdhiśca yathākāmavinirgamaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.32

sarvasyābhibhavaścaiva sarvaguhyārthadarśanam \|\| 7.2,38.33

karmānurūpanirmāṇaṁ vaśitvaṁ priyadarśanam \|\| 7.2,38.33

saṁsāradarśanaṁ caiva bhogairaindraissamanvitam \|\| 7.2,38.34

etaccāṁdramasaiśvaryaṁ mānasaṁ guṇato 'dhikam \|\| 7.2,38.34

chedanaṁ tāḍanaṁ caiva baṁdhanaṁ mocanaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,38.35

grahaṇaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ saṁsāravaśavartinām \|\| 7.2,38.35

prasādaścāpi sarveṣāṁ mṛtyukālajayastathā \|\| 7.2,38.36

ābhimānikamaiśvaryaṁ prājāpatyaṁ pracakṣate \|\| 7.2,38.36

etaccāndramasairbhogaiḥ ṣaṭpañcāśadguṇaṁ mahat \|\| 7.2,38.37

sargaḥ saṁkalpamātreṇa trāṇaṁ saṁharaṇaṁ tathā \|\| 7.2,38.37

svādhikāraśca sarveṣāṁ bhūtacittapravartanam \|\| 7.2,38.38

asādṛśyaṁ ca sarvasya nirmāṇaṁ jagataḥ pṛthak \|\| 7.2,38.38

śubhāśubhasya karaṇaṁ prājāpatyaiśca saṁyutam \|\| 7.2,38.39

catuṣṣaṣṭhiguṇaṁ brāhmamaiśvaryaṁ ca pracakṣate \|\| 7.2,38.39

bauddhādasmātparaṁ gauṇamaiśvaryaṁ prākṛtaṁ viduḥ \|\| 7.2,38.40

vaiṣṇavaṁ tatsamākhyātaṁ tasyaiva bhuvanasthitiḥ \|\| 7.2,38.40

brahmaṇā tatpadaṁ sarvaṁ vaktumanyairna śakyate \|\| 7.2,38.40

tatpauruṣaṁ ca gauṇaṁ ca gaṇeśaṁ padamaiśvaram \|\| 7.2,38.41

viṣṇunā tatpadaṁ kiṁcijjñātumanyairna śakyate \|\| 7.2,38.41

vijñānasiddhayaścaiva sarvā evaupasargikāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.42

niroddhavyā prayatnena varrāgyeṇa pareṇa tu \|\| 7.2,38.42

pratibhāseṣvaśuddheṣu guṇeṣvāsaktacetasaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.43

na sidhyetparamaiśvaryamabhayaṁ sārvakāmikam \|\| 7.2,38.43

tasmādguṇāṁśca bhogāṁśca devāsuramahībhṛtām \|\| 7.2,38.44

tṛṇavadyastyajettasya yogasiddhiḥ parā bhavet \|\| 7.2,38.44

athavānugrahecchāyāṁ jagato vicarenmuniḥ \|\| 7.2,38.45

yathākāmaṁguṇānbhogānbhuktvā muktiṁ prayāsyati \|\| 7.2,38.45

atha prayogaṁ yogasya vakṣye śṛṇu samāhitaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.46

śubhe kāle śubhe deśe śivakṣetrādike punaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.46

vijane jaṁturahite niḥśabde bādhavarjite \|\| 7.2,38.46

supralipte sthale saumye gandhadhūpādivāsite \|\| 7.2,38.47

muktapuṣpasamākīrṇe vitānādi vicitrite \|\| 7.2,38.47

kuśapuṣpasamittoyaphalamūlasamanvite \|\| 7.2,38.48

nāgnyabhyāśe jalābhyāśe śuṣkaparṇacaye 'pi vā \|\| 7.2,38.48

596

na daṁśamaśakākīrṇe sarpaśvāpadasaṁkule \|\| 7.2,38.49

na ca duṣṭamṛgākīrṇe na bhaye durjanāvṛte \|\| 7.2,38.49

śmaśāne caityavalmīke jīrṇāgāre catuṣpathe \|\| 7.2,38.50

nadīnadasamudrāṇāṁ tīre rathyāṁtare 'pi vā \|\| 7.2,38.50

na jīrṇodyānagoṣṭhādau nāniṣṭe na ca niṁdite \|\| 7.2,38.51

nājīrṇāmlarasodgāre na ca viṇmūtradūṣite \|\| 7.2,38.51

nacchardyāmātisāre vā nātibhuktau śramānvite \|\| 7.2,38.52

na cāticiṁtākulito na cātikṣutpipāsitaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.52

nāpi svagurukarmādau prasakto yogamācaret \|\| 7.2,38.53

yuktāhāravihāraśca yuktaceṣṭaśca karmasu \|\| 7.2,38.53

yuktanidrāprabodhaśca sarvāyāsavivarjitaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.54

āsanaṁ mṛdulaṁ ramyaṁ vipulaṁ susamaṁ śuci \|\| 7.2,38.54

padmakasvastikādīnāmabhyasedāsaneṣu ca \|\| 7.2,38.55

abhivaṁdya svagurvaṁtānabhivādyānanukramāt \|\| 7.2,38.55

ṛjugrīvaśirovakṣā nātiṣṭhecchiṣṭalocanaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.56

kiṁcidunnāmitaśirā daṁtairdaṁtānna saṁspṛśet \|\| 7.2,38.56

daṁtāgrasaṁsthitā jihvāmacalāṁ sanniveśya ca \|\| 7.2,38.57

pārṣṇibhyāṁ vṛṣaṇau rakṣaṁstathā prajananaṁ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.57

ūrvorupari saṁsthāpya bāhū tiryagayatnataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.58

dakṣiṇaṁ karapṛṣṭhaṁ tu nyasya vāmatalopari \|\| 7.2,38.58

unnāmya śanakaiḥ pṛṣṭhamuro viṣṭabhya cāgrataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.59

saṁprekṣya nāsikāgraṁ svaṁ diśaścānavalokayan \|\| 7.2,38.59

saṁbhṛtaprāṇasaṁcāraḥ pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.60

svadehāyatanasyāṁtarviciṁtya śivamaṁbayā \|\| 7.2,38.60

hṛtpadmapīṭhikāmadhye dhyānayajñena pūjayet \|\| 7.2,38.61

mūle nāsāgrato nābhau kaṁṭhe vā tāluraṁdhrayoḥ \|\| 7.2,38.61

bhrūmadhye dvāradeśe vā lalāṭe mūrdhni vā smaret \|\| 7.2,38.62

parikalpya yathānyāyaṁ śivayoḥ paramāsanam \|\| 7.2,38.62

tatra sāvaraṇaṁ vāpi nirāvaraṇameva vā \|\| 7.2,38.63

dvidaleṣoḍaśāre vā dvādaśāre yathāvidhi \|\| 7.2,38.63

daśāre vā ṣaḍasre vā caturasre śivaṁ smaret \|\| 7.2,38.64

bhruvoraṁtarataḥ padmaṁ dvidalaṁ taḍidujjvalam \|\| 7.2,38.64

bhrūmadhyasthāravindasya kramādvai dakṣiṇottare \|\| 7.2,38.65

vidyutsamānavarṇe ca parṇe varṇāvasānake \|\| 7.2,38.65

ṣoḍaśārasya patrāṇi svarāḥ ṣoḍaśa tāni vai \|\| 7.2,38.66

pūrvādīni kramādetatpadmaṁ kandasya mūlataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.66

kakārādiṭakārāṁtā varṇāḥ parṇānyanukramāt \|\| 7.2,38.67

bhānuvarṇasya padmasya dhyeyaṁ tad1 hṛdayāntare \|\| 7.2,38.67

gokṣīradhavalasyoktā ḍādiphāntā yathākramam \|\| 7.2,38.68

adho dalasyāmbujasya etasya 2 ca dalāni ṣaṭ \|\| 7.2,38.68

vidhūmāṁgāravarṇasya varṇā vādyāśca lāntimāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.69

mūlādhārāraviṁdasya hemābhasya yathākramam \|\| 7.2,38.69

vakārādisakārāntā varṇāḥ parṇamayāḥ sthitāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.69

eteṣvathāraviṁdeṣu yatraivābhirataṁ manaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.70

tatraiva devaṁ devīṁ ca ciṁtayeddhīrayā dhiyā \|\| 7.2,38.70

aṁguṣṭhamātramamalaṁ dīpyamānaṁ samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,38.71

śuddhadīpaśikhākāraṁ svaśaktyā pūrṇamaṇḍitam \|\| 7.2,38.71

indurekhāsamākāraṁ tārārūpamathāpi vā \|\| 7.2,38.72

nīvāraśūkassadṛśaṁ bisasutrābhameva vā \|\| 7.2,38.72

kadambagolakākāraṁ tuṣārakaṇikopamam \|\| 7.2,38.73

kṣityāditattvavijayaṁ dhyātā yadyapi vāñchati \|\| 7.2,38.73

tattattattvādhipāmeva mūrtiṁ sthūlāṁ viciṁtayet \|\| 7.2,38.74

sadāśivāṁtā brahmādyabhavādyāścāṣṭamūrtayaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.74

śivasya mūrtayaḥ sthūlāḥ śivaśāstre viniścitāḥ \|\| 7.2,38.75

ghorā miśrā praśāntāśca mūrtayastā munīśvaraiḥ \|\| 7.2,38.75

phalābhilāṣarahitaiścintyāścintāviśāradaiḥ \|\| 7.2,38.76

ghorāścecciṁtitāḥ kuryuḥ pāparogaparikṣayam \|\| 7.2,38.76

cireṇa miśre saumye tu na sadyo na cirādapi \|\| 7.2,38.77

saumye muktirviśeṣeṇa śāṁtiḥ prajñā prasidhyati \|\| 7.2,38.77

sidhyaṁti siddhayaścātra kramaśo nātra saṁśayaḥ \|\| 7.2,38.78

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe yogagatau vighnotpattivarṇanaṁ nāmāṣṭatriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 39

upamanyuruvāca

śrīkaṁṭhanāthaṁ smaratāṁ sadyaḥ sarvārthasiddhayaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.1

prasidhyaṁtīti matvaike taṁ vai dhyāyaṁti yoginaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.1

sthityarthaṁ manasaḥ kecitsthūladhyānaṁ prakurvate \|\| 7.2,39.2

sthūlaṁ tu niścalaṁ ceto bhavetsūkṣme tu tatsthiram \|\| 7.2,39.2

śive tu ciṁtite sākṣātsarvāḥ sidhyanti siddhayaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.3

mūrtyaṁtareṣu dhyāteṣu śivarūpaṁ viciṁtayet \|\| 7.2,39.3

lakṣayenmanasaḥ sthairyaṁ tattaddhyāyetpunaḥ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.4

dhyānamādau saviṣayaṁ tato nirviṣayaṁ jaguḥ \|\| 7.2,39.4

tatra nirviṣayaṁ dhyānaṁ nāstītyeva satāṁ matam \|\| 7.2,39.5

buddherhi santatiḥ kāciddhyānamityabhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,39.5

tena nirviṣayā buddhiḥ kevaleha pravartate \|\| 7.2,39.6

tasmātsaviṣayaṁ dhyānaṁ bālārkakiraṇāśrayam \|\| 7.2,39.6

sūkṣmāśrayaṁ nirviṣayaṁ nāparaṁ paramārthataḥ \|\| 7.2,39.7

yadvā saviṣayaṁ dhyānaṁ tatsākārasamāśrayam \|\| 7.2,39.7

nirākārātmasaṁvittirdhyānaṁ nirviṣayaṁ matam \|\| 7.2,39.8

nirbījaṁ ca sabījaṁ ca tadeva dhyānamucyate \|\| 7.2,39.8

nirākāraśrayatvena sākārāśrayatastathā \|\| 7.2,39.9

tasmātsaviṣayaṁ dhyānamādau kṛtvā sabījakam \|\| 7.2,39.9

aṁte nirviṣayaṁ kuryānnirbījaṁ sarvasiddhaye \|\| 7.2,39.10

prāṇāyāmena sidhyaṁti devyāḥ śāṁtyādayaḥ kramāt \|\| 7.2,39.10

śāṁtiḥ praśāṁtirdīptiśca prasādaśca tataḥ param \|\| 7.2,39.11

śamaḥ sarvāpadāṁ caiva śāṁtirityabhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,39.11

597

tamaso 'ntabahirnāśaḥ praśāntiḥ parigīyate \|\| 7.2,39.12

bahirantaḥprakāśo yo dīptirityabhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,39.12

svasthatā yā tu sā buddhaḥ prasādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.13

kāraṇāni ca sarvāṇi sabāhyābhyaṁtarāṇi ca \|\| 7.2,39.13

buddheḥ prasādataḥ kṣipraṁ prasannāni bhavantyuta \|\| 7.2,39.14

dhyātā dhyānaṁ tathā dhyeyaṁ yadvā dhyānaprayojanam \|\| 7.2,39.14

etaccatuṣṭayaṁ jñātvā dhyātā dhyānaṁ samācaret \|\| 7.2,39.14

jñānavairāgyasaṁpanno nityamavyagramānasaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.15

śraddadhānaḥ prasannātmā dhyātā sadbhirudāhṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.15

dhyai ciṁtāyāṁ smṛto dhātuḥ śivaciṁtā muhurmuhuḥ \|\| 7.2,39.16

yogābhyāsastathālpe 'pi yathā pāpaṁ vināśayet \|\| 7.2,39.17

dhyāyataḥ kṣaṇamātraṁ vā śraddhayā parameśvaram \|\| 7.2,39.17

avyākṣiptena manasā dhyānamityabhidhīyate \|\| 7.2,39.18

buddhipravāharūpasya dhyānasyāsyāvalaṁbanam \|\| 7.2,39.19

dhyeyamityucyate sadbhistacca sāṁbaḥ svayaṁ śivaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.19

vimuktipratyayaṁ pūrṇamaiśvaryaṁ cāṇimādikam \|\| 7.2,39.20

śivadhyānasya pūrṇasya sākṣāduktaṁ prayojanam \|\| 7.2,39.20

yasmātsaukhyaṁ ca mokṣaṁ ca dhyānādabhayamāpnuyāt \|\| 7.2,39.21

tasmātsarvaṁ parityajya dhyānayukto bhavennaraḥ \|\| 7.2,39.21

nāsti dhyānaṁ vinā jñānaṁ nāsti dhyānamayoginaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.22

dhyānaṁ jñānaṁ ca yasyāsti tīrṇastena bhavārṇavaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.22

jñānaṁ prasannamekāgramaśeṣopādhivarjitam \|\| 7.2,39.23

yogābhyāsena yuktasya yoginastveva sidhyati \|\| 7.2,39.23

prakṣīṇāśeṣapāpānāṁ jñāne dhyāne bhavenmatiḥ \|\| 7.2,39.24

pāpopahatabuddhīnāṁ tadvārtāpi sudurlabhā \|\| 7.2,39.24

yathāvahnirmahādīptaḥ śuṣkamārdraṁ ca nirdahet \|\| 7.2,39.25

tathā śubhāśubhaṁ karma dhyānāgnirdahate kṣaṇāt \|\| 7.2,39.25

atyalpo 'pi yathā dīpaḥ sumahannāśayettamaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.26

yogābhyāsastathālpo 'pi mahāpāpaṁ vināśayet \|\| 7.2,39.26

dhyāyataḥ kṣaṇamātraṁ vā śraddhayā parameśvaram \|\| 7.2,39.27

yadbhavetsumahacchreyastasyāṁto naiva vidyate \|\| 7.2,39.27

nāsti dhyānasamaṁ tīrthaṁ nāsti dhyānasamaṁ tapaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.28

nāsti dhyānasamo yajñastasmāddhyānaṁ samācaret \|\| 7.2,39.28

tīrthāni toyapūrṇāni devānpāṣāṇamṛnmayān \|\| 7.2,39.29

yogino na prapadyaṁte svātmapratyayakāraṇāt \|\| 7.2,39.29

yogināṁ ca vapuḥ sūkṣmaṁ bhavetpratyakṣamaiśvaram \|\| 7.2,39.30

yathā sthūlamayuktānāṁ mṛtkāṣṭhādyaiḥ prakalpitam \|\| 7.2,39.30

yathehāṁtaścarā rājñaḥ priyāḥ syurna bahiścarāḥ \|\| 7.2,39.31

tathāṁtardhyānaniratāḥ priyāśśaṁbhorna karmiṇaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.31

bahiskarā yathā loke nātīva phalabhoginaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.32

598

dṛṣṭvā narendrabhavane tadvadatrāpi karmiṇaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.32

yadyaṁtarā vipadyaṁte jñānayogārthamudyataḥ \|\| 7.2,39.33

yogasyodyogamātreṇa rudralokaṁ gamiṣyati \|\| 7.2,39.33

anubhūya sukhaṁ tatra sa jāto yogināṁ kule \|\| 7.2,39.34

jñānayogaṁ punarlabdhvā saṁsāramativartate \|\| 7.2,39.34

jijñāsurapi yogasya yāṁ gatiṁ labhate naraḥ \|\| 7.2,39.35

na tāṁ gatimavāpnoti sarvairapi mahāmakhaiḥ \|\| 7.2,39.35

dvijānāṁ vedaviduṣāṁ koṭiṁ saṁpūjya yatphalam \|\| 7.2,39.36

bhikṣāmātrapradānena tatphalaṁ śivayogine \|\| 7.2,39.36

yajñāgnihotradānena tīrthahomeṣu yatphalam \|\| 7.2,39.37

yogināmannadānena tatsamastaṁ phalaṁ labhet \|\| 7.2,39.37

ye cāpavādaṁ kurvaṁti vimūḍhāśśivayoginām \|\| 7.2,39.38

śrotṛbhiste prapadyante narakeṣvāmahīkṣayāt \|\| 7.2,39.38

sati śrotari vaktāsyādapavādasya yoginām \|\| 7.2,39.39

tasmācchrotā ca pāpīyāndaṇḍyassumahatāṁ mataḥ \|\| 7.2,39.39

ye punaḥ satataṁ bhaktyā bhajaṁti śavayoginaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.39

te vidaṁti mahābhogānaṁte yogaṁ ca śāṁkaram \|\| 7.2,39.40

bhogārthibhirnaraistasmātsaṁpūjyāḥ śivayoginaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.40

pratiśrayānnapānādyaiḥ śayyāprāvaraṇādibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,39.41

yogadharmaḥ sasāratvādabhedyaḥ pāpamudgaraiḥ \|\| 7.2,39.41

vajrataṁdulavajjñeyaṁ tathā pāpena yoginaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.42

na lipyaṁte ca tāpaughaiḥ padmapatraṁ yathāṁbhasā \|\| 7.2,39.42

yasmindeśe vasennityaṁ śivayogarato muniḥ \|\| 7.2,39.43

so 'pi deśo bhavetpūtaḥ sapūta iti kiṁ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.43

tasmātsarvaṁ parityajya kṛtyamanyadvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.44

sarvaduḥkhaprahāṇāya śivayogaṁ samabhyaset \|\| 7.2,39.44

siddhayogaphalo yogī lokānāṁ hitakāmyayā \|\| 7.2,39.45

bhogānbhuktvā yathākāmaṁ viharedvātra vartatām \|\| 7.2,39.45

athavā kṣudramityeva matvā vaiṣayikaṁ sukham \|\| 7.2,39.46

tyaktvā virāgayogena svecchayā karma mucyatām \|\| 7.2,39.46

yastvāsannāṁ mṛtiṁ martyo dṛṣṭāriṣṭaṁ ca bhūyasā \|\| 7.2,39.47

sa yogārambhanirataḥ śivakṣetraṁ samāśrayet \|\| 7.2,39.47

sa tatra nivasanneva yadi dhīramanā naraḥ \|\| 7.2,39.48

prāṇānvināpi rogādyaiḥ svayameva parityajet \|\| 7.2,39.48

kṛtvāpyanaśanaṁ caiva hutvā cāṁgaṁ śivānale \|\| 7.2,39.49

kṣiptvā vā śivatīrtheṣu svadehamavagāhanāt \|\| 7.2,39.49

śivaśāstroktavidhivatprāṇānyastu parityajet \|\| 7.2,39.50

sadya eva vimucyeta nātra kāryā vicāraṇā 2 \|\| 7.2,39.50

rogādyairvātha vivaśaḥ śivakṣetraṁ samāśritaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.51

mriyate yadi sopyevaṁ mucyate nātra saṁśayaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.51

1 udyogaṁ kurvata ityarthaḥ

2 na cāsāvātmaghātaka iti pāṭhāntaram

598

yathā hi maraṇaṁ śreṣṭhamuśaṁtyanaśanādibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,39.52

śāstraviśraṁbhadhīreṇa manasā kriyate yataḥ \|\| 7.2,39.52

śivanindārataṁ hatvā pīḍitaḥ svayameva vā \|\| 7.2,39.53

yastyajeddustyajānprāṇānna sa bhūyaḥ prajāyate \|\| 7.2,39.53

śivanindārataṁ haṁtumaśakto yaḥ svayaṁ mṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.54

sadya eva pramucyeta triḥ saptakulasaṁyutaḥ \|\| 7.2,39.54

śivārthe yastyajetprāṇāñchivabhaktārthameva vā \|\| 7.2,39.55

na tena sadṛśaḥ kaścinmuktimārgasthito naraḥ \|\| 7.2,39.55

tasmācchīghratarā muktistasya saṁsāramaṁḍalāt \|\| 7.2,39.56

eteṣvanyatamopāyaṁ kathamapyavalambya vā \|\| 7.2,39.56

ṣaḍadhvaśuddhiṁ vidhivatprāpto vā mriyate yadi \|\| 7.2,39.57

paśūnāmiva tasyeha na kuryādaurdhvadaihikam \|\| 7.2,39.57

naivāśaucaṁ prapadyeta tatputrādiviśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,39.58

śivacārārthamathavā śivavidyārthameva vā \|\| 7.2,39.58

khanedvā bhuvi taddehaṁ dahedvā śucināgninā \|\| 7.2,39.58

kṣipedvāpsu śivāsveva tyajedvā kāṣṭhaloṣṭavat \|\| 7.2,39.59

athainamapi coddiśya karma cetkartumīpsitam \|\| 7.2,39.59

kalyāṇameva kurvīta śaktyā bhaktāṁśca tarpayet \|\| 7.2,39.60

dhanaṁ tasya bhajecchaivaḥ śaivī cetasya santatiḥ \|\| 7.2,39.60

nāsti cettacchive dadyānnadadyātpaśusantatiḥ \|\| 7.2,39. 60

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe śaivayogavarṇanaṁ nāmaikonacatvāriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 40

śrīsūta uvāca

iti sa vijitamanyoryādavenopamanyoradhigatamabhidhāya jñānayogaṁ munibhyaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.1

praṇatimupagatebhyastebhya udbhāvitātmā sapadi viyati vāyuḥ sāyamantarhito 'bhūt \|\| 7.2,40.1

tataḥ prabhātasamaye naimiṣīyāstapodhanāḥ \|\| 7.2,40.2

satrānte 'vabhṛthaṁ kartuṁ sarva eva samudyayuḥ \|\| 7.2,40.2

tadā brahmasamādeśāddevī sākṣātsarasvatī \|\| 7.2,40.3

prasannā svādusalilā prāvartata nadīśubhā \|\| 7.2,40.3

sarasvatīṁ nadīṁ dṛṣṭvā munayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ \|\| 7.2,40.4

samāpya satraṁ prārabdhaṁ cakrustatrāvagāhanam \|\| 7.2,40.4

atha saṁtarpya devādīṁstadīyaiḥ salilaiḥ śivaiḥ \|\| 7.2,40.5

smarantaḥ pūrvavṛttāntaṁ yayurvārāṇasīṁ prati \|\| 7.2,40.5

tadā te himavatpādātpaṁtatīṁ dakṣiṇāmukhīm \|\| 7.2,40.6

dṛṣṭvā bhāgīrathī tatra snātvā tattīrato yayuḥ \|\| 7.2,40.6

tato vārāṇasīṁ prāpya muditāssarva eva te \|\| 7.2,40.7

tadottarapravāhāyāṁ gaṁgāyāmavagāhya ca \|\| 7.2,40.7

avimukteśvaraṁ liṁgaṁ dṛṣṭvābhyarcya vidhānataḥ \|\| 7.2,40.8

prayātumudyatāstatra dadṛśurdivi bhāsvaram \|\| 7.2,40.8

sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṁ tejodivyaṁ mahādbhutam \|\| 7.2,40.9

ātmaprabhāvitānena vyāptasarvadigantaram \|\| 7.2,40.9

atha pāśupatāḥ siddhāḥ bhasmasañchannavigrahāḥ \|\| 7.2,40.10

munayo 'bhyetya śataśo līnāḥ syustatra tejasi \|\| 7.2,40.10

599

tathā vilīyamāneṣu tapasviṣu mahātmasu \|\| 7.2,40.11

sadyastirodadhe tejastadadbhutamivābhavat \|\| 7.2,40.11

taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṁ naimiṣīyā maharṣayaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.12

kimetadityajānanto yayurbrahmavanaṁ prati \|\| 7.2,40.12

prāgevaiṣāṁ tu gamanātpavano lokapāvanaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.13

darśanaṁ naimiṣīyāṇāṁ saṁvādastairmahātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.13

śaddhāṁ buddhiṁ tatasteṣāṁ sāṁbe sānucare śive \|\| 7.2,40.14

samāptiṁ cāpi satrasya dīrghapūrvasya satriṇām \|\| 7.2,40.14

vijñāpya jagatāṁ dhātre brahmaṇe brahmayonaye \|\| 7.2,40.15

svakārye tadanujñāto jagāma svapuraṁ prati \|\| 7.2,40.15

atha sthānagato brahmā tumburornāradasya ca \|\| 7.2,40.16

paraspara spardhitayorgāne vivadamānayoḥ \|\| 7.2,40.16

tadudbhāvitagānottharasairmādhyasthamācaran \|\| 7.2,40.17

gandharvairapsarobhiśca sukhamāste niṣevitaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.17

tadānavasarādeva dvāḥsthairdvāri nivāritāḥ \|\| 7.2,40.18

munayo brahmabhavanādbahiḥ pārśvamupāviśan \|\| 7.2,40.18

atha tumburuṇā gāne samatāṁ prāpya nāradaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.19

sāhacaryeṣvanujñāto brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā \|\| 7.2,40.19

tyaktvā parasparaspardhāṁ maitrīṁ ca paramāṁ gataḥ \|\| 7.2,40.20

saha tenāpsarobhiśca gandharvaiśca samāvṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.20

upavīṇayituṁ devaṁ nakulīśvaramīśvaram \|\| 7.2,40.21

bhavanānniryayau dhāturjaladādaṁśumāniva \|\| 7.2,40.21

taṁ dṛṣṭvā ṣaṭkulīyāste nāradaṁ munigovṛṣam \|\| 7.2,40.22

praṇamyāvasaraṁ śaṁbhoḥ papracchuḥ paramādarāt \|\| 7.2,40.22

sa cāvasara evāyamitoṁtargamyatāmiti \|\| 7.2,40.23

vadanyayāvanyaparastvarayā parayā yutaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.23

tato dvāri sthitā ye vai brahmaṇe tānnyavedayan \|\| 7.2,40.24

tena te viviśurveśma piṁḍībhūyāṁḍajanmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.24

praviśya dūrato devaṁ praṇamya bhuvi daṁḍavat \|\| 7.2,40.25

samīpe tadanujñātāḥ parivṛtyopatasthire \|\| 7.2,40.25

tāṁstatrāvasthitān pṛṣṭvā kuśalaṁ kamalāsanaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.26

vṛttāṁtaṁ vo mayā jñātaṁ vāyurevāha no yataḥ \|\| 7.2,40.26

bhavadbhiḥ kiṁ kṛtaṁ paścānmāruteṁtarhite sati \|\| 7.2,40.27

ityuktavati deveśe munayo 'vabhṛthātparam \|\| 7.2,40.27

gaṁgātīrthesya gamanaṁ yātrāṁ vārāṇasīṁ prati \|\| 7.2,40.28

darśanaṁ tatra liṁgānāṁ sthāpitānāṁ sureśvaraiḥ \|\| 7.2,40.28

avimukteśvarasyāpi liṁgasyābhyarcanaṁ sakṛt \|\| 7.2,40.29

ākāśe mahatastasya tejorāśeśca darśanam \|\| 7.2,40.29

munīnāṁ vilayaṁ tatra nirodhaṁ tejasastataḥ \|\| 7.2,40.30

yāthātmyavedanaṁ tasya ciṁtitasyāpi cātmabhiḥ \|\| 7.2,40.30

sarvaṁ savistaraṁ tasmai praṇamyāhurmuhurmuhuḥ \|\| 7.2,40.31

munibhiḥ kathitaṁ śrutvā viśvakarmā caturmukhaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.31

kaṁpayitvā śiraḥ kiṁcitprāha gaṁbhīrayā girā \|\| 7.2,40.32

pratyāsīdati yuṣmākaṁ siddhirāmuṣmikī parā \|\| 7.2,40.32

599

bhavadbhirdīrghasatreṇa ciramārādhitaḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 7.2,40.33

prasādābhimukho bhūta iti bhutārthasūcitam \|\| 7.2,40.33

vārāṇasyāṁ tu yuṣmābhiryaddṛṣṭaṁ divi dīptimat \|\| 7.2,40.34

talliṁgasaṁjñitaṁ sākṣāttejo māheśvaraṁ param \|\| 7.2,40.34

tatra līnāśca munayaḥ śrautapāśupatavratāḥ \|\| 7.2,40.35

muktā babhūvuḥ svasthāśca naiṣṭhikā dagdhakilbiṣāḥ \|\| 7.2,40.35

prāpyānena yathā muktiracirādbhavatāmapi \|\| 7.2,40.36

sa cāyamarthaḥ sūcyeta yuṣmaddṛṣṭena tejasā \|\| 7.2,40.36

tatra vaḥ kāla evaiṣa daivādupanataḥ svayam \|\| 7.2,40.37

prayāta dakṣiṇaṁ meroḥ śikharaṁ devasevitam \|\| 7.2,40.37

sanatkumāro yatrāste mama putraḥ paro muniḥ \|\| 7.2,40.38

pratīkṣyāgamanaṁ sākṣādbhūtanāthasya naṁdinaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.38

purā sanatkumāropi dṛṣṭvāpi parameśvaram \|\| 7.2,40.39

ajñānātsarvayogīndramānī vinayadūṣitaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.39

abhyutthānādikaṁ yuktamakurvannatinirbhayaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.40

tato 'parādhātkruddhena mahoṣṭro naṁdinā kṛtaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.40

atha kālena mahatā tadarthe śocatā mayā \|\| 7.2,40.41

upāsya devaṁ devīñca naṁdinaṁ cānunīya vai \|\| 7.2,40.41

kathaṁciduṣṭratā tasya prayatnena nivāritā \|\| 7.2,40.42

prāpito hi yathāpūrvaṁ sanatpūrvāṁ kumāratām \|\| 7.2,40.42

tadāha ca mahādevaḥ smayanniva gaṇādhipam \|\| 7.2,40.43

avajñāya hi māmeva tathāhaṁkṛtavānmuniḥ \|\| 7.2,40.43

atastvameva yāthātmyaṁ mamāsmai kathayānagha \|\| 7.2,40.44

brahmaṇaḥ pūrvajaḥ putro māṁ mūḍha iva saṁsmaran \|\| 7.2,40.44

mayaiva śiṣyate datto mama jñānapravartakaḥ \|\| 7.2,40.45

dharmādhyakṣābhiṣekaṁ ca tava nirvartayiṣyati \|\| 7.2,40.45

sa evaṁ vyāhṛto bhūyassarvabhūtagaṇāgraṇīḥ \|\| 7.2,40.46

yatparājñāpanaṁ mūrdhnā prātaḥ pratigṛhītavān \|\| 7.2,40.46

tathā sanatkumāro 'pi merau madanuśāsanāt \|\| 7.2,40.47

prasādārthaṁ gaṇasyāsya tapaścarati duścaram \|\| 7.2,40.47

draṣṭavyaśceti yuṣmābhiḥ prāggaṇeśasamāgamāt \|\| 7.2,40.48

tatprasādārthamacirānnaṁdī tatrāgamiṣyati \|\| 7.2,40.48

iti satvaramādiśya preṣitā viśvayoginā \|\| 7.2,40.49

kumāraśikharaṁ merordakṣiṇaṁ munayo yayuḥ \|\| 7.2,40.49

oṁ iti śrīśivamahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīyasaṁhitāyāmuttarakhaṇḍe naimiṣarṣiyātrāvarṇanaṁ nāma catvāriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

## adhyāya 41

sūta uvāca

tatra skaṁdasaro nāma sarassāgarasannibham \|\| 7.2,41.1

amṛtasvāduśiśirasvacchā gādhalaghūdakam \|\| 7.2,41.1

samaṁtataḥ saṁghaṭitaṁ sphaṭiko palasaṁcayaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.2

sarvartukusumaiḥ phullaiśchāditākhiladiṅmukham \|\| 7.2,41.2

śaivalairutpalaiḥ padmaiḥ kumudaistārakopamaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.3

taraṁgairabhrasaṁkāśairākāśamiva bhūmigam \|\| 7.2,41.3

sukhāvataraṇārohaiḥ sthalairnīlaśilāmayaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.4

sopānamārgau ruciraiśśobhamānāṣṭadiṅmukham \|\| 7.2,41.4

600

tatrāvatīrṇaiśca yathā tatrottīrṇaśca bhūyasā \|\| 7.2,41.5

snātaiḥ sitopavītaiśca śuklākaupīnavalkalaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.5

jaṭāśikhāyanairmuṁḍaistripuṁḍrakṛtamaṁḍanaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.6

virāgavivaśasmeramukhairmunikumārakaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.6

ghaṭaiḥ kamalinīpatrapuṭaiśca kalaśaiḥ śivaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.7

kamaṇḍalubhiranyaiśca tādṛśaiḥ karakādibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.7

ātmārthaṁ ca parārthaṁ ca devatārthaṁ viśeṣataḥ \|\| 7.2,41.8

ānīyamānasalilamāttapuṣpaṁ ca nityaśaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.8

aṁtarjalaśilārūḍhairnīcānāṁ sparśaśaṁkayā \|\| 7.2,41.9

ācāravadbhirmunibhiḥ kṛtabhasmāṁgadhūsaraiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.9

itastato 'psu majjadbhiriṣṭaśiṣṭaiḥ śilāgataiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.10

tilaiśca sākṣataiḥ puṣpaistyaktadarbhapavitrakaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.10

devādyamṛṣimadhyaṁ ca nirvartya pitṛtarpaṇam \|\| 7.2,41.11

nivedayedabhijñebhyo nityasnānagatān dvijān \|\| 7.2,41.11

sthānesthāne kṛtānekabalipuṣpasamīraṇaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.12

saurārghyapūrvaṁ kurvadbhiḥsthaṁḍalebhyarcanādikam \|\| 7.2,41.12

kvacinnimajjadunmajjatprasrastagajayūthapam \|\| 7.2,41.13

kvacicca tṛṣayāyātamṛgīmṛgaturaṁgamam \|\| 7.2,41.13

kvacitpītajanottīrṇamayūravaravāraṇam \|\| 7.2,41.14

kvacitkṛtataṭāghātavṛṣaprativṛṣojjvalam \|\| 7.2,41.14

kvacitkāraṁḍavaravaiḥ kvacitsārasakūjitaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.15

kvacicca kokaninadaiḥ kvacidbhramaragītibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.15

snānapānādikaraṇaiḥ svasaṁpaddrumajīvibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.16

praṇayātprāṇibhistaistairbhāṣamāṇamivāsakṛt \|\| 7.2,41.16

kūlaśākhiśikhālīnakokilākulakūjitaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.17

ātapopahatānsarvānnāmaṁtrayadivāniśam \|\| 7.2,41.17

uttare tasya sarasastīre kalpataroradhaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.18

vedyāṁ vajraśilāmayyāṁ mṛdule mṛgacarmaṇi \|\| 7.2,41.18

sanatkumāramāsīnaṁ śaśvadbālavapurdharam \|\| 7.2,41.19

tatkālamātroparataṁ samādheracalātmanaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.19

upāsyamānaṁ munibhiryogīṁdrairapi pūjitam \|\| 7.2,41.20

dadṛśurnaimiṣeyāste praṇatāścopatasthire \|\| 7.2,41.20

yāvatpṛṣṭavate tasmai procuḥ svāgatakāraṇam \|\| 7.2,41.21

tumulaḥ śuśruve tāvaddivi duṁdubhinisvanaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.21

dadṛśe tatkṣaṇe tasminvimānaṁ bhānusannibham \|\| 7.2,41.22

gaṇeśvarairasaṁkhyeyaiḥ saṁvṛtaṁ ca samaṁtataḥ \|\| 7.2,41.22

apsarogaṇasaṁkīrṇaṁ rudrakanyābhirāvṛtam \|\| 7.2,41.23

mṛdaṁgamurajodghuṣṭaṁ veṇuvīṇāravānvitam \|\| 7.2,41.23

citraratnavitānāḍhyaṁ muktādāmavirājitam \|\| 7.2,41.24

munibhissiddhagaṁdharvairyakṣacāraṇakinnaraiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.24

nṛtyadbhiścaiva gāyadbhirvādayadbhiśca saṁvṛtam \|\| 7.2,41.25

vīragovṛṣacihnena vidramadrumayaṣṭinā \|\| 7.2,41.25

kṛtagopurasatkāraṁ ketunā mānyahetunā \|\| 7.2,41.26

tasya madhye vimānasya cāmaradvitayāṁtare \|\| 7.2,41.26

chattrasya maṇidaṁḍasya caṁdrasyeva śuceradhaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.27

divyasiṁhāsanārūḍhaṁ devyā suyaśayā saha \|\| 7.2,41.27

600

śriyā ca vapuṣā caiva tribhiścāpi vilocanaiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.28

prākārairabhikṛtyānāṁ pratyabhijñāpakaṁ prabhoḥ \|\| 7.2,41.28

avilaṁghya jagatkarturājñāpanamivāgatam \|\| 7.2,41.29

sarvānugrahaṇaṁ śaṁbhoḥ sākṣādiva puraḥsthitam \|\| 7.2,41.29

śilādatanayaṁ sākṣācchrīmacchūlavarāyudham \|\| 7.2,41.30

viśveśvaragaṇādhyakṣaṁ viśveśvaramivāparam \|\| 7.2,41.30

viśvasyāpi vidhātḥṇāṁ nigrahānugrahakṣamam \|\| 7.2,41.31

caturbāhumudārāṁgaṁ candrarekhāvibhūṣitam \|\| 7.2,41.31

kaṁṭhe nāgena maulau ca śaśāṁkenāpyalaṁkṛtam \|\| 7.2,41.32

savigrahamivaiśvaryaṁ sāmarthyamiva sakriyam \|\| 7.2,41.32

samāptamiva nirvāṇaṁ sarvajñamiva saṁgatam \|\| 7.2,41.33

dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭavadano brahmaputraḥ saharṣibhiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.33

tasthau prāñjalirutthāya tasyātmānamivārpayan \|\| 7.2,41.34

atha tatrāṁtare tasminvimāne cāvaniṁ gate \|\| 7.2,41.34

praṇamya daṇḍavaddevaṁ stutvā vyajñāpayanmunīm \|\| 7.2,41.35

ṣaṭkulīyā ime dīrghaṁ naimiṣe satramāsthitāḥ \|\| 7.2,41.35

āgatā brahmaṇādiṣṭāḥ pūrvamevābhikāṁkṣayā \|\| 7.2,41.35

śrutvā vākyaṁ brahmaputrasya naṁdīchittvā pāśāndṛṣṭipātena sadyaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.36

śaivaṁ dharmaṁ caiśvaraṁ jñānayogaṁ dattvā bhūyo devapārśvaṁ jagāma \|\| 7.2,41.36

sanatkumāreṇa ca tatsamastaṁ vyāsāya sākṣādgurave mamoktam \|\| 7.2,41.37

vyāsena coktaṁ mahitena mahyaṁ mayā ca tadvaḥ kathitaṁ samāsāt \|\| 7.2,41.37

nāvedavidbhyaḥ kathanīyametatpurāṇaratnaṁ puraśāsanasya \|\| 7.2,41.38

nābhaktaśiṣyāya ca nāstikebhyo dattaṁ hi mohānnirayaṁ dadāti \|\| 7.2,41.38

mārgeṇa sevānugatena yaistaddattaṁ gṛhītaṁ paṭhitaṁ śrutaṁ vā \|\| 7.2,41.39

tebhyaḥ sukhaṁ dharmamukhaṁ trivargaṁ nirvāṇamaṁte niyataṁ dadāti \|\| 7.2,41.39

parasparasyopakṛtaṁ bhavadbhirmayā ca paurāṇikamārgayogāt \|\| 7.2,41.40

ato gamiṣye 'hamavāptakāmaḥ samastamevāstu śivaṁ sadā naḥ \|\| 7.2,41.40

sūte kṛtāśiṣi gate munayaḥ suvṛttā yāge ca paryavasite mahati prayoge \|\| 7.2,41.41

kāle kalau ca viṣayaiḥ kaluṣāyamāṇe vārāṇasīparisare vasatiṁ vinetuḥ \|\| 7.2,41.41

atha ca te paśupāśamumukṣayākhilatayā kṛtapāśupatavratāḥ \|\| 7.2,41.42

adhikṛtākhilabodhasamādhayaḥ paramanirvṛtimāpuraniṁditāḥ \|\| 7.2,41.42

vyāsa uvāca

etacchivapurāṇaṁ hi samāptaṁ hitamādarāt \|\| 7.2,41.43

paṭhitavyaṁ prayatnena śrotavyaṁ ca tathaiva hi \|\| 7.2,41.43

nāstikāya na vaktavyamaśraddhāya śaṭhāya ca \|\| 7.2,41.44

abhaktāya maheśasya tathā dharmadhvajāya ca \|\| 7.2,41.44

etacchrutyā hyekavāraṁ bhavetpāpaṁ hi bhasmasāt \|\| 7.2,41.45

abhakto bhaktimāpnoti bhakto bhaktisamṛddhibhāk \|\| 7.2,41.45

punaḥ śrute ca sadbhaktirmuktissyācca śruteḥ punaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.46

tasmātpunaḥpunaścaiva śrotavyaṁ hi mumukṣubhiḥ \|\| 7.2,41.46

601

pañcāvṛttiḥ prakartavyā purāṇasyāsya saddhiyā \|\| 7.2,41.47

paraṁ phalaṁ samuddiśya tatprāpnoti na saṁśayaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.47

purātanāśca rājāno viprā vaiśyāśca sattamāḥ \|\| 7.2,41.48

saptakṛtvastadāvṛttyālabhanta śivadarśanam \|\| 7.2,41.48

śroṣyatyathāpi yaścedaṁ mānavo bhaktitatparaḥ \|\| 7.2,41.49

iha bhuktvākhilānbhogānaṁte muktiṁ labhecca saḥ \|\| 7.2,41.49

etacchivapurāṇaṁ hi śivasyātipriyaṁ param \|\| 7.2,41.50

bhuktimuktipradaṁ brahmasaṁmitaṁ bhaktivardhanam \|\| 7.2,41.50

etac chiva-purāṇasya vaktuḥ śrotuś ca sarvadā \|\| 7.2,41.51

sagaṇas sasutas sāṁbaś śaṁkarotu sa śaṁkaraḥ \|\| 7.2,41.51

oṁ iti śrī-śiva-mahāpurāṇe saptamyāṁ vāyavīya-saṁhitāyāmuttara-khaṇḍe vyāsopadeśa-śrī-śiva-mahāpurāṇa-māhātmya-varṇanaṁ nāmaika-catvāriṁśo 'dhyāyaḥ

samāpto 'yaṁ granthaḥ

601
